chapters.title: Chapter 1051: Sudden Attack
paragraphs: Kent looked at the two men frozen under his pressure and smiled.
"I know what you are wondering. How did we end up in this mess?"
Kent grinned, "You were the leader of the Blue Flame Pill Palace, and you were the Vice Leader... a rather obedient and trustworthy one, considering you could have killed him and taken his place.
However, you didn’t, and now, here we are.
You were supposed to be respected, unbeatable, and scary.

However, here you are suppressed and soon to be tortured, all because you couldn’t take a loss like a man, and instead chose to chase a harmless woman all the way to her world for something she won fair and square."
Kent pushed the Old Man down and sat in his chair, placing his leg on the table. His left hand supported his chin as he looked at them.
"First of all, why don’t you tell me the main reason why you went after the Soul Spirit?"
Kent lit the Umbral Flame of Oblivion, bringing it closer to Vice Leader Vince’s face. The danger within the flame made his skin crawl. Naturally, that told him what he needed to know...
"We wanted it to gain favor with the Planet King," Vince said, a pained expression on his face. The Umbral Flame of Oblivion isn’t something to be taken lightly.
"Now I am intrigued," Kent leaned in the chair and crossed his legs.
"Humor me."
Vince winced, but he had to speak because the pain he felt from the dark flames on Kent’s palm was something his soul was afraid of.
"The Planet King is the leader of the Evil Sect. He helped us rise to the level we are at now, so we respect him and his organization.
However, we want to be able to rise above the Pill Alliance, and to do that, we have to gain the favor of the Planet King.
This means if we were to present a Tier 18 Forsaken Soul Spirit to him, not only would he be happy; he might pull us into his inner circle..."
Vince paused when he suddenly noticed something. He turned his head, which he could actually do now, and looked at the Old Man, who was looking back at him with a frown.
"You idiot... what have you done?" the Old Man shouted, his fury bubbling up.
"Hey, don’t shout at him like that," Kent replied, his expression a mix of anger and amusement...
"Yes, why are you shouting at me like that?"

"This idiot," the Old Man gritted his teeth and said, "he is clearly mind-controlling you. The Vince I knew wouldn’t dare divulge such sensitive information to anyone... definitely not to some no-name."
"That is harsh, Leader," Vince said, a frown appearing on his face. "You would do well not to talk to Master Chaos like that."
Kent smiled, feeling very proud.
When he teleported inside the room, he wanted to use the nirvana flames to torture them. However, he soon realized he was much stronger now.
Despite being weak mentally before, now that he had broken three limits on his mind, if he used his bloodline power to suppress them, he could mind-control them.
He tried it with Vince, and looking at him now, Kent knew he was as good as dead.
"So the Planet King is the leader of the Evil Sect."
"Yes, Master Chaos."
"Very good, Vince. I will ensure your death is very painful."
Vince nodded with a smile. "I deserve to die painfully, Master Kent."
Kent read his memories, and so far, if he had the chance, he would boil hot water and pour it down the bastard’s throat for causing so much pain to innocent families.
He killed and separated so many families that one couldn’t begin to think a person could do such vile things.
"How about the armor you bought from the Brown Maple Auction House?" Kent asked, and Vince retrieved the armor from his space ring.
Kent took it and placed it directly inside his space ring.
He walked to the Old Man and activated the Soul Torture. In no time, he penetrated the old man’s soul defense and locked on his soul core.
This means he will die regardless of whether he is guilty or not. Also, his mind is now Kent’s to do with as he pleases.
Kent retrieved two daggers and placed them on the table, and stood up...
"You each have a dagger. All you have to do is skin each other alive. You are not allowed to scream. Also, Old Man, in 8 minutes, stop breathing and die like the scum you are.
Vince, as for you, after he dies, continue to skin yourself alive until you can’t handle it anymore. Only then are you allowed to die."
"Yes, Master Kent."
Kent nodded and vanished, leaving the two to take action.
Vince grabbed a dagger and cut the old man’s ear off.
In retaliation, the old man cut his nose off. Vince took off his other ear, and what shouldn’t be called upon anyone had just landed on these two simply because they had crossed the wrong person.
But even if they hadn’t crossed Kent, killing thousands of mortals and using them as ingredients for the Soul Extinguishing pill warranted what was happening to them a thousand times over.
Kent left them, but he kept watching them skin each other alive. He left a strand of the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
In 25 minutes, it would burn the mansion to the ground, bringing an end to the tyranny these two had inflicted over the years.
While Kent was walking away, a voice suddenly entered his mind, causing him to halt in his step immediately...
"Lord Chaos, we are under attack."
One of the beasts he had left on Planet Nictus reported to him.
"By who?" Kent asked. Thanks to the bracelet, he could talk to them over long distances.
"The Planet King. I think he is after Lady Azela, Kami, and Agnes."
Kent tried to harness the teleportation ability of the taming bracelet, but it didn’t work...
’Tower, what is happening?’
[The taming bracelet is only at Tier 1. You can use it to teleport only when it is Tier 4.]
’Damn it.’
"Lord Chaos, he had taken the three of them and is living."
"What about the formation... is it active?"
"Yes, Lord Chaos... But it doesn’t have any effect on him."
"Are they hurt?"

"No, Lord Chaos." The beast reporting to him paused for a moment before adding more context. "I think they surrendered. I just received a transmission from Lady Azela... She said she was sorry that she would miss you."
Kent’s heartbeat slowed down. He knew what she meant...
"Tell her to give me five days."
Kent teleported to the teleportation gate, where the same man who had given him VIP treatment a few months back was still working.
"Good to see you again, young Master," Daniel greeted, and Kent responded with a nod.
"I need to get to Planet Nictus, but I can’t wait seven days to get there. Is there a quick way?" Kent asked, and Daniel smiled.
"There is indeed a way to get you there within minutes... but it will cost you a fortune even if you are you."
"I don’t mind..."
"Lord Chaos, what are your orders?" The beast asked again...
"Sit tight and make sure no harm comes to the disciples of the sect. I will be there in a few minutes."
Daniel led Kent to a room where a white portal that was exuding faint cosmic energy stood.

chapters.title: Chapter 1052: I need a Ship
paragraphs: "This portal will take you to Planet Nictus after I enter the star coordinates," Daniel said and started entering the unique star coordinates for Planet Nictus.
It may be a non-technological world, but they had long developed superior devices that can do what most modern technologically advanced worlds like Earth can’t.
It is all about studying the stars and knowing how to build arrays and formations.
After he was done, Daniel looked at a few runes that appeared.
"You will have to pay 700 million High-Grade Spirit stones."
Kent didn’t hesitate and took out the card he received from the Brown Maple Auction House. Daniel also brought out a purple jade crystal, and Kent tapped the card against it.
In no time, the spirit stones were transferred, and Kent was ready to leave...
"Thank you, Daniel," Kent said, and Daniel nodded with a smile.
"Good luck, young master."
Kent stepped into the portal and was gone.
He traveled through the void at a speed even he couldn’t track or move, even if he were to use 135,000 flame veins.
However, instead of shattering, a bubble made out of cosmic energy enveloped him, preventing him from feeling the pressure.
Five minutes later, inside a certain room on Planet Nictus, a portal opened and Kent stepped out. Right then, he saw someone standing not far from him...
"Welcome to Planet Nictus..."
"Thank you."
"Are you planning on staying in this city, or do you have another place in mind?" the man asked with a smile.
"I am planning to head to Jin City."
The smile on his face vanished when he heard the mention of Jin City...
"Is anything wrong?" Kent asked, and the man nodded.
"Words reaching us now are that the notorious Planet King attacked Jin City and kidnapped the sect leader of the Heavens Eye Sect, along with her mother and Commander Agnes.
Rumor says he plans to make them his wives in five days...

The army had been deployed there, but by the time they reached there, he was gone. The strange part is that during the attack, three other cities were attacked and, like in Jin City, some ladies were kidnapped.
I will advise you to stay away from Jin City for a few days... at least until after the army pulls back."
"I am afraid I can’t do that. My family is in Jin City, so I can’t stay away."
The man sighed. "I understand. Family is important."
"Indeed," Kent smiled, and the man reciprocated his smile.
"In that case, I will send you to Jin City free of charge."
"Thank you."
They walked out of the room, and soon, the teleportation gate opened and Kent’s body vanished.
The moment he appeared in Jin City, he could sense the dull atmosphere. It felt like a fog of death was hovering over them.
Kent didn’t mind anyone. He teleported away, and soon he was only a few kilometers from the Heavens Eye Sect; however, his soul map already covered the entire sect.
Deep inside the core region, he saw dozens of Heavenly Ascension Stage warriors pointing their weapons at the beasts he had left to protect the sect and his lovers.
A lady whose aura was in no way weaker than the Monarchs he had tamed was questioning them. He could even see Yu Lan standing at the back, her gaze cold.
"Where is General Agnes, the sect master, and her mother?" the lady asked, her expression dark.
None of the beasts even bothered to answer her. This alone only added to the anger she was in. She wanted to find General Agnes and rescue her.
She was her priority... however, as it stands, aside from suspecting the beasts, she had no proof they were involved.

But even if they were, she knew taking them in was going to be very hard. After all, she could sense the aura around them, and she knew, aside from herself and a few others, taking on these beasts would be next to impossible.
This was also the main reason she hadn’t gone ballistic yet. However, seeing that the beasts had no intention of answering her began to wear away her patience.
"I will only ask one more time... if you fail to answer me... I will have no reason but to brand you as criminals and have you executed."
"I am afraid you can’t do that." Kent appeared a few meters from her and began walking toward the beasts. When they saw him, their expressions brightened.
"Who are you?" General Brianna asked, wearing a frown.
"I am Kent. Nice meeting you."
Kent stopped beside the beasts and turned toward General Brianna.
"You are Kent... The Kent?"
"Have we met?" Kent smiled but didn’t go any further than that...
"No. But I believe Commander Agnes met you before."
Kent nodded. "I see. Well then, I am leaving now... I have a Planet King to kill, and time waits for no man."
General Brianna’s expression changed. She wanted to say something; however, recalling what Commander Agnes had told her, she held herself back despite Kent’s plain disrespect.
However, the other Generals besides her aren’t aware of the danger they are staring at...
"Who the hell do you think you are, and what makes you think you can just come and go? Are you looking to die?"

Kent turned and looked at the idiot who was planning to throw his life away. "I don’t plan on dying anytime soon, so no... However, you’d better watch where you point that stick, else you wouldn’t know how you died."
Kent waved his hand, and the General’s body was hurled through the air, crashing into a wall 2 km away.
Kent ignored the shock on everyone’s face and turned to the beasts... "We are going to war. Are you all ready?"
"We are ready, Lord Chaos."
"Very good." Kent turned back to the shocked General Brianna and smiled. "I need a ship."
"Huh?"
"You know... one of those things that flies through the air and can travel between planets."
"I know what a ship is, but why do you need one?"
"I can’t exactly walk to Planet Seamus Prime now, can I?" Kent smirked, thinking this conversation was pointless.
"You aren’t seriously considering going there, are you? The Planet King is marrying his wives in 5 days, meaning all his lackeys will be there. Naturally, that means going there is suicide."
"Even better. They will all be in the same place, which means I can kill all of them once and for all."
Everyone present frowned, watching as Kent treated this so casually. It was as if he didn’t even place the Planet King in his eyes. He wasn’t even affected in any way...
"Look. The longer we wait, the more hold that bastard has on my future wives. So do me a favor and lend me a ship..."
Kent walked closer to her and whispered into her ear...

"Give me a ship and I will return your princess to you safe, sound, and still a maiden. Delay, and it is not only going to be the Planet King who will feel my wrath, but the entirety of this planetary system."
General Brianna’s body shuddered, fear gripping her.
Kent waved his hand, and all the beasts except the ones contracted to the three ladies were left standing.
He turned to Yu Lan and asked a question...
"Is she okay?"
"Yes. Sister Agnes is fine... however, she is afraid. They all are"
"Don’t worry, we will rescue them soon."
Kent turned back to General Brianna... and furrowed his brow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1053: Meeting a Puppet King
paragraphs: "So, are you going to give me a ship or not?" Kent asked.

After sacrificing 10 days, the tower told him that he couldn’t travel directly to Planet Seamus Prime from Planet Nictus. The only way to get there is through one of the six worlds currently under the control of the Planet King.

However, it would take him 4 days to get to the nearest one and another 3 days to reach Planet Seamus Prime. However, if he has a ship and uses the star coordinates the tower gave him, he will reach Planet Seamus Prime before the forbidden wedding takes place.
Kent only needs a ship, and he will bring hell to Planet Seamus Prime.
He doesn’t need any help, and he most certainly isn’t in the right frame of mind to tolerate childish behavior.
"I can’t give you a ship. However, the King can if you can really bring back her daugh... Commander Agnes," General Brianna said, and Kent, who was in a hurry, nodded.
"Then bring me to the king. The more we waste time, the more danger they are in."
General Brianna nodded and gestured for the other generals to follow.
Kent didn’t know if this was some form of trap to take him down. However, he knew one thing: if the king dares make a fuss, he will kill him and take over Planet Nictus...
If he was able to pop down to hell and return as a King, then becoming a King of a planet is not something he will struggle with...
On their way, General Brianna informed the appropriate persons, so when they reached the palace, every last soldier was at attention, weapons ready.
Kent merely smirked and followed General Brianna inside. Yu Lan and the other two beasts entered the palace, too.
They wanted to fight when the planet king attacked... every last beast did. However, realizing the strength of their opponents, Lady Kami advised them to stand down...
Naturally, the Planet King came for them, so after getting them, he left.
Now, knowing Kent planned to rescue them, the three beast companions of the three ladies who had been kidnapped wanted nothing more than to get them back.
When they entered the hall, the first person they saw was the king seated on his throne, with four bodyguards standing behind him.
On his left was another throne, and the person seated inside was the queen, the king’s main wife.
’An Elf King, huh. I thought only Queens ruled the Elven race.’ This was Kent’s first time meeting an Elven King. However, he showed no reaction.
There were also ten Elven elders in the throne room.

Kent didn’t mind the atmosphere. Perhaps before coming to the Past, he would have felt pressured by their auras. However, now that his bloodline had seen a significant awakening, they didn’t measure up to him in any way.
General Brianna went down on her knees when she was close enough...
Kent remained standing...
"My King, this is Kent, the one Commander Agnes talked about."
"Nice meeting you, Kent," King Yesron said, his appraising eyes scanning Kent.
"Glad to meet you, too." Kent looked at the expression on the King’s face, and then he looked at the other Elven elders and immediately knew what was going on in their minds.
However, he had no time to entertain them.
"Pardon my arrogance, King Yesron, but I need a ship, and General Brianna said you are the only one who can provide me one. So here I am..."
Kent’s tone was rude and plain. However, he made it clear why he was there. He had no time to flatter the king when he already felt negative energy coming from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1054: Red Wedding (1)
paragraphs: [Day of the Wedding]
Inside the room where Lady Kami, Azela, and Commander Agnes were being held, the ladies assigned to prepare them for the wedding were busy at their task, dressing them for their big day.
The three ladies remained calm, making no sound despite the situation they found themselves in.
It was almost as if they had given up hope and were now waiting to get things over with.
However, in reality, they couldn’t wait to see the bastard who had kidnapped them choke on his own blood.
Unlike the Taming Bracelet or the harem link, which can be used from a long distance, the connection between the three ladies and their tamed beasts could only work if they were on the same planet.
The moment one was off-world, the connection became usable. However, because they were connected, each could feel the other’s emotional state.
This was how Yu Lan and the other beasts knew the three ladies were afraid a few days ago. Naturally, they were terrified... however, they weren’t anymore.
Their calm and composure were because of the people currently inside an inn somewhere in Alpha City.
Kent sat around a table with Yu Lan, Esme (the dragon beast contracted to Lady Kami), Lois (the phoenix contracted to Lady Azela), and General Brianna.
He had disguised them so no one could recognize them.
They had arrived three hours ago, and while Kent could get his mission done, he first wanted to wait and gather all the scums supporting the Planet King.
He wanted them all dead, so he was waiting for the wedding to start.
"What is the plan?" General Brianna asked, a little nervous. It was her lifelong dream to kill the Planet King and his allies. However, with her strength, she knew she could only dream.
However, now inside his territory and even free to do as she pleased, she wanted to know how the mission would be carried out and what role she would be playing.
"There is no plan, General," Kent said with a smile.
"What do you mean, there is no plan?" General Brianna frowned.
"Why would I need a plan to kill the scum and his lackeys?"
"This—" General Brianna didn’t know what to say.
"No need to be alarmed, General. The plan is very simple. When the wedding starts, I will walk there, kill them all, and leave. It is that simple, General, so no need to look nervous."
The three beasts who knew what Kent was capable of didn’t doubt his words. They could tell he meant business, and so all they could do was wait for the time to come.
General Brianna could only sigh in her heart and hope Commander Agnes came out alive...
[Four hours later]
From the moment Kent and his people arrived, his soul map was active, watching as one guest after another arrived.
At first, the guests arriving were people he did not know. However, as the crowd grew, some familiar faces began to appear.
Most of these familiar faces came from the Pill Worlds. He recognized them because he had seen them during the Pill Ascension trial.
Kent never forgot a face.
Kent knew these people were in bed with the Evil sect, and now that he was seeing them at the wedding of their leader, he knew they must die.

Of course, he could gather evidence and try to shut them down. However, as beings from Pill Worlds and alchemists, they could argue that they were neutral parties and were invited because they wanted to expand their sphere of influence.
In a way, this could save them. So Kent had an outright plan to kill them. Allowing them to live would only make others grow a pair and also start doing the same thing... maybe even worse.
In no time, all guests were seated, and that was when he arrived...
’The Planet King’
Kent’s eyes narrowed when he saw the Planet King walk to the stage, followed by five people.

A smile formed on Kent’s lips when he saw the sixth, bandaged and seated on the sideline. He immediately realized what had happened to him, and now, seeing the anger in his eyes, he knew the bastard might be aware that the soul spirit that had exploded in his face had been tampered with...
The only suspects, too, were now about to marry his boss, so he could only fume in silence.
The five standing behind the Planet King were his generals, and on the left, seated in the front row, were the kings and queens of the six worlds he had under his control.
All six of them were powerful, and Kent could see it. But he wasn’t about to even think about them when his focus was on the Planet King.
’Ignarok and the others didn’t lie when they said he is strong.’ Kent had to admit, the bastard was dangerous.
With the Soul Map, he was able to sense his aura, and he knew if he had come right after he left the Flame Sea, winning would have been difficult.
’However, he is now as good as dead.’ Kent smirked and looked toward General Brianna.
"You, Yu Lan, Esme, and Lois are on a rescue mission.
Rescue the three ladies and take them to the ship, and leave. Head straight to Planet Nictus... I will follow when I am done."
They nodded.
"Are you sure you will be okay?"
Kent stood up and smiled. "I have been to hell and back, General... so rest assured, I will be more than fine."
The Planet King, who went by the name Zorath Kaine, scanned the faces of everyone present with his cold gaze.
"Welcome, everyone. I won’t take up much of your time because after today, we will start with our long, ambitious plan of taking over the entire star system, which includes the ten Pill Worlds.
You all have demonstrated your loyalty and have helped build this organization. However, we can’t stop there... we have to think bigger. So we will be expanding.
However, before the chaos, we must first celebrate."
He smiled and walked to a throne prepared for him.
Then one of the kings, by the name Myrrh, a dark elf, stood up and walked to the stage.
"Lord Planet King has said it all... so without further ado, let’s welcome the brides."
From one of the entrances, sixteen veiled beauties, all dressed in red, walked out and started heading toward the stage.
Lady Kami, Azela, and Commander Agnes were the last to walk out.
Lady Azela took the lead, telling the two ladies behind her not to worry —she would protect them. Of course, their cultivation was sealed, so she was just being brave for her daughter.
Every eye turned toward these beautiful ladies who would soon become wives of their leader, the Planet King.

However, just when the ladies came into view for everyone else to see, a handsome young man dressed in simple clothing walked forward and wrapped his arms around Lady Azela and Commander Agnes’ waists.
GASP
Gasps escaped everyone’s lips when they saw this. However, Kent merely smiled and stared at the dark circles forming around the planet king’s eyes...
He didn’t say anything.
However, Kent’s next action infuriated everyone. He leaned in, kissing Lady Azela’s cheek.
"YOU DARE!"
An arrow streaked through the air, aimed at Kent right when he kissed Lady Azela...

chapters.title: Chapter 1055: Red Wedding (2)
paragraphs: The arrow arrived before Kent. However, before it could pierce him, he caught it between his fingers and tossed it to the side.
Following behind were Yu Lan, Esme, Lois, and General Brianna, who looked surprised when Kent caught the arrow.
In fact, everyone was surprised by how he defended against an arrow from a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator.
The alchemist there, who recognized him, started to panic. They saw what Kent could do, and this made them sense the danger coming.
The six generals, even the injured one, stood up and retrieved their weapons. The kings were the same, but the Planet King still remained on his throne.
The brides walking toward the stage halted, and a few even started crying.
Lady Kami turned toward Kent and lifted her veil, a happy expression painting her face...
"What took you so long?" she asked, very happy that Kent had finally arrived.
However, instead of answering her, Kent’s hand moved and caught another arrow that was fired by one of the generals. This time, it was aimed at Lady Kami, so he retaliated.
The arrow he caught was hurled forward, and before the general could dodge, it went through his head, ending him swiftly.
Kent ignored the rest and took Lady Kami’s hand. His soul energy evaded her body, and the seal on her cultivation was lifted.
"I am here now. However, you have to leave with General Brianna... I will follow once I am done here."
Lady Kami nodded, knowing this battle wasn’t something she could participate in.
Kent looked at the Planet King, who was now standing, his expression focused on him.
"So you are the Planet King," Kent asked, a smirk tugging on his lips. He could see it; the bastard was in shock. The way Kent killed one of his generals was just too shocking.
"Who are you?" the Planet King asked.
"Nobody too important. However, I was sent to come kill you and all these idiots, so you can call me the Planet King Killer."
"I see. In that case, why don’t I see how you do that?" the Planet King sneered and snapped his fingers.
"Lock down the planet." His command was immediate, and before Kent could make any more, the entire planet was sealed.

"I knew one day somebody would come for me, so I prepared. Of course, you can try all you want, but since we both know how this will end, you can start by surrendering." The planet king said with plain arrogance
Kent turned and first looked at the ladies standing behind him... "It will be best if you close your eyes... You know, blood and all."
"We are not kids, Kent," Lady Kami said, feeling very safe around Kent despite being surrounded by hundreds of warriors.
"I see. Then better not puke." Kent turned to the Planet King and chuckled, then rubbed his taming bracelet, summoning the 48 beasts within.
Kent moved and appeared before him, causing his eyes to widen.

However, he managed to step back and swing his fist, aiming to push Kent back. However, before his fist could reach him, Kent moved and appeared before the general who sent the spies to the Heaven’s Eye sect.
He placed his hand on his head, and then, with a gentle push, his head entered his body, leaving a headless body standing.
"Hahahahaha... Bastard, your reckoning has finally arrived," Ignarok, who saw how Kent killed the poor general, laughed at the Planet King, whose eyes narrowed.
However, before he could move to intercept Kent, he took another step and arrived before one of his kings and pushed his head inside his body, too.
Blood flowed out, causing the brides who saw this to start screaming.
"Kill everyone except the maids and brides," Kent gave the order, and the monarchs, alongside the other beasts, started their second massacre.
"Don’t fight it; this wedding is going to be your funeral, so chill and let my people handle your people. Your death will be last."

"Like hell I will be." The Planet King pulled out his sword and lunged forward. However, instead of attacking Kent, he aimed at Lady Kami. He can tell Kent came for her, and the other two he personally went to Planet Nictus for.
"Weakling."
Kent took one step and arrived before him. He grabbed the sword and stomped on his stomach, sending him flying back.
Kent took one more step and appeared overhead, his right leg stabbing down. He stomped hard on his ribcage, shattering a few.
Then, with one powerful kick, he sent him flying.
⟦The seal is currently under your control, master. However, it costs 30 days, meaning you only have two more weeks left before your time in the past comes to an end.⟧
’Thank you, tower.’
Kent smiled, watching as the Planet King retrieved a talisman, attempting to escape.
"That won’t work, idiot. You have sealed the planet, remember."
"Release the seal."

Kent burst out in resounding laughter as he watched the desperation on the Planet King’s face. He was afraid and desperate to run... However, Kent had already seen this coming and had to sacrifice his remaining days to take control of the seal from him.
Now, he was trapped, and despite having a trace of immortal qi, he was seriously outmatched.
Kent was not using his bloodline; however, he was using 2,000 blood runes and 40,000 flame veins. The Planet King was not even close to measuring up to him.
"Just who are you?" the Planet King spat out, a mouthful of blood.
"Like I said, I am the Planet King Killer. So relax and wait for your death." Kent turned and started observing the massacre his beasts were unleashing.
After they each absorbed a high-grade Primordial Flame, all seven monarchs and the 43 beasts had become monstrous. They were just killing, as if it were second nature to them.
Sylvara and Ignarok had already killed two generals and two kings and were now killing the guests who had been invited to the wedding.
"Bugs."

Kent saw from a distance thousands of warriors flying toward them. However, instead of moving to attack them, he waved his hand, and thousands of doom shards, sword arcs, flame palms, and many more rained down on them from the void.
Their screams filled the planet.
"You picked the wrong side, bugs; now I can only kill you all."
"DIE."

Suddenly, a white claw of a tiger slashed at Kent’s neck, aiming to sever his head. However, without even turning around, Kent’s hand moved to his back, caught the claw, grabbed the colossal beast summoned by the Planet King, and slammed him into the ground.
But Kent didn’t stop there; he waved his hand, and the Unbral Flame of Oblivion surrounded the colossal tiger.
"Bro, immortal qi and wannabe Supreme Grade bloodline won’t help you." Kent kicked him away, sending him flying into empty space; his roars shook the hearts of every ally.
"We don’t accept surrender, so kill them all."
Kent walked closer to the Planet King and stomped on his leg.

"I expected so much from you. I was told you have a sliver of immortal qi and a Supreme Grade Bloodline. However, compared to those bastards I killed when I came out of the Damned Hell Sea, you are very weak."
Kent chuckled. "I know it is too shocking to say this, considering you are the infamous Planet King that everyone was scared of... But why are you this weak?"

sentences.text: The arrow arrived before Kent.
However, before it could pierce him, he caught it between his fingers and tossed it to the side.
Following behind were Yu Lan, Esme, Lois, and General Brianna, who looked surprised when Kent caught the arrow.
In fact, everyone was surprised by how he defended against an arrow from a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator.
The alchemist there, who recognized him, started to panic.
They saw what Kent could do, and this made them sense the danger coming.
The six generals, even the injured one, stood up and retrieved their weapons.
The kings were the same, but the Planet King still remained on his throne.
The brides walking toward the stage halted, and a few even started crying.
Lady Kami turned toward Kent and lifted her veil, a happy expression painting her face...
"What took you so long?" she asked, very happy that Kent had finally arrived.
However, instead of answering her, Kent’s hand moved and caught another arrow that was fired by one of the generals.
This time, it was aimed at Lady Kami, so he retaliated.
The arrow he caught was hurled forward, and before the general could dodge, it went through his head, ending him swiftly.
Kent ignored the rest and took Lady Kami’s hand.
His soul energy evaded her body, and the seal on her cultivation was lifted.
"I am here now.
However, you have to leave with General Brianna...
I will follow once I am done here."
Lady Kami nodded, knowing this battle wasn’t something she could participate in.
Kent looked at the Planet King, who was now standing, his expression focused on him.
"So you are the Planet King," Kent asked, a smirk tugging on his lips.
He could see it; the bastard was in shock.
The way Kent killed one of his generals was just too shocking.
"Who are you?" the Planet King asked.
"Nobody too important.
However, I was sent to come kill you and all these idiots, so you can call me the Planet King Killer."
"I see.
In that case, why don’t I see how you do that?" the Planet King sneered and snapped his fingers.
"Lock down the planet." His command was immediate, and before Kent could make any more, the entire planet was sealed.
"I knew one day somebody would come for me, so I prepared.
Of course, you can try all you want, but since we both know how this will end, you can start by surrendering." The planet king said with plain arrogance
Kent turned and first looked at the ladies standing behind him...
"It will be best if you close your eyes...
You know, blood and all."
"We are not kids, Kent," Lady Kami said, feeling very safe around Kent despite being surrounded by hundreds of warriors.
"I see.
Then better not puke." Kent turned to the Planet King and chuckled, then rubbed his taming bracelet, summoning the 48 beasts within.
Kent moved and appeared before him, causing his eyes to widen.
However, he managed to step back and swing his fist, aiming to push Kent back.
However, before his fist could reach him, Kent moved and appeared before the general who sent the spies to the Heaven’s Eye sect.
He placed his hand on his head, and then, with a gentle push, his head entered his body, leaving a headless body standing.
"Hahahahaha...
Bastard, your reckoning has finally arrived," Ignarok, who saw how Kent killed the poor general, laughed at the Planet King, whose eyes narrowed.
However, before he could move to intercept Kent, he took another step and arrived before one of his kings and pushed his head inside his body, too.
Blood flowed out, causing the brides who saw this to start screaming.
"Kill everyone except the maids and brides," Kent gave the order, and the monarchs, alongside the other beasts, started their second massacre.
"Don’t fight it; this wedding is going to be your funeral, so chill and let my people handle your people.
Your death will be last."
"Like hell I will be." The Planet King pulled out his sword and lunged forward.
However, instead of attacking Kent, he aimed at Lady Kami.
He can tell Kent came for her, and the other two he personally went to Planet Nictus for.
"Weakling."
Kent took one step and arrived before him.
He grabbed the sword and stomped on his stomach, sending him flying back.
Kent took one more step and appeared overhead, his right leg stabbing down.
He stomped hard on his ribcage, shattering a few.
Then, with one powerful kick, he sent him flying.
⟦The seal is currently under your control, master.
However, it costs 30 days, meaning you only have two more weeks left before your time in the past comes to an end.⟧
’Thank you, tower.’
Kent smiled, watching as the Planet King retrieved a talisman, attempting to escape.
"That won’t work, idiot.
You have sealed the planet, remember."
"Release the seal."
Kent burst out in resounding laughter as he watched the desperation on the Planet King’s face.
He was afraid and desperate to run...
However, Kent had already seen this coming and had to sacrifice his remaining days to take control of the seal from him.
Now, he was trapped, and despite having a trace of immortal qi, he was seriously outmatched.
Kent was not using his bloodline; however, he was using 2,000 blood runes and 40,000 flame veins.
The Planet King was not even close to measuring up to him.
"Just who are you?" the Planet King spat out, a mouthful of blood.
"Like I said, I am the Planet King Killer.
So relax and wait for your death." Kent turned and started observing the massacre his beasts were unleashing.
After they each absorbed a high-grade Primordial Flame, all seven monarchs and the 43 beasts had become monstrous.
They were just killing, as if it were second nature to them.
Sylvara and Ignarok had already killed two generals and two kings and were now killing the guests who had been invited to the wedding.
"Bugs."
Kent saw from a distance thousands of warriors flying toward them.
However, instead of moving to attack them, he waved his hand, and thousands of doom shards, sword arcs, flame palms, and many more rained down on them from the void.
Their screams filled the planet.
"You picked the wrong side, bugs; now I can only kill you all."
"DIE."
Suddenly, a white claw of a tiger slashed at Kent’s neck, aiming to sever his head.
However, without even turning around, Kent’s hand moved to his back, caught the claw, grabbed the colossal beast summoned by the Planet King, and slammed him into the ground.
But Kent didn’t stop there; he waved his hand, and the Unbral Flame of Oblivion surrounded the colossal tiger.
"Bro, immortal qi and wannabe Supreme Grade bloodline won’t help you." Kent kicked him away, sending him flying into empty space; his roars shook the hearts of every ally.
"We don’t accept surrender, so kill them all."
Kent walked closer to the Planet King and stomped on his leg.
"I expected so much from you.
I was told you have a sliver of immortal qi and a Supreme Grade Bloodline.
However, compared to those bastards I killed when I came out of the Damned Hell Sea, you are very weak."
Kent chuckled.
"I know it is too shocking to say this, considering you are the infamous Planet King that everyone was scared of...
But why are you this weak?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1056: Red Wedding (3)
paragraphs: Kent truly expected a challenge. To some extent, he even expected the Planet King to be stronger than Hell King Bliz...
However, the one he is fighting now is very weak.
For someone with immortal qi and a Supreme-grade bloodline, he is very weak.
[I believe I know what is happening here.] From within Kent’s soul universe, Gaap spoke, drawing Kent’s attention to him...
’What seems to be the issue?’ Kent asked.
[I believe he has two bloodlines conflicting with each other. Right now, his true strength is nowhere near what it should be. I believe he is even working on merging the two together.
Once he is done, there is no telling how much stronger he will become. However, the current him now is much weaker than even the City Lords back in Hell.]
’Well, that is just disappointing,’ Kent smirked.
Watching what he saw to be a dangerous man now scream in pain on the ground made him wonder just what happened a while back, warranting a raise in the quest danger level.
The quest difficulty was raised when the Planet King had finished absorbing the forsaken bloodline. That moment was unexpected, and so it warranted a rise in the danger level he possessed.
However, his ambition and greed for power got the better of him, so he tried to merge the two. This sparked a backlash that reduced his strength.
However, he was still strong enough to kidnap the three ladies and even decided to attack Planet Nictus and other worlds after his wedding.
However, he never expected someone like Kent to arrive seeking his head.
In a way, Kent came at the right time, which was the wrong time for the Planet King. If he had waited 20 more days, he wouldn’t be having it this easy.
Watching as a bloodbath unfolded on the wedding ground, charred bodies scattered everywhere, Kent could only sigh.
’I really hope back in the future, a worthy opponent would be waiting for me.’
He turned back to the Planet King and took away the fire. He waited for the poor bastard to calm down...
"In your next life, be sure not to associate yourself with the forsaken race... They are not good company, and I, Chaos, will never stop hunting them and their associates down."
Perhaps even feeling pity for the bastard, Kent summoned Gaap and drove it through his heart. He truly wanted to have a good battle; however, he was met with disappointment.
Of course, if he hadn’t met the Paragon again inside the Pill Ascension Realm, perhaps he would have had a good battle. But his trip down to Hell has completely changed everything for him.
In a way, Kent defies the norm and has done something he never would have done had it not been for Paragon.
The moment the Planet King died, the quest message rang along with a notification telling him he had become a Sword Sage.
’The only requirement now is to gain five more sword enlightenments in the sword path, and I will become a Sword King,’ Kent smiled...
"I may be strong, but when it comes to sword mastery, I am still far from being the best in a high world. I need to catch up."
After four good hours of massacre, in which Lady Kami, Azela, General Brianna, and Commander Agnes even joined, the legacy of the Planet King was wiped out.
News immediately spread, telling everyone that a new king is in town and that his name is Chaos. Kent intentionally chose not to use his real name for obvious reasons.
However, the mysterious Chaos has spread everywhere, and in no time, the six planets that were under the control of the Planet King and Planet Nictus had all sworn their allegiance to Kent.
It cost him seven days in the past, but he managed to add seven high worlds to his guardian tower, allowing him to immediately start forming another asteroid.
Kent, now left with only seven days to remain in the past, set out to accomplish many things before his time ran out...
[Planet Solan (Immortal World) - Supreme White Tiger Clan - Lord Cyrus’s POV]
Planet Solan is an immortal world in the Divine Beast Star System. This star system is filled with only beastkins, most of which are Divine Beasts.
Planet Solan is the home world of the Supreme White Tiger Clan, one of the powerhouses in this star system.
They are mostly recognized among the strongest worlds simply because they have a few Supreme Beasts in their ranks.
Of course, a clan having five demigods and hundreds of immortals is no weak family.
There are rumors that even say the ancestor of the Supreme White Tiger Clan has reached the rank of a god; however, he is suppressing himself until he is ready to take the tribulation.
At the moment, sitting under a pavilion is a white-haired, handsome man who has the aura of a demigod around him.
He is meditating in a quiet atmosphere.
However, out of nowhere, his eyes snap open, and a murderous look forms in his eyes.
"Who dares..." His voice spread through the entire space he was in, shaking almost everything and everyone.
In an instant, four more demigods and thirteen Immortal Lords appeared out of thin air and approached him.
"Lord Cyrus, is everything okay?" a demigod, another handsome white-haired man, asked.
"Kaine is dead."
"WHAT?"
This time, because a lot more people shouted, a few buildings collapsed, and some people were injured.
"Who dares kill an heir of the Supreme White Tiger clan?" a different demigod asked, his expression dark.
"Somebody who has a dying wish," a Lord Immortal said, his killing intent leaking. If Kent saw this, he would probably run with his tail tucked between his legs.
"We should hunt him down. Killing a White Tiger leaves a mark on the killer. We can use it to track them and make sure they pay."
"I second that."
"Me too."
Lord Cyrus, who was fuming with anger, turned and looked in the direction of a mansion sitting atop a mountain. It was as if he were looking at someone.

After a few minutes, he turned back to his subordinates. "Issue a bounty. Whoever can get me the head or location of a person named Chaos will be allowed to pick a treasure from the Supreme White Tiger Vault."
Every last person there nodded.
They understood why Lord Cyrus made this decision.
Inside the mansion on the mountain, on a certain wooden shelf, sat a flat jade stone. On the surface is a crack; however, there is also another word, or more like a name.
The name Chaos is inscribed on this jade stone tablet.
This jade tablet is linked to the Planet King’s soul. It is a way for the Supreme White Tiger Clan to track and determine whether their kin is still alive out there.
However, in the event that they end up dead, either the name of the killer or the location will be inscribed on it.
Kent told the Planet King his name, and so now the entire White Tiger Clan knows the name of the one who killed one of their heirs who went missing many years ago.

Kent, of course, had no idea his name had appeared in the past, and once he got back to the future, not only would he be facing demigods, but even gods who had been searching for him for the past 370,000 years.

chapters.title: Chapter 1057: Loose Ends
paragraphs: [Brown Maple Auction House - Kent and Lady Wu]
After completing his quest and getting seven more worlds linked to his guardian tower, thereby allowing him to start earning soul essence from them, Kent started tying up loose ends.
He had already made up his mind to secure a good future, one where his wives and people in his life back in the future wouldn’t struggle the moment he ascended.

Kent wanted to make good friends, but not just any friends — those he could trust, because while they hadn’t reached the level he knew they would yet, when they do, the one who would make a big impact in their lives was him...
Kent seeks to build that loyalty in them before they meet again.
So the first person he went to see was Lady Wu, the woman at the auction house who oversaw the soul spirits he had put up for auction.
"Good to see you again, Lady Wu," Kent said, seated in a VIP room, taking a sip of the tea served to him by Lady Wu. Today is not an auction day, so she was very free.
Of course, even if there was an auction, meeting someone like Kent would be her top priority.

"It is good to see you, too, Kent." She was a little curious about why Kent returned so early. According to the schedule he set when they last parted, Kent still had about a month before he would come to see her again.
But because he completed his quest early, that schedule was thrown out the window.
"No need to be alarmed, Lady Wu," Kent said with a smile, noticing the look on her face, "I just came to bid you goodbye."
"Are you leaving?"
Kent nodded, "As much as I wish to stay, I have people waiting for me back home, so I need to leave."
"I see." A sad look appeared on her face, "And where would you be going? Will I see you again?"
The smile on Kent’s face brightened, "Of course, you will be seeing me again. Although I will be going to a faraway place, I know one day we will meet again, so don’t be sad."
She nodded...
"But before I leave, I want you to have these," Kent waved his hand, and loads of stuff appeared. Lady Wu’s eyes widened the moment she saw the items displayed before her.
"Flame crystals, lotus flame seeds, lotus flame petals, flame spirits... is that a primordial flame seed?" The shock she was in just multiplied...
Kent smiled, "Yes. These three are low-grade primordial flame seeds, and the other flame spirits are all Tier 19. The rest, you will have to take your time to go through them all.
However, you mustn’t sell them all at once. I don’t know how you are going to do it, but I believe with this much, by the time we meet again, you will become a powerhouse in the auction business."
Kent also retrieved a device used to hold soul spirits and handed it to her...
Inside it were 100 Tier 18 and 50 Tier 19 soul spirits. When Lady Wu saw this, she nearly collapsed. Kent only smiled at her and retrieved the last thing.
It was one of the beasts he had tamed. He asked this particular beast to become Lady Wu’s assistant and guard. She is a phoenix with the ability to blend in with humans.
She would be perfect for the role.
After Kent and this phoenix lady spent 10 minutes calming Lady Wu’s beating heart down, she named the phoenix Vega...
"If you have what it takes to buy the Brown Maple Auction House, do it. Later, when I am gone, more friends will come around to help you out.
They are trustworthy and people you would want around you."
"Thank you, Kent," Lady Wu said, tears falling down her face.
Kent wiped her tears and gave her his final goodbye... "When we meet again, I expect you to have a name that will even shake the hearts of immortals."
"I will, Kent," Lady Wu smiled.
Kent soon left and headed to the next place.
[Kent and Veth]
The next person Kent searched for was the lady who sold him the weapons at the Green Bridge Weapons Shop.
Naturally, Kent expected to struggle to find her, considering she had made such a sale worthy of earning the role of a manager of an entire store or even a fleet of stores.

However, he was shocked to find her still in a worker’s clothing, working in a much larger shop. They didn’t promote her; instead, they just sent her to a bigger shop where she would have to work ten times as hard.
When he saw her in the same uniform, Kent nearly destroyed the store. However, he calmed down and spoke to her first.
It was then that he found out her superior had taken credit for her sale and gotten a promotion while she was left to rot.
Kent immediately took her away to dinner and began brainstorming ways to change her future.

"How about I follow you home and become your maid? I am a good cook, I can also fight, and if you need me to warm your bed, I will, even though I am still a maiden," Veth said, desperate not to part with the man who tried to change her life.
Even the commission Kent gave her was taken by her boss. So she was desperate...
Kent smiled, hearing her childish words...
"Don’t be silly, Veth. You are a beautiful woman who deserves the whole world. So while I would love to spend a night or two with you, I wouldn’t, mainly because you are asking out of desperation.
However, I will help you become your own person. Then, when you reach the level where even immortals have to be respectful to you, we can talk about becoming my maid who would cook and warm my bed."
Veth nodded with an embarrassed expression. She was indeed desperate; however, hearing what Kent said made her even more embarrassed.
"I happen to have some connection with Two Pill Alliance. How about I build you a fancy store where you will sell pills?"
"Really?"
"Of course. And trust me, I will be building you a store that will make you a number one attraction."
"Thank you, Kent."
"Don’t mention it."
Kent asked Pill King Flura to meet him in three days’ time. Once he is done with Veth, he will go to Planet Nictus.
However, when he returns to Planet Pyris, where he would spend his last days, he would introduce Veth to Pill King Flura and Pill Monarch Nefeli.

He would also draw a good building plan and leave enough money to build her a good store. As to whether she could expand her business and even ascend to an immortal world, that would depend on her determination.
After the dinner, Kent told her to go to the Pyris Pill Pagoda and ask for Yuna. She would be taken to Pill Monarch Nefeli, where she would wait for him.

Kent later left, using a planet teleporter that took just five minutes to reach Planet Nictus. Upon arrival, he first went to see the new queen of Planet Nictus, Princess Autumn, who was previously known as Commander Agnes.
She was with General Brianna when he arrived.

Perhaps because they were too overwhelmed, they said nothing.

"WHAT?"

According to history, this star system was once home to the Divine Beast Tamer. Legend has it that during his era, every beast went there to seek guidance on how to evolve beyond their bloodline limits.

Many say just living there will raise the potential of any beast. Personally, it is not a rumor, for I have met beasts from there, and while I can beat my chest and say I am a dragon, I pale in comparison to them.
After all, they are all descendants of beasts that once followed the Divine Beast Tamer."

Kent has left us with so many pill recipes that even the Pill Worlds haven’t seen before. If we can make her become that powerful, then we can easily eradicate all those in higher positions who dare pollute this star system.
Also, those of us who still haven’t broken the 30th limit must work harder to accomplish that before ascending.
I plan for all of us to be ready to ascend in 10,000 years’ time. I know being an immortal sounds good, but we must be ready before ascending.
Lastly, we must also make Planet Nictus very powerful, and to achieve that, we must make Princess Autumn a powerful Queen, and if possible, an Empress."
Everyone nodded to her words.
Even Ignarok, the strongest of them, decided to listen to Nefeli’s arrangement.
Kent had left her in charge since she was much more experienced.
After they finished planning, they started work.
The first five years after Kent left, the Dream Pill Store was established, and only Legendary Pills were sold there.
Ten years after he was gone, the Dream Pill Store had opened more branches in all Pill Worlds.

Also, Planet Nictus became a powerful world after the other worlds, once under the control of the Planet King, decided to swear their allegiance to Queen Autumn, who three years later became Empress Autumn.
A hundred years later, Lady Wu bought the Brown Maple Auction House.
A thousand years after she bought the auction house, she finally acquired all the shares from all the shareholders, making her the sole owner.
Five thousand years later, Planet Nictus now had over 50 worlds under it, making Empress Autumn the strongest person in the star system.
Within those five thousand years, the evil sect had been eradicated thanks to the chilling efforts of Ignarok and Nefeli.
Also, within that same five thousand years, Nefeli became a Pill Legend, and even Flura reached the Pill Sovereign stage.
They later spent another 5,000 years cementing their foundation before they ascended.
Every last beast went to the Beasts Kingdom, while the Humans and Elves went to Salem. However, every ten thousand years, Empress Autumn returns to Planet Nictus to ensure her legacy still stands.
Of course, she knew nobody would dare touch her empire; however, as an excuse, she did this simply because she believed one day, Kent would come back, and she wanted to be around to welcome him.

sentences.text: "Sounds Serious," Kent said, hearing what Ignarok said about the Beasts Kingdom.
"Very serious.
The Beasts Kingdom is not a place just any beast can go to.
I learned that the weakest beasts there are all divine beasts with so much potential.

And as beasts straight from beasts that once followed the Divine Beast Tamer, you can only imagine the kind of monsters they are." Ignarok is happy, and the other six monarchs, including Sylvara, are also happy.
This made Kent sigh with happiness as well.
He knew that, with their positive attitude today, they would like their new home—the Beasts Kingdom—and thrive there.
"How about Salem?
Does anyone have any idea what that star system is like?"
Zeraphine nodded, "I only heard of it once at an auction.
But apparently, it is a star system dominated by Humans, Elves, and Dwarves.
It is one of the strongest star systems, housing powerful immortal worlds.
That is all I know."
"Thank you, Zeraphine." Kent turns and looks at Nefeli...

She nodded.

However, be sure to keep in touch with each other to know how life is treating each other."
They nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1063: Destiny Calling
paragraphs: BOOM

The moment Kent came out of the Pill World, a powerful aura exploded out of him. This aura contained both the flame and blood aura, a clear sign of all that had changed in him during his stay in the past.
Kent sat down and closed his eyes, letting his body adapt to the new changes.
Meanwhile, Akira, Dori, and Gaia appeared in the Alchemy Tower the moment they sensed Kent’s presence.
They woke up a month ago while Kent was still in seclusion.
They missed their master and big brother so much that they couldn’t wait to talk to him again. However, since he was currently busy, they could only wait.
"I wonder what changes have happened to master," Dori said, already craving to merge back into Kent’s mind and read all his memories. She was the mind weaver, so she wanted to know.
"I know his soul strength is already at Tier 16. However, his soul universe has already reached Tier 2. It seems he had formed more bonds with High Worlds in the past," Akira also said.
"How many are we talking?" Gaia asked. She is connected to the tower (System), so she focuses on interacting with the cosmos to make her master’s life easier.
Akira and Dori are the ones more connected to him on a personal level...

"I can’t tell for sure, but there are over 100 High Worlds connected to his soul universe. It seems he added one or maybe six worlds to his soul universe, and these worlds formed bonds with other worlds, creating a chain."
"That is good then. Looks like master didn’t waste his time in the past," Gaia said, her expression containing pride and happiness.
She was the one who built the chamber that allowed him to go to the past, so hearing Kent had gained so much from it made her extremely happy.
"Master has also formed a blood core gate, a flame core, 135,000 flame veins, 5,000 blood runes, and even refined a blood death and life seal. The current master is extremely strong."
Just when the three lolis were getting more into what had changed in Kent, a portal suddenly opened inside the Alchemy Tower, causing them to narrow their eyes.
At the same time, Kent also opened his eyes.
"What is happening?" Kent asked, but the three lolis didn’t hear him. They were more focused on the portal
However, a beep inside his mind gave him the answer to his question.
⟦Your Destiny Key Has Activated. Destination: Earth-616. Duration: 1 Day⟧
[The energy coming from this portal is not of this universe.] Gaia, the cosmic weaver, was able to pinpoint the anomaly from a mere glance.
"That is true. It is because this portal leads to a different universe, and I think I know where."
[Master,] the three lolis jumped on him, sending Kent falling on his back.
"How are you three?"

[We are fine, master. We missed you so much... When we woke up, you were in seclusion, so we missed you very much,] Akira said, planting her face in Kent’s chest as she smiled and breathed a sigh of relief.
"I missed you, too. Now that you are awake, I am extremely happy..."
[We too,] Gaia said.
But then she pointed at the gate. As a cosmic weaver, sensing a different energy from another universe alarmed her.
One day, when Kent is strong enough, she will be in charge of identifying all universes that pose a threat to this one and, if possible, help eradicate them.
That is her main job.
[Big brother, you said you know where that portal leads... Can you tell me where?]
"I have only met him twice, but it seems this portal leads to a universe that has a paragon."
[A paragon, as in someone who doesn’t respect the heavens and their laws?] Gaia said, and Kent nodded.
"He helped me a few times. He was even the one who gave me the Soul Universe. So I have to go and handle whatever is required of me there."
[We understand, master. However, know that aside from the tower, we cannot go with you. You can’t also summon your legion or any weapon the moment you cross over.]
"I’d better place my weapons and everything of importance into my soul universe." The three lolis nodded in agreement with Kent’s words.
Gaia waved her hand, and a talisman appeared...

[Lady Alina told us to give this to you. It is a Tier 14 talisman called Second Chance. According to her, it gives a second chance to whoever uses it. She thinks since you are always taking risks, you should have it.]
Kent received the talisman and smiled... "Where are they?"

[Your wives are currently on the way to Celestial Gate Planet, where the interplanetary Sect competition will be happening. Something about going to support their new sisters, whose disciples will be participating in.
As for the legion, they are still on the 4th level of the Planet Killer Dungeon, exploring the Church of Destruction.]
"I see."
[Yes. And the glass lady left a message as well. She said you should hurry and come... The competition starts in a little over a day, and your name is on the list.
Also, you should know Lady Yi Lai has received a new dragon undead. That lady sent down to the world of undead dragons succeeded in getting a second chance at life.]
"Good thing I will be staying in this new universe for just one day. And tell them I will come back as soon as I return from this new universe."
[Okay, master. Be sure to bring some souvenirs from this new universe. I want to learn more about them, and the fastest and easiest way is to examine some things from there.]
"I will. Also, if it is anything like the Earth I came from, then I might even return with ice cream and pizza."
[Master is the best.]
The three lolis started jumping up and down, showing how happy they were...
Kent ignored them, went to the tower shop, and started buying weapons for this new trip. He didn’t need to be told this trip wasn’t an invitation to a wedding.
He could tell he was about to jump into yet another battle, so he started to prepare.
He might be strong in his universe, but this was a new one, and if there was any indication of what to expect, meeting Paragon twice was all he needed to know.
"You three can go watch this competition in case I am not back early, and it is starting."
[Okay, master.]

Kent walked toward the portal but stopped and opened the tower shop, buying one last item. A second later, a mask appeared in his palm, and then he placed it inside his soul universe as he changed into his battle wear.
A flaming ring, about a meter in diameter, appeared behind him. The ring had nodes for nine flame cores. But at the moment, only one node had a green core.
However, the ring quickly formed into three pairs of flame-feathered wings.
’Tower, initial recording mode. I want everything captured.’
⟦Recording Mode Activated⟧
Kent nodded, then stepped into the portal and vanished the next second.
The portal also vanished.

Meanwhile, on a certain battlefield, a Life Stage warrior timed and perfectly executed a move, one that caught a certain redheaded beauty whose blood aura was enough to suffocate Domain Stage warriors.
Her other two teammates tried to come to her rescue; however, they were blocked, leaving her life in danger.
However, just when the sword could pierce her neck, a dragon-clawed hand burst from the void and grabbed and snapped it in half...
...a voice that spread all over Earth followed.
"Ladies and gentlemen, the Chaos Dragon has arrived."

chapters.title: Chapter 1064: Kent In Another Universe
paragraphs: The first person Kent saw was a redhead beauty, whose eyes contained so much killing intent he nearly called her Nefeli. After all, that kind of killing intent, he only felt it from Pill Monarch Nefeli.
However, instead of confronting her, he snapped the sword that came at her, and a sword shot from his Soul Universe, drilling a hole through the swordsman’s head.
"Endless Sword Arc Domain."
He then activated one of Jest’s skills, pushing away the dozens of warriors surrounding the redhead (Queenie). It was only then that Kent’s full body appeared.
His hand reverted to human form.
The battle inside the dome came to a halt when Kent stepped out.
The redhead’s two teammates appeared beside Queenie, each facing Kent with their backs, making sure nobody sneaked up on them.
"Who are you?" Queenie asked, looking at Kent with a suspicious gaze.
Kent smiled and flicked his hair. "You can call me Chaos... a friend of the Paragon... well, more like his tutor, considering he mostly comes to me for tutoring. But don’t tell him that."
Kent turned toward Klaus and waved...
Klaus had no time to wave back; however, he sent a message to Queenie, which made the Asura lady narrow her eyes at Kent.
"No need to be alarmed. I am just here to aid my bro, so point me toward a battlefield, and I will see to it that all enemies are dead."

Queenie didn’t hesitate and pointed toward the new red crack that appeared in the air. "Go help them handle it, and please, if you dare backstab anyone, trust me; death will be the last thing you will have to worry about."
"Ooohhh, a feisty one I see. No wonder my bro was always in a hurry to leave whenever he came to visit." Kent giggled, and then he turned toward the three masked figures.
Queenie had already killed one of them.
"Cool mask... too bad you three are on the bad guards’ side."
Kent opened the soul map and teleported behind the three. Then, with a quick swing of his hand, their heads flew into the air.
His gaze then met King Archon. However, something told him not to kill the King. Kent then turned and counted 420 Life-stage warriors.
He then turns his focus to Queenie and the two ladies.
"Let’s level the playing field, then." A talisman appeared in Kent’s hands. He channeled his energy into it, and a formation appeared in the air.
In an instant, all 430 life-stage warriors felt their cultivation base drop by a realm.
"That will do it." Kent smiled and winked at Queenie. "Don’t thank me; it is just that I am that awesome. However, you have 30 minutes before they return to their full strength."
With that, Kent vanished from the dome and appeared on a small mountain just a few km away from the new battlefield where Uncle Ziggy and the others had just clashed with the new arrivals.
Kent first chatted with the tower...
’So in this universe, my current cultivation base is at the Chaos stage. However, some cultivation realms seem to be missing in this universe.
So the Domain stage in this universe is comparable to Spirit Sovereign in mine, and the Life stage is Spirit Lord.
This means the Death stage will be Heavenly Ascension.’
⟦That is right, master. The cultivation stages in this world are weird and, in a way, very dangerous.⟧
"No kidding, tower." Kent turned and watched where Klaus was fighting, and he could feel his blood boil.
’If I am not mistaken, that lady will be comparable to an Empyrean stage warrior in our universe.’
⟦Yes. In this world, she is at the Monarch stage.⟧
’And what cultivation rank is the Paragon?’
⟦Same as you, master... He is at the Chaos stage.⟧
’I see. In that case, why don’t I clear the battlefield fast?’

⟦The master should really do that. I can sense great danger coming from this portal. It is like somebody really wants this world gone, and they will stop at nothing to achieve it... or until he is dead.⟧
"Good thing I am here." Kent sighed, watching how Klaus parried Loff’s attack and then, with a powerful kick, sent her flying.
"He is worried."
⟦Yes. However, I will do my very best to ensure you are safe.⟧
Kent nodded, but he couldn’t help sensing something strange... "Tower, are you sacking me so you can do something on your own?"
This was the first time Kent sensed such a feeling from the tower. It was like she was hiding something...
"Spill it."

⟦Master is perceptive as ever. I am indeed hiding something... I sense another intelligent life coming from that man, and I want to see if we can work together to ensure the world is saved in the end.⟧
"So you want to make a friend, huh. Good for you, tower..."
Gaap appeared in Kent’s hand, and a mask covered his face.
"Good luck, tower." Kent moved again and appeared on the battlefield. His sword met that of a Life-stage warrior—a human with a pair of horns on his forehead.
Kent kicked with his right leg and pivoted with his left hand, grabbing the Life-stage warrior by the neck. This combo left the warrior disoriented.
This allowed Kent to use the Soul Torture on him.
"A Nethran, huh." Kent snapped his neck and threw him away. Then he looked toward the portal, watching as Death-stage warriors started to appear.
"Heavenly Ascensions in this universe are no joke. However, maybe because these people are a wandering race facing countless dangers in their travels, they are also much more dangerous than others."
Kent didn’t want to ponder on it much, so he teleported and appeared a meter from the Death-stage warriors.
"I don’t know the dynamics of this universe, but from what I read from your pal, you guys aren’t supposed to be here... at least not right now."
"Kill him!"
A Death-stage warrior with a larger horn gave the command, and Kent was surrounded.
"Not a race of talkers, huh..." Kent raised his sword, and in an instant, an intense Profound Blood Sword aura surrounded it.
The advancing Death-stage warriors came to a halt when they sensed the danger.
"Too late. Gaap, let’s reap blood."
[Gladly.]
Kent’s move activated 60,000 flame veins and 2,000 blood runes. In an instant, a terrifying pressure descended on everyone.
"Flame Sea!"
The 2 km radius instantly turned into a sea of flame, causing the Nethrans to feel their energy drain. Kent didn’t bat an eye and began his slaughter.
This was a good time for him to farm blood essence for his second blood core gate. So, having nearly an entire battlefield to himself, he started to reap blood.
As Kent was busy reaping blood, he heard someone issue a command.
"Uncles, Anna, why don’t you leave this place to me? You can go handle the Neburians," Sofia ordered, and Klaus’s uncles nodded.
The moment they pulled back, Sofia turned into a dragon and roared to life.
"That’s more like it," Kent smiled, knowing what Sofia was trying to tell him.
He paused and formed a hand seal. In an instant, the entire battlefield turned into a sea of flame.
"Handle the Death-stage warriors; I will take care of the rest," Sofia said, and Kent nodded. The two dragons started to slaughter, leaving charred bodies in their wake.
