"You can call me Chaos... a friend of the Paragon... well, more like his tutor, considering he mostly comes to me for tutoring.
But don’t tell him that."
Kent turned toward Klaus and waved...
Klaus had no time to wave back; however, he sent a message to Queenie, which made the Asura lady narrow her eyes at Kent.
"No need to be alarmed.
I am just here to aid my bro, so point me toward a battlefield, and I will see to it that all enemies are dead."
Queenie didn’t hesitate and pointed toward the new red crack that appeared in the air.
"Go help them handle it, and please, if you dare backstab anyone, trust me; death will be the last thing you will have to worry about."
"Ooohhh, a feisty one I see.
No wonder my bro was always in a hurry to leave whenever he came to visit." Kent giggled, and then he turned toward the three masked figures.
Queenie had already killed one of them.
"Cool mask... too bad you three are on the bad guards’ side."
Kent opened the soul map and teleported behind the three.
Then, with a quick swing of his hand, their heads flew into the air.
His gaze then met King Archon.
However, something told him not to kill the King.
Kent then turned and counted 420 Life-stage warriors.
He then turns his focus to Queenie and the two ladies.
"Let’s level the playing field, then." A talisman appeared in Kent’s hands.
He channeled his energy into it, and a formation appeared in the air.
In an instant, all 430 life-stage warriors felt their cultivation base drop by a realm.
"That will do it." Kent smiled and winked at Queenie.
"Don’t thank me; it is just that I am that awesome.
However, you have 30 minutes before they return to their full strength."
With that, Kent vanished from the dome and appeared on a small mountain just a few km away from the new battlefield where Uncle Ziggy and the others had just clashed with the new arrivals.
Kent first chatted with the tower...
’So in this universe, my current cultivation base is at the Chaos stage.
However, some cultivation realms seem to be missing in this universe.
So the Domain stage in this universe is comparable to Spirit Sovereign in mine, and the Life stage is Spirit Lord.
This means the Death stage will be Heavenly Ascension.’
⟦That is right, master.
The cultivation stages in this world are weird and, in a way, very dangerous.⟧
"No kidding, tower." Kent turned and watched where Klaus was fighting, and he could feel his blood boil.
’If I am not mistaken, that lady will be comparable to an Empyrean stage warrior in our universe.’
⟦Yes.
In this world, she is at the Monarch stage.⟧
’And what cultivation rank is the Paragon?’
⟦Same as you, master...
He is at the Chaos stage.⟧
’I see.
In that case, why don’t I clear the battlefield fast?’
⟦The master should really do that.
I can sense great danger coming from this portal.
It is like somebody really wants this world gone, and they will stop at nothing to achieve it... or until he is dead.⟧
"Good thing I am here." Kent sighed, watching how Klaus parried Loff’s attack and then, with a powerful kick, sent her flying.
"He is worried."
⟦Yes.
However, I will do my very best to ensure you are safe.⟧
Kent nodded, but he couldn’t help sensing something strange...
"Tower, are you sacking me so you can do something on your own?"
This was the first time Kent sensed such a feeling from the tower.
It was like she was hiding something...
"Spill it."
⟦Master is perceptive as ever.
I am indeed hiding something...
I sense another intelligent life coming from that man, and I want to see if we can work together to ensure the world is saved in the end.⟧
"So you want to make a friend, huh.
Good for you, tower..."
Gaap appeared in Kent’s hand, and a mask covered his face.
"Good luck, tower." Kent moved again and appeared on the battlefield.
His sword met that of a Life-stage warrior—a human with a pair of horns on his forehead.
Kent kicked with his right leg and pivoted with his left hand, grabbing the Life-stage warrior by the neck.
This combo left the warrior disoriented.
This allowed Kent to use the Soul Torture on him.
"A Nethran, huh." Kent snapped his neck and threw him away.
Then he looked toward the portal, watching as Death-stage warriors started to appear.
"Heavenly Ascensions in this universe are no joke.
However, maybe because these people are a wandering race facing countless dangers in their travels, they are also much more dangerous than others."
Kent didn’t want to ponder on it much, so he teleported and appeared a meter from the Death-stage warriors.
"I don’t know the dynamics of this universe, but from what I read from your pal, you guys aren’t supposed to be here... at least not right now."
"Kill him!"
A Death-stage warrior with a larger horn gave the command, and Kent was surrounded.
"Not a race of talkers, huh..." Kent raised his sword, and in an instant, an intense Profound Blood Sword aura surrounded it.
The advancing Death-stage warriors came to a halt when they sensed the danger.
"Too late.
Gaap, let’s reap blood."
[Gladly.]
Kent’s move activated 60,000 flame veins and 2,000 blood runes.
In an instant, a terrifying pressure descended on everyone.
"Flame Sea!"
The 2 km radius instantly turned into a sea of flame, causing the Nethrans to feel their energy drain.
Kent didn’t bat an eye and began his slaughter.
This was a good time for him to farm blood essence for his second blood core gate.
So, having nearly an entire battlefield to himself, he started to reap blood.
As Kent was busy reaping blood, he heard someone issue a command.
"Uncles, Anna, why don’t you leave this place to me?
You can go handle the Neburians," Sofia ordered, and Klaus’s uncles nodded.
The moment they pulled back, Sofia turned into a dragon and roared to life.
"That’s more like it," Kent smiled, knowing what Sofia was trying to tell him.
He paused and formed a hand seal.
In an instant, the entire battlefield turned into a sea of flame.
"Handle the Death-stage warriors; I will take care of the rest," Sofia said, and Kent nodded.
The two dragons started to slaughter, leaving charred bodies in their wake.

chapters.title: Chapter 1065: First True Challenge
paragraphs: (A/N: Before you start reading, take note of these differences in cultivation stages. The first is the cultivation stages in the universe Kent traveled to, and its equivalent is after the equal sign.
Domain stage = Spirit Sovereign, Life stage = Spirit Lord, Death stage = Heavenly Ascension, Monarch = Empyrean, Nirvana = Life Law, Core Formation = Death Law)
Kent’s sword went through the neck of a Nethran warrior, ending his pitiful life. Then, with a movement so blinding, Kent appeared behind another and killed them too.
The speed he was moving at, only the Death stage warriors could track him.
However, despite seeing him move and being able to track him with their eyes, they just can’t mount a defense fast enough to block his attacks.
It felt like they saw him—they saw his sword move—but when they raised their defenses to block him, it was already too late...
Of course, Kent was only using 60,000 flame veins this time.
The Death stage warriors in this universe are like Heavenly Ascension stage warriors in his universe. However, Kent couldn’t help noticing something.
The Death stage warriors he is clashing with are much stronger than those in his universe. At first, he thought it was because of the two missing cultivation bases that this new universe didn’t have.
However, as he started defending against the attacks from the Life and Death stage warriors, he sensed something else. The spiritual energy in this universe is much denser.
This means that, naturally, all attacks will hold more weight than in his universe, or at least high and medium worlds in his universe.
Kent is already aware of the world dynamics in his universe.
If a Core Formation expert from an immortal world were to arrive in a high world, the chances of a Core Formation warrior in a high world defeating them are very low.
This is due to the difference in spiritual qi in the two worlds. So, feeling their attacks now, he can only tell that this universe has more monsters.
’I have never been to an immortal world in my universe, but based on the difference I am feeling now, I can say this world is comparable to an immortal world in my universe.’
Kent parried an attack, and then his left hand moved, cutting the throat of a Nethran Life Stage warrior with a dagger.

’What a crazy universe... No wonder it has a paragon... the entire universe is a mess. There is no organization to anything; even the cultivation realms are a mess, and on top of all that, breaking the rules is something simple here.’
"Doom Shards"

Obsidian shards burst out from the ground, and thousands of warriors were caught off guard. Some defended, sustaining minor injuries, while some were just too late to react, the shards becoming their death.
The only upside to Kent’s overwhelming strength is that he feels his core drain less thanks to the spiritual energy in this universe.
Kent pivoted on his heels and then, using his left hand, he grabbed a Domain stage warrior by the neck and threw him at a Life stage warrior.
"Annihilation Strike"

Kent swung his sword, sending out a red sword arc that cut through the Nethran Domain stage warrior and a few others. The Life stage warrior lost his left hand, and so he moved back. However, a doom shard burst out of the ground and stabbed him through the head.
’I will be sure to advise Paragon to fix the cultivation realms in his universe once he defeats the heavens. The mess is just too dangerous if one doesn’t take care.
Also, something about this Nethran race smells fishy. It is like they don’t care if their people die or not... This is not a good feeling, especially coming from me.’
Just when Kent ended his thought, he sensed a powerful presence appear on the battlefield.
’An Empyrean in my universe, but a Monarch here,’ Kent looked toward the Dragon and the Phoenix, and he could tell they were doing well.
’I guess I’d better see how long it will take me to handle this one.’ Kent locked his gaze on the new arrival, causing the lady to turn in his direction.
Kent smiled, "Since you came, why don’t you stay?"
With a speed so blinding, he moved and clashed with the lady. Kent didn’t make any adjustments to his stats, so he merely clashed with her.
However, the moment their swords met, he sensed it.
’Stronger, faster, and deadlier.’
Kent immediately increased his flame veins to 100,000 and blood runes to 4,000, while his bloodline was immediately activated to 10%.
They clashed again, but neither was pushed back. However, Kent immediately saw it—the new lady wasn’t taking him seriously.
This, in a way, enraged him. He immediately unleashed two deadly attacks, forcing the lady to see she was about to have a world of pain.
"Soul Universe Art - Meteor Shower"
"Void Fracture"
The sky turned dark, and red meteors, about the size of a car, rained down. At the same time, the void cracked, and sword arcs started raining down.
"Domain." Echo, the dual-bladed swordswoman who came to clear the path for her team, unleashed her domain, instantly changing their surroundings.
Kent immediately found himself in a valley where, on the ground, thousands of swords were stabbed into the earth.
[Activate the Blood Death Seal,] Gaap said the moment they appeared in the domain. Kent obeyed because he, too, could sense the danger he had landed himself in.
The meteor shower and the sword arcs were neutralized by the domain, causing Kent to see something that could have cost him if he had unleashed an asteroid.
’Domains ride on a different law, so if I had used the asteroid, even if I managed to land a blow, the majority of the damage would have been absorbed.
This is an eye-opener.’
Suddenly, the swords in the domain started to fly from the ground. Echo, who appeared and was hovering in the air, pointed her sword at Kent, and the swords in the air lunged at him.
"Flame Wheel."
Still using just 100,000 flame veins, Kent moved, and his speed exploded, allowing him to evade the swords and even close in on Echo. However, the lady saw him move and reacted.
’Looks like Monarchs are no joke.’ Kent smiled and then unleashed his entire bloodline; however, he held back on the flame veins and the blood runes.
Instead, he decided to use something he never knew he needed at the moment.
"Finger of Destruction."
Kent channeled his flame core and pointed forward. In an instant, the domain shuddered, and a flaming finger appeared in the air.
Echo frowned and waved her hand, causing thousands of swords to form into a dragon’s head and move toward the finger. However, just when they were about to meet, Kent smiled and formed a hand seal.
He clenched his fist, causing the finger to explode. The domain cracked and shattered...
"NO!"
Echo coughed blood, but then she saw Kent move behind her and attack. However, if killing a Monarch were that easy, the Paragon wouldn’t have been holding back one for the past seven minutes.
Echo raised her sword and blocked Kent’s attack. However, Kent was no simple warrior either. His left clawed hand moved and landed an attack on her chest, sending her tumbling back...

chapters.title: Chapter 1066: Chilling Gaze
paragraphs: Kent unleashed a sword arc, but Echo blocked it with her sword before her eyes changed color. Suddenly, a colossal sword appeared in the air and shot toward Kent.
The chaos dragon sensed a dangerous feeling coming from the sword. However, he was prepared to retaliate.
However, before the attack could get close to him, a colossal ship blasted through it and entered the crack leading to the planet the Nethrans were coming from.
Echo’s expression changed. She moved, aiming to retreat, but Kent used the soul map to teleport and block her path.
"MOVE!"
Echo’s angered voice filled the battlefield; however, Kent just smiled.
"Move me if you can."
Just when he said that, a powerful explosive shockwave came out of the red portal, sending all those fighting close to it flying.
"NOOOOO!"
Echo’s painful cry sent a chill through thousands of warriors from either side of the battlefield. Kent, who was also pushed back, turned and looked in the direction Paragon was fighting.
What he saw sent a chill down his spine.
’Damn... he is both handsome, dangerous, and evil.’
That was the feeling he got when he saw Paragon holding the head of the Monarch he was fighting by the hair, her legs and arms chopped off.
It was as if he were telling the lady to look at what he had just done to the Nethrans and that he would do the same thing to her.

’Would I be able to do something this chilling, too? Am I capable of doing something like this?’ Kent asked himself, but he just couldn’t see himself bombing an entire world, killing both warriors and civilians alike.
Looking into Paragon’s cold gaze, devoid of emotion, he felt both fear and sympathy toward him. Kent could feel it somehow.
He didn’t know how, but he could feel and understand how the redhead holding the lady by the hair was feeling.

Paragon wasn’t in the right mindset, mainly because at the moment, he wasn’t fighting as a human with lovers in his life; he was fighting as a Paragon, someone who hated the heavens and everything they stood for.
That made him dangerous, and as someone who had seen danger, Kent could tell this could go either way. However, he knew he, too, could only do his best to ensure that the bad didn’t happen.
"I will kill you!" Echo, who also knew where the attack came from, tried to lunge toward a lady standing not far from the Paragon.
"Maybe try killing me first." Kent blocked her again, and this time, he went all out, activating everything. This time, all his attacks started pushing Echo back.
Kent landed a powerful kick, sending Echo flying back. He then used the soul map to move back, distancing himself 8 km from her.
Then, tapping into the second form of the Annihilation Sword Technique, he unleashed an attack.
"Void Cleave!"
A five-meter-wide red sword arc flashed out and sped toward Echo, who immediately sensed danger and tried to retreat. However, Kent didn’t allow her.
A meteor fell from the sky and locked her down.
This time, because her domain failed to hold Kent, she didn’t try to use it again. Instead, she raised her left sword, and another large sword appeared.
She slashed down, and the sword sped forward to meet the Void Cleave, while her right sword controlled thousands of swords to obliterate the meteor.
’She fell for it.’
The soul flag appeared, and four soul spirits came out and teleported beside Echo.
"Soul Explosion!"
BOOOOOOM!

A powerful explosion rocked the battlefield, sending Echo flying back. The shockwave reduced some warriors closer to the explosion to dust, while thousands were either knocked unconscious or hurt beyond healing.
The battered and bruised Echo slammed into a tall mountain 30 km away. Kent used the soul map to teleport and appear beside her, stabbing his sword toward her chest.

However, the moment his hand moved, Kent sensed a powerful attack coming at him. He teleported away, aiming to save his life first instead of risking it to kill. However, just when he teleported away, he still felt the danger.
Using the soul map, he saw a different Monarch—a yellow-haired archer—shoot an arrow at him. The arrow, even after he evaded, still followed him, causing Kent to distance himself further from Echo.
He started teleporting at random, but the arrow kept coming at him.
’Damn, is this arrow a heatseeker?’

That was the only explanation. Kent, of course, also knew there might be other reasons for how weird this arrow was behaving. But for now, he could only keep teleporting while looking for a way to defend.
"Void Piercer Bolt." Suddenly, just when Kent teleported away from the heatseeker arrow, another arrow appeared before him and exploded, sending him flying several kilometers away.
’He is good. I never saw that coming.’
Kent saw through the soul map that seven people had come through the red crack after the explosion. He could only assume that he had reduced the rest of the Nethran warriors to ash.
However, he had no time to focus on them since another arrow arrived before him.
This time, Kent teleported and moved 1,000 km away, taking his battle further away from everyone now that he was being targeted by two Monarchs.
’Should I use it now?’ Kent wondered. He wasn’t afraid of the two Monarchs. If anything, he welcomed the challenge. However, his worry was more toward Paragon and his people.
The Paragon had just killed the lady, but when he could have had some breathing space, seven more appeared, and from the look of things, one of the seven was even stronger than the Monarchs.
This already told him what he needed to know, and, taking a second to observe, he saw the battle was about to get dirty.
’Paragon is okay. He can handle two, maybe even three. However, if all seven were Monarchs, his teammates could have handled them.
But there is a Nirvana (Life stage in Kent’s universe) stage warrior now in the mix, meaning Paragon would have to focus on him, leaving six Monarchs.
Even if the strongest on Paragon’s side were to team up on them, there are still millions of enemy warriors left for the weaker army to handle.’
Kent blocked Echo’s sword attack, but he was forced to teleport back when an arrow came at him from the side. Kent couldn’t counterattack, but he bought himself another second to observe some more.
’The three ladies inside the dome are almost done. That is good. With them filling in for the people now facing the Monarchs, the death toll will be reduced somehow.’
Kent’s focus was pulled back when he felt another heatseeker arrow lock on him. However, this time he had a counter.
He waved his hand, and the void cracked, swallowing the arrow. Up ahead, a new crack appeared, and the arrow shot toward the archer, who was now forced to defend against his own arrow.
Kent used the chance to unleash an attack on Echo.
His left hand grew claws, and with one powerful swing, four red claw arcs flashed out and slammed into Echo’s chest, sending her flying down.
Kent observed one last time, but what he saw caused his blood to run cold.
Up ahead in the other crack, just as Paragon and his teammates started to hold back the six Monarchs and the one Nirvana warrior, another Nirvana warrior—an angel—emerged from the golden portal.
A talisman appeared in his hand, and he was about to clench it when something strange started to happen...

’He is good.
I never saw that coming.’
Kent saw through the soul map that seven people had come through the red crack after the explosion.
He could only assume that he had reduced the rest of the Nethran warriors to ash.
However, he had no time to focus on them since another arrow arrived before him.
This time, Kent teleported and moved 1,000 km away, taking his battle further away from everyone now that he was being targeted by two Monarchs.
’Should I use it now?’ Kent wondered.
He wasn’t afraid of the two Monarchs.
If anything, he welcomed the challenge.
However, his worry was more toward Paragon and his people.
The Paragon had just killed the lady, but when he could have had some breathing space, seven more appeared, and from the look of things, one of the seven was even stronger than the Monarchs.
This already told him what he needed to know, and, taking a second to observe, he saw the battle was about to get dirty.
’Paragon is okay.
He can handle two, maybe even three.
However, if all seven were Monarchs, his teammates could have handled them.
But there is a Nirvana (Life stage in Kent’s universe) stage warrior now in the mix, meaning Paragon would have to focus on him, leaving six Monarchs.
Even if the strongest on Paragon’s side were to team up on them, there are still millions of enemy warriors left for the weaker army to handle.’
Kent blocked Echo’s sword attack, but he was forced to teleport back when an arrow came at him from the side.
Kent couldn’t counterattack, but he bought himself another second to observe some more.
’The three ladies inside the dome are almost done.
That is good.
With them filling in for the people now facing the Monarchs, the death toll will be reduced somehow.’
Kent’s focus was pulled back when he felt another heatseeker arrow lock on him.
However, this time he had a counter.
He waved his hand, and the void cracked, swallowing the arrow.
Up ahead, a new crack appeared, and the arrow shot toward the archer, who was now forced to defend against his own arrow.
Kent used the chance to unleash an attack on Echo.
His left hand grew claws, and with one powerful swing, four red claw arcs flashed out and slammed into Echo’s chest, sending her flying down.
Kent observed one last time, but what he saw caused his blood to run cold.
Up ahead in the other crack, just as Paragon and his teammates started to hold back the six Monarchs and the one Nirvana warrior, another Nirvana warrior—an angel—emerged from the golden portal.
A talisman appeared in his hand, and he was about to clench it when something strange started to happen...

chapters.title: Chapter 1067: Out Of His League
paragraphs: All over the battlefield, smaller red portals began opening, and from within, feathered warriors — most Life stage, a few dozen Death stage, and about 16 Monarchs — appeared.
’What the hell is happening?’ Kent shouted in his head, stomping on Echo’s leg. The leg broke, but Kent didn’t retaliate; instead, he focused on the portals that kept appearing.
In no time, over a hundred Angels appeared, each wielding a divine sword, and more keep coming.

Then, when the last of them appeared, or perhaps that is what they want him to think, another portal opened, and this time, a white-haired angel woman —a Nirvana-stage warrior —stepped out, looking coldly at Paragon.
⟦Master, I know what is happening.⟧ Suddenly, the tower spoke, causing Kent to return his focus to her.
⟦According to Icon, she is the other intelligent life form I was talking about. According to her, what is happening is called world awakening.
This world is going through a phase to awaken its true self. However, for that to happen, another world must challenge it.
Initially, they were fighting against only a world known as Nebu. However, it now seems that other worlds not included in the awakening are starting to appear.
But that isn’t the most chilling part. According to Icon, they want his master dead, and until he dies, the heavens will never stop coming.
Master, you must help them.⟧
’No kidding, Icon, I am doing my part. However, they aren’t allowing me to get close. It is like they are purposely holding me back for some reason.’
⟦That is because you are the only one, aside from the Paragon, that can face a Nirvana (Life stage in his universe) stage warrior. Now, there are three of them, meaning everyone is in danger.⟧
Kent knew what the tower said was true, but whenever he teleported closer to land a killing blow, the annoying archer always found a way to evade.
’Do you have any suggestions?’

⟦As a matter of fact, I do... why don’t you unleash the soul spirits and explode them all over the various battlefields? Icon said that if you can find a way, she has a way to ensure her side isn’t caught in the explosions.⟧
’I see. I guess it’s time for some fireworks.’
Kent paused, retrieved the soul flag, and waved it, unleashing over 300 soul spirits. In an instant, 100 each teleported to three separate battlefields.
Then, in a way Kent never saw coming, all Earth Warriors vanished into thin air. Even the dead bodies vanished from sight, allowing him to explode the soul spirits.
"Soul Explosion!"
BOOOOOOOM
BOOOOOOOM
BOOOOOOOM
In an instant, the planet shook violently when the explosions rocked the three battlefields.
"NOOOO!"
Echo, who saw the last of the Nethran warriors reduced to ash, cried. She burned her life force and infused it into her sword, activating a powerful technique.
The archer also drew his bow, and a life-threatening arrow locked on Kent.
This action caused them to remain stationary for a moment.
Kent didn’t allow them to shoot those arrows or unleash the sword attack. He waved the flag again, and thirty soul spirits surrounded them.
BOOOM
Another explosion so violent rocked the battlefield, and this time, Echo lost her left arm, and the archer lost his bow and was severely injured, too.
Kent didn’t allow her to recover, so he appeared before Echo, and this time, with a powerful swing of his sword, the first Monarch he was facing (Empyrean in his universe) died.
But Kent didn’t stop there; he moved close to the second target and slammed his clawed hand through his chest, taking out his heart.
⟦Master, the Nirvana warrior is going for the ladies inside the dome.⟧
Kent looked up and saw the angel lady moving toward the dome. The angel man was also moving toward Paragon, who was already locked in with the Nirvana from the Nethran race.
It was between saving Paragon and the three ladies.
’Ladies before bros,’ Kent grinned and teleported, blocking the angel lady’s path.
"I can’t allow you to get close, lady..."
"I am Atria, and I command you to step out of the way. This is official business from the Heavenly Court. You do not want to provoke the wrath of the Heavenly Court."
Kent smirked, "I am Chaos, and I don’t give a fuck who your daddy is."
Kent teleported and appeared before the lady, stabbing his sword. However, the lady flapped her white wings, sending Kent flying back.
⟦She is strong, Master. If this were our universe, she would be only two steps away from becoming an immortal.⟧
’I know, Tower. However, I can take her.’
⟦Well...I don’t know about that⟧
Kent smiled but ignored the tower and moved again, this time with so much power. He clashed with Atria, who was pushed back a step.
She swung her leg and landed a kick on Kent. However, her sword moved behind her, taking on another attack when Kent swapped with a clone body just as the kick was landing on him.
After she managed to defend against the sneak attack, another attack came from in front of her, forcing her to pivot and block with her sword, only for another attack to come from behind her.
"Enough!"

A powerful aura exploded from her body, sending Kent flying back. However, the next second, Kent was upon her again. This time, the void cracked in many places and started raining down attacks on her...
"Domain!" Atria unleashed her domain, but Kent countered.
"Rule Breaker!"
The domain was canceled, and the shock that appeared on Atria’s face said it all.
"We have 24 hours before you can use it again... That is a lot of time for me to kill you."
"Invincible Body!" Kent activated another skill and lunged at Atria, who started to see Kent as a danger now.
She tried to dodge an attack aimed at her, but at the last second, it shifted to her ribs, forcing her to switch her defense.
However, Kent swapped with his clone body and unleashed a different attack...
"Bleeding Crescent Slash!"
A blood arc flashed out and landed on Atria’s shoulder, sending her flying back.
However, Kent wouldn’t let her come back up. His claw took a wide swing, sending claw arcs at her. Atria used a skill to teleport a meter from Kent with her sword stabbed forward.
However, Kent struck her sword with his left claw and somersaulted, landing an uppercut with his leg. This blow disoriented Atria, allowing Kent another opening.
"Dragon Blow!"
BOOM!
Kent’s fist landed in her stomach, sending her flying back.
’I can’t continue like this,’ Kent said, seeing that his blow did next to nothing to Atria.
⟦The master is doing a great job. However, the master cannot use the talisman or the key yet... not while that portal hasn’t closed.⟧
Kent nodded, looking at the golden portal. After the angel man appeared, nobody had appeared from it again; however, from the look of things, it was still a danger...
’The normal warriors are no match for these Angels,’ Kent said, noticing thousands of humans losing their lives by the second.
’This is just too evil. How can a small world like Earth face three worlds at once?’ Suddenly, just when Atria was about to unleash an attack, Kent saw another startling display.
Out of nowhere, a purple formation appeared on the ground, and a chilling voice spoke from what appeared to be hell...
"Arise."
In an instant, the dead bodies on the ground started rising to their feet. Both Earth warriors and enemy warriors all started rising to their feet...
Then, from a dark portal that appeared suddenly, a handsome man with evil eyes emerged, standing atop the head of a bone dragon...
"I am back."
’What a showoff.’
Kent smirked, but Atria was upon him...
⟦He is called Asmodeus, in case you are wondering.⟧
The tower teased, but Kent was too occupied to say anything.

chapters.title: Chapter 1068: Solid Plan
paragraphs: If there is one thing Kent is good at, then it is close combat, especially with a sword. He was the father of swordsmen, someone who mastered every possible move a swordsman could make.
Of course, one can argue and say he isn’t his past self at the moment.
That is true; the current Kent is but a brat who has just started walking the path of a swordsman.
He had only recently reached the Sword Sage stage, which is several times far from reaching the peak of true swordsmanship.
So, using his past-life achievements to project his combat experience is more than shameless.
However, one thing can be said: the current him has mastered all 1.6 million sword moves a person could possibly think of. It took years for Jest to master all, and now Kent has all those moves.
So, despite being in a completely different universe, the same rules still apply, and Kent, who saw how dangerous Atria was, was using his talent in close combat to overwhelm her.
’The saying that in the face of absolute strength, all schemes are useless is indeed true.’
Both in strength and speed, Atria surpasses him. Even with 135,000 flame veins, Kent is barely keeping up.
The only thing saving him is the soul map, which allows him to see and anticipate every move Atria is making and would make.
’I may have graduated even from Supreme High Worlds, but I am not ready for Immortal or Unique Worlds,’ Kent smiled as he evaded a wide swing.
Then, with a quick jab, he pushed Atria back, only for her to move around him and try to stab him from the back...
"I never knew Angels were cowards, even going as far as trying to backstab me... How shameless."
Kent teleported and then used a clone body to appear behind Atria and try to backstab her, only for his clone body to be cut in half by a wind blade Atria conjured from thin air.
Kent, of course, knew she was doing that, so he probed her with his clone body, and then, using his main body, he teleported back to land an attack.
But facing a Nirvana-stage warrior, even if she doesn’t have access to her domain, the chances of catching her off guard are next to zero.

However, Kent isn’t merely attacking to see if he will be lucky... Kent is more intelligent than that. He has 1.6 million sword moves in his mind... he can execute them with ease, meaning whenever Atria makes a move, it is within one of the 1.6 million moves.
What he was doing was isolating all her moves, and then, once she has used all close combat moves she knew, he would find a way to use the remaining moves she didn’t know and, hopefully, kill her...
’Or I can just use my trump cards now and pray for the best,’ Kent said inwardly, but then he chuckled.
He knew his ride back home wouldn’t open for another 23 hours and 45 minutes, so he might as well kill the woman and later use his trump cards when a new target came and there were no other ways.
Soon, two more hours passed, and aside from the three Nirvana-stage warriors, no new ones appeared again. However, more Angels kept coming, most at the Domain stage.
Of course, Kent knew that despite the dead rising to aid in combat, the danger was still there, and that only seemed to increase when he saw more Angels coming out from the portals.
Kent didn’t know how these Angels were coming from many portals instead of one. It felt like they were summoned by someone.
They only appeared when the Angel man that is currently locked in combat with the Paragon arrived on the battlefield.
Also, Kent seemed to grasp something that made him question whether this was still an awakening or an execution.

According to Atria, she and her Angel friends are on a mission from an organization called Heavenly Court. However, the tower made it plain to Kent that this is a world awakening where two worlds collide and fight for the right to live.
So, if that is the case, then why has the Heavenly Court interfered in it?
’Like I said, something fishy is going on, and I don’t like it.’
Kent had been observing the battle for the past two hours, and from what he saw, the humans were fighting with everything they had.
Also, he noticed the dead rising to the occasion aren’t like the undead but more like half-humans, half-undead.
He tried to scan them, but nothing showed. However, he knew that whatever ability the Necromancer used, the humans fighting weren’t different from when they were alive.
After looking around for a few minutes, Kent chose to observe Paragon for a few moments and see something.
What he saw made him realize something that made him raise his brow.
’Tower, can you confirm with your new bestie if Paragon is fighting using his bloodline power? I can feel he has multiple bloodlines, but he isn’t using them like I am doing.’
⟦Okay, master⟧
’If he is merely using the bloodline boost instead of actively tapping into his true bloodline power, then there’s no telling what kind of monster he is.’
Kent’s focus turned back to Atria, whom he had studied like an open book for the past two hours of combat, and now, he started to see some openings in her attacks.
This means Kent is finally making headway, and while he is out of his league, having a bloodline like his has made him extremely dangerous.
Kent moved back, his flame wheels leaving a trail of flames as he evaded a powerful stab that blasted a hole into a mountain 3 km away.
Then Kent conjured three clone bodies and swapped places with the first and unleashed an attack,
"Rapid Sword Slash."
The moment the 450 sword arcs appeared, Kent swapped with the second clone.
"Void Piercer."

A beam of sword light shot out, and before Atria could dodge, Kent swapped with the third clone and unleashed a wide arc, one that left the ground trembling when it landed on the shield Atria created from her spirit qi.
’It is all about timing.’
Kent teleported 8 km away and unleashed the ’Void Cleave’ attack instantly. This time, Kent channeled so much killing intent that he forced Atria to also unleash an attack.
"Now!"
The moment she raised her sword, which Kent knew she would, he teleported and appeared behind her.
"Doom Shards!"
With a powerful stomp on the ground, a large shard burst out of the ground and shot at Atria, who was caught off guard. The Void Cleave reached her right when the Doom Shards also did.
This divided her attention long enough for Kent to do what he risked his neck for.
A sword appeared in his hand, and then with a powerful stab, he jammed the sword into the ground and formed a hand seal...
"Crimson Guillotine Array!"
The sky suddenly turned dark as thousands of swords appeared in the air and started moving like snakes.
Kent teleported back and waved his hand, causing 3,000 swords to shoot forward and create a diamond formation around Atria.
Her expression turned grim.
’I need a minute for the array to be complete, meaning I must find a way to hold her back from using any powerful attacks in the next 60 seconds.’
"You are much stronger than I expected... makes me wonder just how you must be feeling at the moment, knowing you couldn’t even scratch someone six stages below you after two hours of combat."

A sword appeared in his hand, and then with a powerful stab, he jammed the sword into the ground and formed a hand seal...
"Crimson Guillotine Array!"
The sky suddenly turned dark as thousands of swords appeared in the air and started moving like snakes.
Kent teleported back and waved his hand, causing 3,000 swords to shoot forward and create a diamond formation around Atria.
Her expression turned grim.
’I need a minute for the array to be complete, meaning I must find a way to hold her back from using any powerful attacks in the next 60 seconds.’
"You are much stronger than I expected... makes me wonder just how you must be feeling at the moment, knowing you couldn’t even scratch someone six stages below you after two hours of combat."

chapters.title: Chapter 1069: Crimson Guillotine Array
paragraphs: Kent laughed and stared at the seething Angel Lady who wanted nothing more than to end him with a single sword strike.
"I only have one question," Kent said, raising a finger. "Why would the heavenly court mess with the awakening between two worlds?"
To buy time, Kent activated a skill he received when he added Princess Lovina to his harem.
It wouldn’t be able to penetrate Atria’s mind and cause her to say things she wouldn’t want to say, but it was strong enough to at least make her talk.

"I don’t talk to mongrels," Atria said, which caused Kent to narrow his gaze at her. For some reason, he hated being called a mongrel. However, he kept his cool and instead chose to handle it like a man.

"Mongrel, you say. I guess this universe is different from mine, yet the same. Though I pity you... The mission you are on is a failure... You cannot kill the one you are after because I wouldn’t allow you."
Kent turned and looked at the redheaded beauty he had saved the moment he arrived in the universe.

During the past two hours that they had fought, Kent caught Atria observing the redhead every chance she got. Every time she looked at her, a wave of killing intent flowed from her, making him wonder just what she was after.
However, after she had tried to sneakily kill her, Kent finally realized she wasn’t only after her; she was on a strict mission to kill that redhead.
Kent noticed the changes that were happening in the redhead. When he first arrived, if he and she had fought, he would have killed her in under thirty minutes.
However, as time passed and the battle only grew chaotic, he started to sense that if they were to clash now, an hour wouldn’t be enough.
He realized that the redhead was like Sylvara; the longer the fight, the stronger she became. Naturally, the main factor in this was the blood on the battlefield...
"You are scared of her... No, you are not scared... You are scared of what she will become if she is left unchecked for a while. That is the case."
The look on Atria’s face changed, but before she could make a move, Kent spoke again, this time saying something that struck a nerve.

"Do you love your family... You know, your sister, currently on Planet Nimbus, your mother, who is a governor in the Intergalactic Angel War Council... Your brother, who left home and started chasing after a lady like a simp, or your little boyfriend who told you not to take this mission...yet you did."
A grin appeared on Kent’s face. "I believe his name is Micah."
Atria faltered, and her heartbeat nearly came to a stop when Kent spoke again. However, she turned pale when Kent added more words...
"I am not a firm believer in hurting the innocent. However, after appearing in this world and watching what you people are capable of, I don’t mind aiding my bro in killing your family members.

"I believe my beautiful Alina calls it the price you pay for your stupidity. I have already sent the name of your world, family, their description, and even where your vacation home is to my bro, the paragon.

"I may not be able to personally do it, but I think my bro would be more than happy to kill the family of someone working for the Heavenly Court." Kent formed a hand seal, causing a formation to open in the air.
"Why... why would you want innocent people to die?" Atria said, her expression dark.
Kent had been trying to probe her status page for the past hour, but aside from her name and age, nothing else showed...
He tried all he could, but nothing happened.
However, that all changed when Kent started using the "Mind Mess" skill on her. He began to see more of her status.
Soon, everything became clear to him, and that was when he saw the danger he was in, but also a way to buy himself some time.
Of course, what Kent saw made him lose hope in humanity for a moment...
"You talk about innocence when deep within you, you knew all these people were innocent. Even the Paragon is innocent. However, you don’t care about that.
All you care about is pleasing the heavens. You don’t care what happens to the innocent as long as you score some brownie points with the heavens.
So why should I care? Also, my strength comes when there is chaos, so making sure your families follow you in death is the best recipe for you to get mad, so I can do this."
"Crimson Guillotine Array — Open."
The moment Kent said that, the array opened, and over a hundred thousand swords filled the air. Kent formed a few more seals, and then the swords lit with dark flames.
"Attack."
Atria, who was both angry because Kent discovered her secret and scared for the life of her family, decided to let go and kill the bastard.
However, Kent wasn’t about to make things easy for her.
"Guillotine Lotus Formation!"
Ten thousand swords moved to create a lotus flower-like formation around Atria, causing her movement to come to a stop. Then the swords attacked, and all she could do was retaliate.
However, fighting against swords from hell and the Umbral Flame of Oblivion was no easy thing.
Swords kept coming, and despite her blocking and even destroying a few more, the changes were just too little since there were thousands more raining down on her.
"Guillotine Dragon Formation!"

While the lotus formation was working its magic, Kent activated another formation, forming a colossal dragon made of swords that moved toward her and swiped its tail, causing a thousand swords to strike with eerie precision and great speed.
Atria wrapped her wings around herself, and the surface of the wings turned metallic just as the swords arrived.
BOOM!
A powerful explosion rocked the battlefield, creating dust that covered both Kent’s and Atria’s vision. Naturally, they each made a move to catch the other off guard.
However, who was Kent if not someone who wanted just this moment to happen...
’Go, Gaap, you have five minutes.’
Kent’s sword moved and entered the Crimson Guillotine Array. The main killing move is yet to be created.
If Kent had a shot at killing Atria, then Gaap must succeed in his mission.
⟦Master, I have heard back from Icon. She said her master becomes strong when using any of his bloodlines.
The one he is using now is called the Primordial Vampire Monarch Bloodline. It allows him great control in close combat, warfare, and blood manipulation.⟧
’So he is not channeling his bloodline power like I am doing?’
⟦No, he is merely riding on the boost.⟧
’What a monster. Even without holding true control over his bloodline, he is holding back two powerhouses and has even managed to injure one.
That is another level of monster.’
Kent smiled, watching the Paragon send the Angel man crashing to the ground. Then, at the same moment, he saw him manifest a clone that slipped away and was heading in a certain direction.
Kent focused on the clone, which moved toward the direction where a certain woman clad in futuristic armor was locked in fierce combat with a Life Stage warrior.
Naturally, the woman was being trashed. However, it felt like she wanted to be in that position long enough for the clone to arrive.
Just when the Life Stage warrior pushed the woman to a corner and was about to end her, the clone split into two clones and grabbed him.
In the microsecond granted by the new clone, Kent saw the woman point forward, and a beam made from water drew a fist-sized hole through the Life Stage warrior’s head.
Then the clones pointed at the woman, sending her into the pagoda, which stood not far from where she fought.
Kent turned his focus back to the Paragon, who was still locked in fierce combat...

chapters.title: Chapter 1070: Killing Atria
paragraphs: ’What just happened?’ Kent asked, unsure of how to explain what he had just witnessed.
⟦Apparent, this Paragon has many minds, allowing him to observe many things while still locked in combat with two people who can easily end his life.⟧
’What a monster.’ Kent smiled, feeling some form of pride watching the handsome redhead, fighting while a part of his mind was controlling thousands of weapons to aid his friends.
’I have decided, Tower. The moment we go back, I will learn the "Claw Art" even if I have to suffer soul damage.’
⟦Let’s talk about that when we go back, master. For now, you have an Angel to kill.⟧
’I know, Tower. However, I want to help him harness his bloodline power. I believe that will make him several times stronger.’
⟦How should we do that?⟧
’Very simple, actually. Just give him one Innate Talent Awakening Pill infused with a drop of my essence blood.’
⟦How sure are you that it will work?⟧

Even the Tower has no idea that a person can do what Kent wanted to do. The least the Innate Talent Awakening Pill can do is awaken an innate talent, like an ability, bloodline skill, or even a bloodline boost.
Allowing one to open a doorway into their bloodline so they can harness it is not possible. Those things come naturally once one has the body, soul, and mind for it.
Using a pill to achieve that is not possible...
’I know it will work because, back during the primordial era, when Elina wanted to become a dragon, I did some research and found out my bloodline can bring out the potential of others.
Perhaps, if I had given Elina a drop of it before those forsaken idiots came, she would have survived.’
Kent sighed, recalling a moment back when he and Elina spent a night in a cave once owned by a scholar who specialized in bloodlines.
There, she tortured Chaos to make her a dragon; however, he didn’t simply because he was scared his bloodline might hurt her.
Now, he knew he shouldn’t have been afraid.
⟦I will do as you say, master.⟧
’Thank you.’
Kent looked at the Paragon for a few more seconds before turning back to Atria, who was still locked in with the Crimson Guillotine Array...
However, just when he was about to activate a new formation, a beam came from one portal that had just opened.
The beam wasn’t aimed at him, but at the same redhead beauty Atria was trying to kill. At that same moment, another beam came for the Array, forcing Kent to prioritize who to save.
Saving the Array would mean getting to kill a Nirvana-stage warrior, but ignoring and saving the redhead would mean risking losing Atria.
Those were some odds he couldn’t help thinking about. Losing Atria would put more lives at risk, and letting the beam kill the redhead would make Atria win regardless.
’Fuck the heavens,’ Kent made up his mind and was about to go save Queenie (redhead) when a red beam came from the cloud and collided with the beam.
"Guillotine Shield Formation."
Kent formed a hand seal, and ten thousand swords formed into a shield that appeared between the Array and the beam.
’How is it going, Gaap?’
[Almost there, master. I am almost there.]
’Hurry, buddy, we have more arrivals.’ Kent looked at the person who saved the redhead, but aside from a residue of solar qi in the air, nobody was there.
This made Kent look up as if staring at the sun...
’I am just overthinking things.’
[The formation is ready.] Gaap pulled his focus back to the Array. Then, without wasting time, Kent formed a hand seal...
"Guillotine Killing Formation."
The moment the new formation was activated, the swords spinning up in the air stopped; green flames lit on half the swords, while the other half were still lit by black flames.
"KILL"
The sword moved, and Atria, who had called for reinforcement, was finally met with something she wasn’t prepared for.
Kent used his hand to control the black swords while the green ones circled in the air.
Suddenly, a long sword bypassed Atria’s defense and landed on her shoulder, sending her flying back.
"Killing Sword Strike."
Kent’s sword glowed green, and then he unleashed a powerful slash, one that caused the green swords to form into one large sword and slash at Atria, aiming to cut her in half.
However, just when the green sword was about to land on her body, a red-winged Angel, another Nirvana stage warrior, appeared and blocked it with a colossal sword.
"Thank you." Instead of frowning, Kent thanked the new arrival and formed a hand seal.
"Teleport."
Atria, who was finally out of harm’s way, felt her surroundings shift, and then she found herself staring at a flaming finger less than a meter from her.
"Finger of Destruction."
"NOOOOOO!"
The red-winged Angel cried out loud, watching as the finger landed on Atria’s body, and without any resistance, she was pushed into the ground, creating a powerful explosion.
"BOOOOOOM!"
At the same time, the green sword that the red-winged Angel defended against also exploded, sending the poor guy crashing into the ground.
"Welcome to the Crimson Guillotine Array... Have a nice stay."

And without even seeking out a new target, another Nirvana stage warrior willingly entered the Array, making him the second victim Kent planned to use to test the limit of the Crimson Guillotine Array.
Kent observed the battlefield and saw that some of the human warriors were retreating under the command of the Paragon.
He observed that the ones retreating were all Void stage warriors who were extremely tired.
As more Angels arrived, the danger level also started to rise.
⟦I have delivered the pill. Now, we just have to wait and see what happens.⟧
Kent nodded and also entered the Array and clashed with the red-winged Angel. Their battle soon became chaotic, but killing a Nirvana stage warrior made Kent extremely happy.
So his confidence was at an all-time high.
Slowly, time went by, but the various battles never seemed to slow down at all. More enemies kept coming.
However, something good happened.

The portal leading to the planet the Nethran came from closed. When he looked around, he saw that all the monarchs that came from there had died, and even the Nirvana stage warrior fighting the Paragon was also dead.
Even stranger, the Nirvana stage Angel was now locked in fierce combat with a silver-haired beauty who had a crown-like item on her forehead.
It didn’t wrap around her entire head but only her forehead, and it had a pentagon-shaped gem glowing golden in it.
The Paragon, on the other hand, was nowhere to be found. He had vanished from the battle for an entire hour, yet Kent didn’t notice.
This alone told him what he needed to know...
’They are all monsters.’
Suddenly, Kent felt a powerful pressure come from the pagoda standing in the distance.
At the same time, Kent also saw a green and blue portal open. Exactly 419 Angels walked out from the green and 12,000 from the blue.
But as if that wasn’t enough, Kent sensed tribulation clouds forming, and their target seemed to be a vampire lady...
’I hate this universe.’
He retrieved a talisman and clenched it. In an instant, his bloodline rose from 20% to 25%.
"ROAR!"
A mighty dragon roared and covered the sky...creating a shadow large enough to send chills running down everyone’s back...

chapters.title: Chapter 1071: Primordial Chaos Dragon Unleashed
paragraphs: One of the trump cards Kent brought with him is a unique talisman that temporarily boosts his bloodline by 5% for 24 hours.
Kent didn’t need it before when his bloodline hadn’t reached 20% awakened yet. Of course, he also didn’t pay attention to it simply because the talisman is ridiculously expensive.

However, now he does, and if the fact that he is in a completely different universe or the fact that he is fighting beings far stronger than he is isn’t enough, then now, he has to fight dozens of said opponents at the same time, and that is just too much for a person.
So he used it, and at the moment, what could be described as a primal predatory feeling was what everybody started to feel the moment Kent turned into his true dragon form.

His body is about 300 meters long. Not even close to the true beast form of someone like Ignarok or even Sylvara. However, 300 meters is already long enough to put him in the rank of a collosal beasts.

His scales are dark golden, with a few patches of red. His wings are also very wide, even longer than his body. It is about 350 meters wide, and a metallic sheen could be felt from them, making every flap so suffocating and, well, just dangerous.
His dark golden horns aren’t as twisted as a primordial dragon’s should be, but that is to be expected, considering he is only at 25% at the moment.
However, what made him a danger are his tail and legs...
His tail is lined with metallic scales and ends with a pointed metallic spike, the kind that is designed to pierce anything.
As for his legs, they ended in metallic talons, so hard and piercing that anything they touched would be shredded beyond recognition.
As he flaps his wings and circles around the Crimson Guillotine Array, which was still holding the red-winged angel he feel like a god looking down on a bug.
Suddenly, the array exploded, freeing the monarch.
"Dragon breath."
Kent, who was both excited to have finally turned into his dragon, unleashed his dragon breath, and a wave of black flames blasted out, consuming the poor monarch.
"AAarrrgggHHHH!"
His screams drew the attention of many angels; however, when they saw the dragon in the air, none dared move.

When Kent finished breathing the flames and let the monarch catch his breath, everyone’s back turned cold. The poor angel, still on his knees, was barbecued, and while he was dead, his body continued to twitch.
That is how much pain he was in before he died.
It was all thanks to Kent using the Umbral Flame of Oblivion.
’So aside from my soul flame and my core flame, I can also use the Nine Nirvana Flames through dragon breath.’
This discovery made Kent turn and look toward the direction where 12,000 angels appeared, the majority of them at the Death Stage, while over 40 were monarchs and 8 were in the Nirvana Stage.
However, what caught his attention the most was a white-haired angel lady holding a metallic bow, her expression cold.
’She seems to be looking toward the redhead, too. Just why are they keen on killing her?’
⟦Master, the Paragon said can you handle the lady wielding the bow. He said she is a level 8 Nirvana Stage warrior, while the two you killed were just level 2.⟧
Kent looked up at the air and saw the Paragon looking toward him.
Just from staring at him, Kent could tell that whatever this tribulation is about, Paragon has been waiting for it from the start.
Aside from that, he could tell that Paragon had become much stronger, just like how he, too, had become stronger now that he was in his dragon form.
Kent gave him a nod, telling him he shouldn’t worry.
’Tell him not to worry and that he should focus on the tribulation. With me here, these angels are about to have a bad day.’
⟦Good luck, master, and please, don’t do anything reckless.⟧
’You already know me, Tower... I value my life more than anything.’
Kent turned back to the angel lady and growl, smoke coming from the corner of his mouth.

He can tell that even if he takes on the Angel lady, who at the moment is the most dangerous warrior on the enemy side, there are still 40 monarchs and 8 Nirvana stage warriors coming from the blue portal.
And from the green portal where the 419 warriors appeared, 9 of them are Monarchs and 6 Nirvana stage warriors too.
Thankfully, the moment they arrived, all portals closed, showing they were the last to arrive.
However, the question still remains, how are the Earth warriors going to fight such odds when their strongest is now about to face a different challenge.
’So is this how being a paragon feels like...always clashing with odds far beyond your level.’ Kent felt pity toward the paragon, who he could tell was both angry and scared at the moment.

He saw him looking around, watching his people panic and many dying simply because of him. All of this is happening because of him, so at the moment, despite knowing all these warriors signed up for the worst, watching them die made him powerless.
’This is just too cruel. I wish Kaizo and the others were here to take some loads off their neck.’
Kent sighs, knowing that it is impossible. However, he also knew killing the Angel Lady would take off a major player from the board.
He flaps his wings and, in an instant, vanishes, appearing before the angel lady known in the Divine Angel race as Arella.
"Dragon Claw."
Kent swung his claw, unleashing a red dragon claw arcs that tore the void in an instant. Arella saw him move and knew she could block him. However, the speed Kent used was beyond her calculation.
But even so, she didn’t panic.
Her bow turned into a sword, and she struck with a powerful swing, meeting the claw in a rather powerful explosion.
Both of them were pushed back.
Arella turned to three angels and issued a command before turning back to face Kent. "Set up the transporter."
Her beautiful white wings spread, and she instantly dashed toward Kent, aiming for his life. However, Kent wasn’t about to waste his strength on a bug.
"Dragon Tail."
Kent attacked with his dragon tail, but Arella didn’t let it come close to her. She moved back, narrowly evading the deadly spiked tail.
However, it didn’t end there; she even went ahead and unleashed a sword arc before transforming her sword back into a bow.
She fired a random shot that instantly opened a wormhole, dragging both of them in. When they appeared, Kent saw they were several miles away from the battlefield.
’She wants to isolate me from them...Just what is she planning?
Kent dodges another arrow, and then he unleashes a dragon claw. However, just when he was about to unleash another attack, he sensed his surroundings twist.
’Someone or some people are hiding in the void...I need to be careful.’

Kent started fighting Arella with half his focus on the space around him. He can sense the void thanks to his Chaos blood. So while he can’t tell how may are hidden, he knew they are waiting for the best moment to attack.
"Projectile Domain."
She unleashed her domain, and in an instant, Kent sensed 14 points of contact where her arrows could land on him.
He didn’t know how it happened, but through the soul map, he saw that the domain had selected 14 points on his body that an arrow could pierce.
Obviously, Arella didn’t know her domain had been figured out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1072: How a Dragon Fight
paragraphs: But even though Kent had figured the domain out still, he was still left one problem: how to counter.
In the Divine Angel race, though there are gods and demigods leading many units in their Divine Army, Arella is recognized as one of the rare talents.
Her domain is not anything fancy or chilling that just being inside will make one break into a cold sweat.
However, it is the most useful.

No matter how absolute your defense is, she will always find a way to land an arrow, and right now, Kent, who has become a large body waiting to be poked by her arrows, has become the best target practice.

⟦I believe now might be the best time for the master to take on his demi-dragon form. Now that you have become a full dragon, for the next 24 hours, your demi-dragon form will have the same strength as your true dragon form.
This means a smaller body, less target to aim at.⟧
’I know, Tower. However, where is the fun in that? I bet she is going to be pissed when she finds out not even a single arrow of hers would land on my colossal body.’
⟦This sounds like a bad idea to me.⟧
’I know it is a bad idea, but I want to kill her when she least expects it, and fooling her with my dragon body is the perfect recipe.
After all, an angry angel is one who will make many mistakes.’
"Dragon Scales."
"Flame Veins."
Kent’s dark gold scales gleamed, and a wave of blood energy poured out, causing the space around him to start to warp.
His speed also surged, and in an instant, he started to see everything around him slow down. All 135,000 flame veins had been activated, boosting his speed by several folds.
"Bone Piercing Arrow!"
Arella unleashed an arrow, aiming it toward Kent’s chest. However, Kent didn’t give her that satisfaction.
"Flame Wheel!"
Kent’s wings lit up in green flames, and he moved. The arrow that was piercing toward his chest instantly changed direction. However, Arella didn’t blink and fired a second arrow.
Kent’s massive form twisted midair as the second arrow whistled past him, grazing his scales. The arrow exploded behind him, releasing a wave of compressed holy light that tore apart chunks of space.
Kent distances himself, but he can tell whatever arrow she fired wasn’t the last...

Arella had already fired her third and fourth arrows before the explosion even settled. Each arrow glowed with divine inscriptions, vibrating with power as they split into six smaller projectiles midair.
"Celestial Scattershot"
The arrows came from every direction—above, behind, left, right, even the blind spots under his wings.
⟦Master, the angels are setting up a portal. I told Icon, but she had no way to destroy it. You have to hurry. Also, three Nirvana stage warriors are missing from the battlefield⟧
’No kidding, Tower, and I think I know where they are.’
Kent’s eyes flashed with a deep red glow.
"Draconic Pulse."
A shockwave rippled from his body, creating a pulse of dragon blood Chaos energy that bent the path of the incoming arrows.
Some shattered instantly, others deflected harmlessly against his metallic scales, and the rest burned away before even reaching him.
"What"
Arella was shocked to see her arrows do next to no harm to Kent.
However, Kent didn’t waste time. He retaliated instantly, making sure he caught her off guard.
He surged forward, his massive body cutting through the air like a living comet. His tail glowed crimson as he spun.
"Dragon Spiral!"
The sheer force of his movement created a spiraling storm of destructive energy formed from black flames. This storm churned with so much energy that it forced Arella to block rather than dodge.
She summoned a radiant barrier of light, but the moment Kent’s tail struck it, cracks raced across the surface.
BOOM!
The explosion hurled her back several meters, her feathers scattering like shards of light. She intantly turn pale and even cough a mouthful of blood.
However, she managed to steady herself midair, blood trickling from the corner of her lips.
"There’s something strange about your flames."
She spat more blood, feeling her soul and body arch.
Kent chuckled, his dragon voice deep and resonant. "You noticed? Good. It’s called the Umbral Flame of Oblivion. It burns the soul before the body."
Arella’s expression hardened. She was sent to kill Queenie, who Kent would later come to know as an Asura, a being created for battles and bloodshed.
Her mission is to kill her. However, just when she arrived, this dragon came at her.

Initially, she didn’t place much emphasis on Kent, but when her domain failed to give her a clear shot, even causing her to miss many shots for the first time in her life, she began to sense the danger.
This made her want to bring Kent down. However, the Chaos dragon, who is more determined to help his bro, wouldn’t go down that easily.
She spread her wings wide, and the air around her began to hum. Countless golden symbols appeared, forming a massive halo of divine arrows suspended behind her.
Each arrow contains some form of Divine Light, the kind that only gods should have. However, the heavens knwing the plans they had for her made sure she wield such devastating power.
"Divine Arrow Storm!"
The sky lit up with streaks of holy light as tens of thousands of arrows descended upon Kent. Each carried enough divine essence to level a mountain.
But Kent wasn’t fazed.
"Flame Domain!"

His body erupted in dark-green fire, expanding into a massive inferno that swallowed everything around him. The flaming domain clashed with the descending arrows, creating blinding explosions one after another.
Through the chaos, Kent moved.
His claws glowed with runic lines as he dove through his own flames, appearing right before Arella.
Her eyes widened. "What—"
"Dragon Rend!"
His claw slashed downward, cutting through her barrier and grazing her shoulder. Blood splattered across the sky, burning as it fell, slamming hard into the ground.
Arella screamed, her bow reforming in her hand. She drew back the string with trembling fingers, condensing a single glowing arrow that pulsed like a small sun.
"This is over, monster!"
Kent laughed, his wings spreading wide, the flames behind him forming the image of a roaring dragon.
"I agree. But it’s your end, not mine." Both Kent and the flaming dragon he projected behind him roared, and then his mouth opened.
"Dragon Breath—Umbral Burst!"
Arella released her divine arrow at the same time Kent unleashed a beam of black fire from his jaws.
The two attacks collided midair, creating a suspense that suggests something devastating is about to happen.
Already, Kent is prepared to kill the Angel lady before the three Nirvana stage warriors hidden in the void could make any attempt to save her.
So while on the surface, Kent was merely using a dragon breath to defend against the arrows, the main attack was a talisman he spent 500 million tower points on.
A blinding light engulfed the battlefield, followed by a deafening roar that shattered the clouds and sent shockwaves across the entire planet’s surface..
When the smoke cleared, both Kent and Arella stood at opposite ends. At first sight, one could tell who had had the short end of the stick.
Arella’s armor cracked in more than one place and was smoking, while Kent’s scales were glowing faintly red from the heat.
She fell to one knee, panting, her bow dissolving into light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1073: Dragon Dominance
paragraphs: "Die" Kent, of course, saw the opening he wanted, and so he went for it. His wings flapped and his throat turned green, aiming to bathe her in a green inferno.
However, before he could unleash his breath attack, the bruised and battered Arella called out...
Kent’s dragon eyes narrow, a hint of mischief appearing in them.
"Commanders..." Arella called out, looking to her left.
The void cracked in three places, and three Nirvana stage Angel warriors jumped out.
Two lungs at Kent while the third went to secure Arella...
"Perfect timing," Kent made sure all three new arrivals heard him before he made his move. This was to ensure they knew he had been timing them, and now that they fell for it, they can only suffer.
"Draconic Clone Bodies"
In an instant, 10 identical copies of Kent appeared, causing the two lunging at him to come to a halt, confused about who among the 11 dragons to attack.
However, that one delay was enough for Kent to use the Amber Flame of Eternity to slow down time for the Nirvana stage warrior going to save Arella.
"Death is the only way," Kent said, before his mouth opened and he unleashed a breath attack, this time using the green hell flame from his flame core.
"AaaarrrggggHHHH"
"NOOOOOOO"
Two different shouts filled the battlefield. One came from Arella, whose painful cries that came from her soul filled the space, and the other came from the three Angel commanders.
Kent flaps his wings and distances himself from the four angels. All clones dissolved, or atleast that was what he wanted them to see.
"It is all about timing." In a mocking tone, he spoke, causing all three angel commanders to lung at him with weapons drawn. However, Kent wasn’t about to give them the satisfaction.
His wings flapped and he started running.
"Die Monster." One of them unleashes an attack, aiming for Kent’s wings. However, he swerves and keeps flying away...
"No need to be angry about anything. It is not like I killed her. Well...I didn’t kill her but my sword sure is about to"
One of the commanders chasing after Calm suddenly halted and turned around to see if what Kent said was indeed true.
When he turned, what he saw made his spine freeze.
A man with many face tattoos stood beside Arella, inscribing a rune on her forehead,
"No"
He dashes back, his speed several times faster now. However, it was already too late... Before he could even get within 3km of Arella, Gaap turned her into a Sword intent rune.
Flames engulf her, and then her soul is instantly purified into an intent rune.
"Die Demon"
"No need to shout...I merely gave her a different purpose. You should thank me instead," Gaap smiled and gave the angel commander the peace sigh before vanishing back into Kent’s soul sea.
Far in the distance, Kent came to a halt. The two commanders immediately attacked, only for their attacks to pass through Kent’s body, causing him to dissolve into sparks of light.
"A clone"
The moment they realize this, a bad feeling engulfs them.
Turning around, they saw Kent’s colossal body appear above the third commander, who was frustrated, angry, and taken off guard.
From the moment Kent activated the ’Draconic Clone Bodies, ’ he became his next target. After all, he was the only one who tried to defend Arella while the other two came at him with furious eyes.
This made him see him as someone whose main job was to protect Arella.

However, killing her on his watch was a mental blow, and even going as far as showing him what had become of Poor Arella, his anger became so much that he failed to notice when Kent sneaked up on him.
ROAR
Kent unleashed a dragon roar, which froze the poor guy who had no idea he was Kent’s target from the start.
A wave of black flame breath bathed him, barbecuing him into a burnt toast. He dropped from the air and slammed hard into the ground.
However, he didn’t die.
Kent ignored him and lunged at the remaining two, who also came at him.
Gaap appeared beside the dying commander and drew a rune on his forehead. Then, like what happened to Arella, flames engulf him and he turned into a sword intent rune and merged with Gaap.
"This universe is the best," Gaap grinned, knowing if this were to be Kent’s universe, the laws wouldn’t have allowed him to easily turn a living person into a sword intent.
It would have taken months to turn just one person into an intent rune; however, in this universe, the process was much faster.
Now, he has two intent runes, making him several times stronger.

[I will be more than ready]
