chapters.title: Chapter 1074: Angel Killer (1)
paragraphs: Kent had absolutely no idea when the five dragons appeared.
However, now that he was watching them battle the Nirvana stage warriors, he couldn’t help but feel happy.
He could see the danger was already at its peak, and with Paragon now facing six people in what appeared to be a strange kind of tribulation, the more help they got, the better.
Kent could also tell that more of the warriors were missing, suggesting they were either dead or taken off the board and sent somewhere.
This made him wonder just what kind of ability could allow someone to take an entire unit of warriors off a battlefield.
Then he recalled the Primordial Space his wives have, and he got the answer.
’The necromancer is nowhere to be found. Looks like he has taken some loads off,’ Kent spotted the first change.
Then it struck him...
’I have the soul map, yet I failed to notice these changes. Does it mean my focus was rooted in these Nirvana stage warriors to the point I didn’t even hear or see these changes?’
Clearly, Kent didn’t like this discovery.
He had seen how Paragon created a clone to go save someone and even controlled swords with his mind to aid his friends while still locked in a fierce and deadly battle.
Obviously, that made Kent see a weakness—his mental strength.
His mind was weak, and he could see that now.

’I can’t have this. The moment I ascend, the chances of my adventuring into a unique or immortal world would be very high. If I can’t spot a danger from miles away, then death will become my next neighbour for sure.’
The idea of having the means yet failing to use them made Kent very scared for his own life.
However, he also knew he couldn’t handle whatever this weakness was for now. His mission was to kill the remaining two Nirvana stage warriors and stop the ones setting up the transporter.
"No pressure then."
Kent muttered, swerving with practical ease as he evaded a sword beam unleashed by one of the Nirvana stage warriors.

However, the next second, he was forced to jump back just in time to evade a powerful slash at his wing. The sword scratched the surface of his wing, and the noise produced made Kent, in his dragon form, grin.
It sounded like metal scratching metal. Naturally, Kent didn’t even have to think to know he had absolutely nothing to worry about...
His wings were metallic, or at least would be metallic. He had merely used 25% of his bloodline, so he could only be impressed by how sturdy his wings were.
He moved his massive body back, sending a dust storm into the air. Then, using his colossal wings, he unleashed the dust at the two Nirvana stage angel commanders.
The cloud of dust spread violently, swirling around like a raging sandstorm. The two Nirvana stage angel commanders instinctively raised their defence barriers, hiding their bodies behind them.
The storm was violent and deadly.
The idea that Kent would let them escape also occurred to them. However, Kent had yet to unleash his main attack.
’I learned this from a sea dragon during my time in the Damned Hell Sea.’
Kent took a nosedive and landed on the ground, his dragon eyes glowing a deep molten hue as his claws sank into the ground. He could feel the pulsing energy of magma beneath the battlefield.
This made him happy and also very evil as his colossal eyes scanned the two angel commanders.
’So much fire.’

Drawing upon it, he inhaled sharply, and a fiery glow surged into his throat. He was channelling the fire from the ground, allowing him not only to enhance his own flame but also to add a small amount to it.
"Burn!"
A torrent of molten flame burst from his jaws, swallowing the dust storm and turning it into a blazing inferno.
At first, nothing unusual happened, so the two Angel commanders disregarded Kent’s attack. However, soon, it became clear what kind of danger they were facing.
Their barriers crackled under the assault, sparks flying as the heat tore through their defence and swallowed them in a raging storm of fire.
"Soul attack... retreat!"
One of them shouted, running back while pulling his teammate.
However, how could Kent allow him to go just like that...
Before he could escape, Kent’s tail whipped across the ground like a thunderclap, slamming into his side.
The impact shattered bones and sent him spiralling through the flames. The other angel, who was being pulled back, fell back into the inferno storm.
"Next time, save yourself first before thinking about others... punk."
The second angel commander, who had fallen back into the flames, soared upward, his sword radiating golden light.
"Divine Sword: Descent of Judgment!" he roared, and the sky above split open.
A massive golden sword about 400 meters long, formed from condensed divine energy, descended toward Kent’s head like an arrow fired by a giant.
Kent, of course, knew this attack wasn’t something he could brush off easily. After all, he could sense some divine essence hidden within it.
Though small, as someone who had a god in his harem, he didn’t miss that.
’Cheaters...’
He unfurled his wings wide, their metallic edges gleaming like forged blades. Kent planned to take the divine sword head-on.
With a mighty flap, he ascended to meet the attack head-on.
"Break"
His wings slashed upward, tearing through the golden sword with a screeching sound that echoed through the battlefield. The impact pushed him back, but he stabilised his body.
However, from the shattered sword, shards rained down like broken stars.
"Teleport."
Kent’s colossal body teleported just when the other angel commander saw an opening after the divine sword attack.
Kent may not have as many minds as Paragon, but he could anticipate his opponent’s move, and that told him all he had to know.
Kent appeared above the angel who had unleashed the divine sword. Before he could react, Kent’s claws glowed red-hot, molten scales pulsing with destructive heat.
"Crimson Rend!"
Kent saw this moment as the best time to go for his fifth Nirvana warrior kill, and he took it.
He plunged downward, slashing with both claws. The angel, caught off guard, could only raise his sword and brace for impact.
The air cracked, and two massive arcs of red energy carved through the sky, colliding with the angel’s chest.
The explosion that followed drowned out all other sounds.
The second angel commander’s scream was drowned out as well. He realised he had been played, and that pained him deep in his heart.
However, he realised this was war, and their opponent had proven time and time again to be someone who couldn’t be underestimated.
So all he could do was scream his heart out.
When the flames cleared, the angel commander’s armour was gone, his body trembling, wings reduced to ash. He fell from the sky like a broken doll and slammed hard into the ground.

Kent hovered above, his scales glowing faintly from the heat of his own attack. His breathing was steady, his now crimson eyes thanks to the nirvana flame he used, holding a mocking expression as he stared at the last remaining angel commander.
"Who knew killing angels would be this easy?"
The comment struck at the poor angel’s heart, but before he could move, doom shards erupted from the ground and drove through the burnt angel’s head.
"Oops."

chapters.title: Chapter 1075: Angel Killer (2)
paragraphs: The last remaining angel commander clenched his teeth, his eyes burning with fury and hatred.
The death of his comrades sent a tremor of rage through his veins. In fact, the once-pure light surrounding him flickered and dimmed, turning dull red.
"Monster..." he hissed, his voice trembling between pain and hatred. "You’ll die for this."
How all three of his companions died had enraged him to the point that his reasoning was being clouded by rage.
Kent didn’t bother replying.

His crimson eyes simply narrowed as he flapped his colossal wings once, sending shockwaves that cracked the earth beneath. The air trembled around him, and molten dust rose up as heat distorted the battlefield like a mirage.
’So much battle experience for me, I guess.’
Kent has already recalled memories of Chaos (his first incarnation) battling many powerful foes.
So he isn’t a mere dragon, he is one with so much battle experience...
The angel raised both hands, his sword dissolving into radiant particles that began swirling around him.
The light condensed, forming countless spears of golden energy that hovered mid-air, their tips aimed at Kent’s massive body.
"Judgment Rain!"
Thousands of golden spears shot forth, piercing through the sky in a blinding onslaught that commanded so much power. Kent obviously saw this, and he knew he was about to have a nasty welcome.
After all, the poor angel was burning his life force to further empower his attack.
However, the Chaos Dragon wasn’t about to fear divine light when he had Nirvana Flames.
Instead of dodging, he simply chuckled. "Let’s see whose rain burns hotter."
He opened his maw wide. The glow in his throat turned multicoloured. So much heat came from this multicoloured light...
It was the Prismatic Flame of Chaos, whose main aspects were Creation and Annihilation. Obviously, Kent sought to annihilate.
Suddenly, he exhaled a continuous stream of condensed plasma flames.
The two forces collided mid-air.
Multicoloured light and crimson fire clashed, exploding in bursts that tore through the clouds and scorched the heavens.
So much heat spread across many battlefields, causing many to turn in the direction of the explosion.
The sky turned into a canvas of multicoloured fire.
The ground quaked violently.
Shattered stones and flaming debris rained down as Kent roared, pouring more of his bloodline power into his flames.
"ROAAAAR!"
The dragon’s roar shattered several of the spears mid-air, but the angel pressed on, his divine energy surging to new heights.
’He is burning more of his life force... Looks like this bastard wants me dead.’
⟦No kidding, Master. You should be careful.⟧
The angel commander extended his hand toward the heavens, his armour burning away to reveal glowing golden runes etched across his body.
⟦Those are divine runes.⟧
’Looks like a god is helping him even now.’
⟦Yes, Master. But if they lose this battle, so many gods are going to have a bad day. After all, I can sense many of the angels using similar runes.⟧
’So this is a bet against the laws, huh? Vexthra said something similar. She said that, to some extent, the gods can bend the rules; however, it would be a bet against the heavenly laws.
If they lose, they will lose their divinity, and their chances of getting it back will be slim.’
⟦Then we can only win and dethrone some gods.⟧
’I like the sound of that.’

The runes on the angel’s skin continued to glow, and his divine essence formed around him. Suddenly, a powerful divine essence surged out, forming enormous golden wings that stretched hundreds of meters.
The divine light also formed an armour around him.
Kent immediately sensed a threat to his life, so he became alert.
"I am Commander Zevrael of the Holy Dawn Legion! If I don’t kill you, then may the heavens destroy my soul."
Kent’s grin widened. "Big words for someone marked for death."
The two launched forward simultaneously.
Zevrael’s sword reformed in his hands, blazing with divine light. Kent’s claws glowed molten red, the air rippling around them from sheer heat.
BOOOOOOOM
The shockwave levelled mountains in the distance, turning the landscape into a fiery wasteland.
It can be said that when this battle is finally over, the topography of Earth will be reshaped forever. The damage being dealt to it is already doing a lot.
Zevrael swung his sword downward, and Kent blocked it with his left claw. Sparks of divine light scattered across the scales, burning deep lines into his skin, but Kent didn’t flinch.
His right claw slashed forward, cutting through Zevrael’s armour and sending him flying back with blood spraying across the sky.
The angel crashed into the ground, carving a massive crater. But before Kent could finish him, Zevrael’s hand shot out, light erupting from his palm.
"Holy Seal: Angelic Domain!"
A circular formation spread beneath him, expanding rapidly until it covered the entire battlefield.
The moment the formation covered where Kent stood, a really bad feeling penetrated his heart. He could tell the danger filling the battlefield now was not going to be a walk in the park.
Golden chains of light shot out from the circle, binding Kent’s wings and limbs. In an instant, he felt his strength drain and the hold of the chains tighten.
⟦Use the Blood Death Seal⟧
’Far ahead of you, Tower.’
Kent activated the Blood Death Seal he had refined back in Hell. He had the chance to only refine one, but after the quest, he received two more yet to be refined.
The moment he activated it, his strength was restored, but he could feel 20% of it still suppressed.
’Chaos has been in many situations far more suppressing than this... I too can do it.’
Kent growled, his energy flaring wildly. The ground beneath him melted, forming rivers of magma as his power fought the seal.
Zevrael rose to his feet, battered and bleeding, his hair burnt and armour cracked, but his resolve unshaken.
He truly wanted to take Kent down, so he put everything on the line to get what he wanted.
’He really wants me dead, huh?’ Kent’s draconic face held a grin as he made his move to free himself from these divine chains.
He spread his wings with all his might, the golden chains creaking.
⟦Master, you have accumulated some Chaos energy. You can use it to break free.⟧
’I will need it later when I have no other moves left... for now, I have plenty of moves still left to make.’
Kent channelled energy into his body. Then, in an instant, his scales turned pitch black, and cracks of crimson energy spread across his body like molten veins.
The air shifted, and a primal feeling began to emanate from Kent. His aura changed.
’This aura... it is similar to those Primordial Beasts. Don’t tell me he has a bloodline from the Primordial Era,’ Zevrael thought, horror dawning on his face.
Soon, the horror turned to fear.

In this universe, there are 14 beasts known as the Primordial Beasts. They are said to be creatures from the Primordial Era. They are calamities—beings that nobody with a functioning brain cell would dare go against.
Everyone was already aware that during the Primordial Era, the powerhouses that rose were all monsters in their own right.
They were dangerous, and Zevrael, who was privileged to watch a battle between 14 gods and a Primordial Beast, had since developed fear for them.
Feeling Kent’s aura now, the terror he felt when he saw those green eyes on that Primordial Beast had enveloped him.
His body shuddered, fear gripping him.

After all, the poor angel was burning his life force to further empower his attack.
However, the Chaos Dragon wasn’t about to fear divine light when he had Nirvana Flames.
Instead of dodging, he simply chuckled.
"Let’s see whose rain burns hotter."
He opened his maw wide.
The glow in his throat turned multicoloured.
So much heat came from this multicoloured light...
It was the Prismatic Flame of Chaos, whose main aspects were Creation and Annihilation.
Obviously, Kent sought to annihilate.
Suddenly, he exhaled a continuous stream of condensed plasma flames.
The two forces collided mid-air.
Multicoloured light and crimson fire clashed, exploding in bursts that tore through the clouds and scorched the heavens.
So much heat spread across many battlefields, causing many to turn in the direction of the explosion.
The sky turned into a canvas of multicoloured fire.
The ground quaked violently.
Shattered stones and flaming debris rained down as Kent roared, pouring more of his bloodline power into his flames.
"ROAAAAR!"
The dragon’s roar shattered several of the spears mid-air, but the angel pressed on, his divine energy surging to new heights.
’He is burning more of his life force...
Looks like this bastard wants me dead.’
⟦No kidding, Master.
You should be careful.⟧
The angel commander extended his hand toward the heavens, his armour burning away to reveal glowing golden runes etched across his body.
⟦Those are divine runes.⟧
’Looks like a god is helping him even now.’
⟦Yes, Master.
But if they lose this battle, so many gods are going to have a bad day.
After all, I can sense many of the angels using similar runes.⟧
’So this is a bet against the laws, huh?
Vexthra said something similar.
She said that, to some extent, the gods can bend the rules; however, it would be a bet against the heavenly laws.
If they lose, they will lose their divinity, and their chances of getting it back will be slim.’
⟦Then we can only win and dethrone some gods.⟧
’I like the sound of that.’
The runes on the angel’s skin continued to glow, and his divine essence formed around him.
Suddenly, a powerful divine essence surged out, forming enormous golden wings that stretched hundreds of meters.
The divine light also formed an armour around him.
Kent immediately sensed a threat to his life, so he became alert.
"I am Commander Zevrael of the Holy Dawn Legion!
If I don’t kill you, then may the heavens destroy my soul."
Kent’s grin widened.
"Big words for someone marked for death."
The two launched forward simultaneously.
Zevrael’s sword reformed in his hands, blazing with divine light.
Kent’s claws glowed molten red, the air rippling around them from sheer heat.
BOOOOOOOM
The shockwave levelled mountains in the distance, turning the landscape into a fiery wasteland.
It can be said that when this battle is finally over, the topography of Earth will be reshaped forever.
The damage being dealt to it is already doing a lot.
Zevrael swung his sword downward, and Kent blocked it with his left claw.
Sparks of divine light scattered across the scales, burning deep lines into his skin, but Kent didn’t flinch.
His right claw slashed forward, cutting through Zevrael’s armour and sending him flying back with blood spraying across the sky.
The angel crashed into the ground, carving a massive crater.
But before Kent could finish him, Zevrael’s hand shot out, light erupting from his palm.
"Holy Seal: Angelic Domain!"
A circular formation spread beneath him, expanding rapidly until it covered the entire battlefield.
The moment the formation covered where Kent stood, a really bad feeling penetrated his heart.
He could tell the danger filling the battlefield now was not going to be a walk in the park.
Golden chains of light shot out from the circle, binding Kent’s wings and limbs.
In an instant, he felt his strength drain and the hold of the chains tighten.
⟦Use the Blood Death Seal⟧
’Far ahead of you, Tower.’
Kent activated the Blood Death Seal he had refined back in Hell.
He had the chance to only refine one, but after the quest, he received two more yet to be refined.
The moment he activated it, his strength was restored, but he could feel 20% of it still suppressed.
’Chaos has been in many situations far more suppressing than this...
I too can do it.’
Kent growled, his energy flaring wildly.
The ground beneath him melted, forming rivers of magma as his power fought the seal.
Zevrael rose to his feet, battered and bleeding, his hair burnt and armour cracked, but his resolve unshaken.
He truly wanted to take Kent down, so he put everything on the line to get what he wanted.
’He really wants me dead, huh?’ Kent’s draconic face held a grin as he made his move to free himself from these divine chains.
He spread his wings with all his might, the golden chains creaking.
⟦Master, you have accumulated some Chaos energy.
You can use it to break free.⟧
’I will need it later when I have no other moves left... for now, I have plenty of moves still left to make.’
Kent channelled energy into his body.
Then, in an instant, his scales turned pitch black, and cracks of crimson energy spread across his body like molten veins.
The air shifted, and a primal feeling began to emanate from Kent.
His aura changed.
’This aura... it is similar to those Primordial Beasts.
Don’t tell me he has a bloodline from the Primordial Era,’ Zevrael thought, horror dawning on his face.
Soon, the horror turned to fear.
In this universe, there are 14 beasts known as the Primordial Beasts.
They are said to be creatures from the Primordial Era.
They are calamities—beings that nobody with a functioning brain cell would dare go against.
Everyone was already aware that during the Primordial Era, the powerhouses that rose were all monsters in their own right.
They were dangerous, and Zevrael, who was privileged to watch a battle between 14 gods and a Primordial Beast, had since developed fear for them.
Feeling Kent’s aura now, the terror he felt when he saw those green eyes on that Primordial Beast had enveloped him.
His body shuddered, fear gripping him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1076: Angel Killer (3)
paragraphs: This time, however, he was the one receiving the end of this aura, and while Kent had no idea how this poor angel was feeling, he started to grow excited, for he had finally awakened the Chaos Dragon Aura.
But that wasn’t all.
Awakening the aura gave Kent his first Dragon Technique. The ones he had been using were all innate abilities and a few borrowed ones from Chaos’s memories.
After making sure his aura had slipped into Zevrael’s bones, he made his move.
The next roar from Kent caused the air around them to tremble. The Angelic Domain shattered like glass.
Zevrael barely had time to react before Kent vanished.
A blur of black and crimson appeared behind him.
"Dragon Art - Abyssal Severance."
A single slash.
The world went silent.
Zevrael’s eyes widened.
His sword dropped.
A line of molten energy split his chest from shoulder to hip.
He fell to his knees, light fading from his body.
Kent loomed over his head, telling his fading soul that he, the Chaos Dragon, had defied the odds yet again.
⟦Master, you have to stop them from building the transporter⟧
Tower reminded Kent, who was catching his breath. If this were his universe, the being he had killed would be nine realms above him.
Those are odds no normal person should be able to breach. However, Kent defied those odds and did what many deemed impossible.
’Tower, do you think I have what it takes to kill an immortal?’
⟦I don’t want to make you feel bad, Master, but if death is something you want to experience, then fighting an immortal is the answer.⟧
Kent smirked and took to the sky.
RUMBLE
However, the moment he rose into the air, a powerful pressure he had never felt before fell on him, sending him crashing to the ground.
COUGH
Kent caught a mouthful of blood, his bones creaking as he struggled to move his body.
"Who are you?" Suddenly, the voice entered Kent’s ears, causing him to scan his surroundings. However, he saw nothing or anyone that would suggest an attacker.
"My name is Chaos, and I would love to be released before I get angry."
"Are you a native of this universe?" the voice asked again, this time with increasing pressure. Kent immediately realised he was facing an enemy—someone with knowledge of the multiverse.
"I am not from this universe... but I am here now, so what can you do about it?"
This time, the voice didn’t speak, but the pressure remained.

"Look, we both know you can’t do anything to me. After all, as a god, messing in the affairs of mortals is a huge offence. So why don’t you get on with your business and let me have fun slaughtering your lackeys?"
The voice remained quiet again; however, Kent could feel the anger the person was in. After five minutes, they let him move. By then, the pressure had drained Kent’s energy down to 40%.
"What an idiot god. It makes me wonder if this universe only has brain-dead gods," Kent chuckled and took to the sky.
However, after a single flap of his wings, he realised the main reason the god had to sacrifice his divinity was just to stop him...
"The transporter is ready."
Kent said that just when a beam was fired, a rift was torn in space, creating a very wide portal.
"No."
Kent moved and arrived before the portal in an instant. His body shifted, and he transformed into his demi-dragon form.
The last talisman Kent bought for 1 billion tower points appeared in his palm, and he threw it into the portal...
"GAAP"

Somewhere on the battlefield, Kent’s sword, which was claiming intent runes, suddenly trembled and vanished, appearing in Kent’s firm grip just in time for him to block a powerful swing from the monarch...
"Activate!"
Kent shouted, activating the talisman.
In an instant, the rift was sealed by a golden light; however, Kent was soon surrounded.
What is the worst-case scenario that can happen in battle?
In a dire battle, where the odds are against you, the most dreadful thing that can happen to you is gaining reinforcements.
That won’t only make the situation even more deadly, but it will also escalate the battle, ending it faster than it should.
So Kent prepared for it.
He brought a talisman he planned to use to buy an hour of time when things were dire and the enemy called for backup.
Initially, it was intended to use it to freeze the Nirvana stage warriors in place for one hour.
Now, he had sealed the rift with it for an hour, meaning they had just 60 minutes to change things before there was nothing else he could do...
’Tower, look through everything I have and give me something that can change the state of the battle.’
Kent clashed with the monarchs.
Some slipped away and started attacking the seal. However, knowing there was no way for them to break it unless the one hour was over, he ignored them.
Kent turned and looked in Paragon’s direction, but all he could see was fierce combat, one he wasn’t sure he could handle even with his bloodline now at 25%.
The Paragon was locked in with six Peak Nirvana stage warriors. Strangely, he seemed to be fending them off, but he was also under heavy assault.

⟦Don’t even think about it, Master. Interfering with his battle will give the Heavenly Daos a reason to send someone more powerful. The least you can do is make sure there is a world left behind after all of this is over.⟧
Kent really thought about it.
He knew if he were to take two out of the six warriors off Paragon’s hands, the speed at which they would kill them would be much faster.
This meant if things were to go well, the chances of both him and Paragon facing whatever would come out of the rift were high.

However, after hearing what the Tower said, he knew things weren’t as simple as he would have liked. But there was a silver lining, and that was the fact that all Nirvana stage warriors were contained.
’But what happens when the rift opens and even I can’t handle what comes out?’
⟦You can only do your best, Master... that is all you can do.⟧

’I wish Kaizo and the Legion were here,’ Kent sighed, grabbing a monarch with his clawed hands. He pulled him close to his body and then, using him as a meat shield, the arrow that came from behind him was received by him.
Kent threw him aside to suffer and die quietly.
More targets closed in on him.

Soon, 55 minutes had by, and looking around, Kent could tell things weren’t going to end well for his side. However, he knew, as the Tower said, that all he could do was his best, and he was doing his best.
After one hour, the seal was lifted.
However, when the first person appeared, a chill ran down Kent’s spine.
But then something strange happened.
From Kent’s soul universe, a golden key vibrated and shot out, appearing on the outside. It flew into the air and burst into golden sparks.
A golden portal formed. Kent, who was ready for action, heard a voice come from the golden portal, bringing a smile to his face.
"Here I come."

chapters.title: Chapter 1077: Reinforcement
paragraphs: "Here I come."
The classic line, spoken only by Kaizo, the Divine Angel Titan, spread across the battlefield.
From within the portal, Kaizo, clad in armless golden armor, descended, his fist crackling with lightning.
BANG
His fist connected with the jaw of a monarch, the first to appear from the rift. The smug expression on his demon face was wiped away by the fist.
His jaw shattered, and his teeth flew out, scattering across the ground.
But it didn’t end there. Kaizo’s fist, which was covered in potent lightning, had disoriented the poor guy, allowing a certain archeress to also make her move.
"Astra Arrow."
An arrow was fired, which streaked across the horizon, drawing a beautiful line like a beautifully painted grid line by a seasoned painter before going through the demon’s head.
His brain exploded, and blood gushed out, painting the sky.
Up in the air, Unity appeared, holding her bow in her first grip. She is an archer but also a painter, so she started balancing the two, thereby increasing the lethality of her arrows.
Although her two primordial spirits are still sleeping, she is in no way weak.
"Showoff."
Kaizo ignored the annoying Unity, who, aside from her uncanny accuracy with the bow, excels in annoying him.
It started as a rivalry at first, which it still was; however, they learned to work together to achieve their goal.
Kaizo is a brute with so much attack power. So, mostly, whenever he lands a blow, the lightning he imbues in his punch mostly disorients the targets, making them falter for a second.
That is when Unity mostly comes in.
She never misses, so Kaizo trusted her to get the job done.
Now that they are up against thousands of beings far beyond their current capabilities, he knew with Unity keeping an eye out, no single warrior would slip up on him.
Naturally, Kaizo is more than happy to get the battle going even if the odds stacked against him are far beyond his current strength.
Kent watched as his legion descended on everyone.
The Undead Legion led by Kaizo came.
The Eternal Wrath Legion led by Aetheris, the flame brute.
His wives, led by Vexthra. Even Lady Enzi and Liora came through the portal.
But they aren’t the only ones. The Bloodvein Tribe, led by Tribe Chief Malthar, also came to help Kent save this world.
The portal that brought Kaizo and the rest also came for the ladies who had just settled down on Planet Celestial Gate.
Now, all they can do is fight.
From the rift, hundreds of monarchs keep coming.
Of course, Kent knew his legion alone was not enough to hold them, so when he saw his goddess wife appear, he immediately contacted her.
[Vexthra dear, you don’t think now that you are in a different universe, you can use your abilities to clear the battlefield, right?]
Vexthra, who heard Kent’s words in her head, smiled.
’I can’t. The least I can do is face off against other gods, which I can sense are actively scanning you and two others.’
[Let me guess, their targets are the extremely handsome but not quite close to my level white-haired young man over there, and the beautiful redhead spilling blood.]
’Yes. They can’t touch you simply because you are not from this universe, but they can curse you, which I believe they have already.’
[I feel fine, love, so I guess their curse didn’t work on me.]

’True. But they can break the rules and attack you. Also, if the gods attack, I can protect you and the lady, but not the white-haired man over there. For some reason, I feel like helping him directly will be a bad thing.
Honestly, I can’t even bring myself to think maybe they want me to help her. It seems they are looking for more excuses to kill him directly.’
[Then we shouldn’t help him directly then. However, we can help his friends, right? After all, there is no harm in helping the friends of a Paragon, the last time I checked.]
’Yes. Alina is already on it.’
Vexthra looked around and saw that, despite bringing with her over four dozen warriors, the odds were still against them.
However, just when she was about to think of a plan, she spotted seven demons appear on the battlefield. Her eyes narrowed, scanning them.
"Strange, these seven aren’t like the others."
Vexthra scanned a few warriors from Earth and tried to compare their auras. However, she arrived at the same conclusion.
"They reek of death and resentment." As the goddess of hatred and resentment, she was able to discern some form of familiarity from them.

This caused her to narrow her eyes, sensing something suspicious. She traced their aura and saw they came from the white-haired young man currently facing off against six people she knew deep down had no business fighting.
’Kent, do you have a way to talk to the Paragon?’
[I do. What do you want to ask him?]
’Ask him whether these seven demons are from the underworld.’
[Okay.]
Vexthra could sense the aura of a god on them. In fact, this aura seemed to be influencing them somehow. Naturally, she wouldn’t have minded, but she could sense the aura of resentment on them.

That aura shouldn’t come from them, considering they also have the aura of death on them. So she could only come to a sudden conclusion—the seven demons were not happy about whatever or whoever released them.
’They are warriors, and to think somebody is pulling strings to limit them. I hate gods that play games with mortals.’
[My dear goddess, it seems these seven are from the underworld. They came about thanks to the mercy of the underworld god.]
’I see.’
Kent, who stabbed his claw into the chest of a monarch warrior, felt something strange come from Vexthra, making him raise his brow.
[Vexthra dear, you aren’t about to pick a fight with an underworld king, are you?]
’I hate gods who play with mortals.’
Kent grinned. [Go kick his ass, will you?]
’I will be back.’ Vexthra vanished from the battlefield, and Kent, who knew a god was about to have a very nasty day, grinned wildly.
"Oh, how I wish I could see that."
[Don’t worry, big brother, we will record everything.] Just when Kent thought everyone had appeared, the three lolis appeared, clad in battlewear, even though they couldn’t fight.
"You three are angels." The three mischievous lolis vanished from the battlefield too.
Kent could only grin happily. Although they were still losing, the fact that his goddess wife was about to have some action made him very happy.

Vexthra had been frustrated countless times when her sisters fought, and she couldn’t do anything. As a goddess, unless a god came after her man, she couldn’t do anything. So being presented with this chance felt like a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Is he worried his wife will lose? Definitely not.
Is he worried his wife will succeed in killing a god? Kent knew that it was less likely to happen.
It wasn’t that Vexthra was weak in any way. If anything, she could easily kill a god since her law had already reached the threshold to become a supreme.

The only reason she hasn’t taken the supreme tribulation is because she was also walking the ancient path. She wanted to become a dual supreme, someone who walks both the Law Path and the Ancient Path.
However, Vexthra didn’t want to make things hard for her man, so she wouldn’t kill the Underworld King (god).
However, she was going to have a serious conversation with him, making sure he understood that messing with mortals had consequences.

"Strange, these seven aren’t like the others."
Vexthra scanned a few warriors from Earth and tried to compare their auras.
However, she arrived at the same conclusion.
"They reek of death and resentment." As the goddess of hatred and resentment, she was able to discern some form of familiarity from them.
This caused her to narrow her eyes, sensing something suspicious.
She traced their aura and saw they came from the white-haired young man currently facing off against six people she knew deep down had no business fighting.
’Kent, do you have a way to talk to the Paragon?’
[I do.
What do you want to ask him?]
’Ask him whether these seven demons are from the underworld.’
[Okay.]
Vexthra could sense the aura of a god on them.
In fact, this aura seemed to be influencing them somehow.
Naturally, she wouldn’t have minded, but she could sense the aura of resentment on them.
That aura shouldn’t come from them, considering they also have the aura of death on them.
So she could only come to a sudden conclusion—the seven demons were not happy about whatever or whoever released them.
’They are warriors, and to think somebody is pulling strings to limit them.
I hate gods that play games with mortals.’
[My dear goddess, it seems these seven are from the underworld.
They came about thanks to the mercy of the underworld god.]
’I see.’
Kent, who stabbed his claw into the chest of a monarch warrior, felt something strange come from Vexthra, making him raise his brow.
[Vexthra dear, you aren’t about to pick a fight with an underworld king, are you?]
’I hate gods who play with mortals.’
Kent grinned.
[Go kick his ass, will you?]
’I will be back.’ Vexthra vanished from the battlefield, and Kent, who knew a god was about to have a very nasty day, grinned wildly.
"Oh, how I wish I could see that."
[Don’t worry, big brother, we will record everything.] Just when Kent thought everyone had appeared, the three lolis appeared, clad in battlewear, even though they couldn’t fight.
"You three are angels." The three mischievous lolis vanished from the battlefield too.
Kent could only grin happily.
Although they were still losing, the fact that his goddess wife was about to have some action made him very happy.
Vexthra had been frustrated countless times when her sisters fought, and she couldn’t do anything.
As a goddess, unless a god came after her man, she couldn’t do anything.
So being presented with this chance felt like a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
Is he worried his wife will lose?
Definitely not.
Is he worried his wife will succeed in killing a god?
Kent knew that it was less likely to happen.
It wasn’t that Vexthra was weak in any way.
If anything, she could easily kill a god since her law had already reached the threshold to become a supreme.
The only reason she hasn’t taken the supreme tribulation is because she was also walking the ancient path.
She wanted to become a dual supreme, someone who walks both the Law Path and the Ancient Path.
However, Vexthra didn’t want to make things hard for her man, so she wouldn’t kill the Underworld King (god).
However, she was going to have a serious conversation with him, making sure he understood that messing with mortals had consequences.

chapters.title: Chapter 1078: Alina’s Plans
paragraphs: "Kaizo, take on the brutes; they are much more destructive," Kent said, parrying an attack from a monarch.
Then he jumped back and moved to his left, watching as Lani slid into the shadow of a monarch and emerged, her dagger plunging deep into his heart.
Kaizo nodded, already locked in combat with a giant wearing spiked gauntlets.
Kaizo smashed his fist into his face before ducking low, rising back up with an uppercut that sent the brute staggering back.
Sylara appeared behind him and grabbed a chunk of his neck, tearing it away. Her claws glowed red as she grabbed the second chunk of flesh and ripped it off, too.
In the end, his head lay slumped, held by only the esophagus.
"Nasty." Kaizo chose to move away from Sylara, who sank her fangs into the almost-dead demon’s arm and started drinking his blood.
Sylvara needed blood to become stronger.
She had lost her Blood Hunger seal during the battle with the forsaken race. So until she could get into her element, she had to at least become much more powerful.
So, nasty as it may seem, she was drinking the blood of a monarch, which, with just a single gulp, was able to raise her strength to a new level.

After a few more gulps, she moved away and started to hunt like the vampire she was. She can’t form a new blood hunger seal here due to the nature of the battle, but Kent promises to take her to form when he ascends.
Lani, Vari, and Liora, the three assassins, moved from one shadow to the next, either killing if they could or severely injuring the enemy.
The number of monarchs far exceeds what the legion can handle. Of course, the seven demons sent over by the Paragon are also proving to be much more deadly.
They are very deadly...in fact.
But the monarchs aren’t normal warriors. They are criminals, hardened and tainted by the constant dangers they found themselves in while incarcerated.
So they are pushing back.
Yi Lai, previously known as the Hunter, had unleashed her two undead dragons, and she herself had already dived into the battle, fighting using her sword.
She is a necromancer, but she can also hold her own in combat, especially in close combat.
Up in the air, Alina is working on a formation. Ingrid and Elaine are standing guard, making sure nobody interrupts the trump card everyone is waiting for.
Elaine is creating something called a living formation.
It will not have consciousness like a living being, but it will continue to grow as it accumulates more spiritual qi.
For now, she wants to create aspects that will both attack and defend.

When she arrived on the battlefield, she sensed a beautiful formation carved into the battlefield. Naturally, as someone with eyes to see anything runes, she was able to decipher the formations and saw a way to further improve it.
Millions of years after this battle is over, the formation will continue to grow until one day, it becomes so powerful that even gods would have to run from it.
In a way, without Earth knowing it, a defense so advanced is being created by a Formation expert who single-handedly imprisoned a calamity billions of years ago with a few strokes of her rune knife.
"Uhm, Alina, it is not that I want to pressure you, but I feel like we are missing a lot. Maybe you should hurry up," Ingrid said, watching as her sisters battled the monarchs.
"Yeah. Move your big ass quickly and let us also join in the fun," Elaine giggled; however, Alina didn’t mind them. She wasn’t the one who told them to guard her.
They, of their own accord, chose to guard her, so they could only complain for all she cared.
Seeing she didn’t want to mind them, Elaine stirred the conversation away from Alina.

"That lady is very strong," Elaine said, watching a certain beautiful redhead (Queenie) cut a deep wound into the Nirvana stage warrior and then raise her hand, summoning blood. She shaped the blood into spears and attacked with it.
"She isn’t the only one... All of them are strong. I guess they have been preparing for this day for a very long time, and now that it is here, all they can do is fight with everything they have."
Mara was suddenly struck on the side, her body shooting through the air like a meteorite.
Elyndra, the strongest undead so far in Kent’s legion, waved her staff, and space formed into a bubble around the falling Mara.
When she landed on the ground, she felt no pain, all thanks to Elyndra using her space manipulation abilities to save her.
Elaine waved her staff, and a wave of green energy enveloped Mara, restoring her to full strength.
Mara gave her a nod, and then she went after the monarch who struck her with the spear.
As they say, revenge is best served cold and ruthless.

Considering how far away she landed, Mara now had to move slowly toward the monarch. However, as if someone had seen through her motive, she found her body suddenly moved, and soon she was standing before the monarch, who seemed startled.
Mara kicked with her right leg, landing a powerful blow on the monarch’s leg.
He staggered back but managed to gain a foothold just when Mara unleashed a sweeping attack with her sword, targeting the same leg she had kicked.
The monarch reacted quickly. He blocked the blow but was pushed back.
COUGH.
The monarch coughed and lowered his head, seeing a sword sticking out of his chest.
He raised his head and saw Mara looking at him, her cold eyes now filled with an amused expression.
That was all he saw before his consciousness faded, not knowing who killed him.
Nara retrieved her sword and grinned at her sister. "I leave your side for a second, and you nearly die. Don’t make me look bad, sis."
Mara smirked, giving her sister the ’I had everything under control’ look. However, hearing her words, though she sounded joking, Mara knew she was worried.
"I will be more careful."
"That will be great," Nara said before looking in the direction Kent was fighting in.
"Are you surprised?" Mara asked, and Nara nodded.
"I am. I never expected him to cross over to an entire Universe just to fight. Makes me wonder how this experience will affect him."
"He is a dragon, so what do you expect? I only wish when all this is over and we go back, he wouldn’t go on any adventure for a while."

The two sisters nodded, watching their man kill one monarch after another. They truly never expected Kent to enter yet another battle after spending time in the past, battling beasts of different shapes and sizes.
They were waiting for him to come and bring the entire Alliance to their knees, making them become soul essence donors before he ascended.
However, given how things are going now, they can only wish for something more subtle.
Naturally, all of them want to lock him down for months, just making love to him.
But for now, they can only focus on battling their foes.
"Let’s kill some more, I suppose... They won’t kill themselves now, would they?"
The two sisters decided to stick together now.
Although they both have the same cultivation base, Nara is much stronger and more experienced than Mara, her baby sister. So she felt some form of overprotectiveness over her.
Soon, the last monarch appeared on the battlefield, and the rift closed. The green and blue portals also closed, and finally, the portal leading to Planet Nebu also closed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1079: Vexthra’s Dominance
paragraphs: The moment all the portals closed, it became clear that the battle was finally coming to an end.
This was a good sign; however, Kent wasn’t relaxed at all.
He turned and looked in Paragon’s direction.
The six Nirvana stage warriors he was fighting were all alive. However, the demi-dragon had lost one arm, the elf had lost an eye, and the ice demon was in full-on attack mode.
The demi-lion and the supreme human were still in good shape. However, the masked figure seemed to be getting stronger.

Naturally, this was a good and bad thing for the Paragon, who was also bleeding from more than one place. However, for some reason, Kent couldn’t help but think that Paragon might be planning something.
"Can he make it?" Kent muttered.
⟦The master shouldn’t worry. Since, after an hour, they couldn’t kill him, he will be able to persevere and win in the end... That is, if nothing else happens.⟧
"Don’t raise flags, Tower. We are going to win, and that is a fact."
⟦I know, master. We are indeed going to win.⟧
Although the odds were still against them, they wouldn’t back down. That alone was a good sign that they were indeed on the grind.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the underworld, Vexthra stood calmly in the air, looking coldly at Yama, the Underworld King.
"Who are you, and how dare you invade my domain?" Yama asked, his expression also cold. He was having a good time watching the Paragon suffer, only for this bitch to enter his domain uninvited.
Vexthra didn’t blink at his question. Instead, she spoke coldly...
"You are going to release the seal you have on the seven demons you released, and whatever hold you have over that young man, you are going to cancel it."
"What if I said no?"
Vexthra raised her hand and gestured down. In an instant, Yama dropped to one knee, beads of sweat forming on his forehead.
"Supreme..." he muttered, his expression turning pale.

"No... I am just a god like you. But unlike a scum who preys on the weak and vulnerable, I actually dedicate my time to being an actual god—something you and all those scums would never know because you never actually do what is required of a god.
As a god, you are to maintain the fairness that separates mortals from us. You are to make them feel safe, not scared.
It sickens me to see gods abusing their powers."
Vexthra was clearly angry, as her expression slowly began to take on her god form—her true Hatred and Resentment.
She took one step forward, and Yama crashed to the other knee.
Then she took another, causing him to almost lie face-first on the ground.
"I can’t kill you simply because killing a god bound to a domain makes you the new owner. I have no plans on becoming an Underworld God... so I will spare your life.
However, two things will happen, and depending on your response, you may either become grateful we met or extremely regretful, wishing we had never met again."
Vexthra took the third step, and Yama was now lying face down on the ground.
"I am going to say two things, and you are going to make them happen, or else I will taint your law of self and forever ruin you as a god.
The souls down here are full of hatred and resentment, and in case you are not aware, I am the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment, so don’t test me."
Vexthra turned slightly to her left, watching Gaia, Akira, and Dori hiding behind a tree, thinking she wouldn’t see them.
However, she did, and while she didn’t smile on the outside, she chuckled inwardly, knowing Kent was the one who sent them.
"First, you are going to free the seven demons and forever wipe away your aura, making sure not even a sliver of it is left.
Second, you are going to cancel the contract you have with Paragon and make sure you never trick him into signing a contract he didn’t want.
You may be an Underworld God, but you aren’t eternal... Death is something that can happen to you, so be careful what you bargain for."
Yama, who was both furious and in shock, nodded, knowing that staying in his current position, while his fellow gods were watching, was just too embarrassing.
He moved his finger, and two dark threads appeared.
Vexthra waved her hand, and the threads were severed.
"Good. Now compensate me for wasting my time." Vexthra pointed at a dark core sitting on a shelf somewhere in Yama’s Underworld Vault.
The core flew through the void and landed in her palm.
"Thank you for your cooperation, Underworld King."
Vexthra waved her hand, and a portal opened. She walked toward it, but before entering, she turned to Gaia and her sisters, causing the three lolis to put on a lost expression.
"Where are we?" Dori asked.
"One moment we were inside the tower, the next we were here," Akira also said, causing Vexthra’s mouth to twitch.
"You can never trust this damn universe portals again. They pop up anywhere and mess with your plans...even sending you to the underworld when you clearly don’t want to"
"Let’s go, you three troublemakers. This is not our universe, so you can’t mess around anyhow."
"Big sister!" They ran toward Vexthra, who just chuckled, leading them through the portal.
It was only after she was gone that the pressure on Yama vanished.
Vexthra had already told Kent she could fight a Supreme on equal footing; clearly, she wasn’t kidding. Yama, with a furious expression, teleported and slammed hard into his throne.
The humiliation he had just felt was too much.
Being forced to eat dirt in his own domain made him extremely furious. If he could, he would slaughter Vexthra a thousand times over. However, he was powerless in that regard.
After all, being suppressed in his own domain is a clear sign that he can’t lay a finger on Vexthra. So all he could do was wallow in his anger.
However, things didn’t last long until a projected copy of a certain monkey appeared inside his throne room...
"Why the sour look, Yama? You were just made to eat dirt, no need to look sour about that," the monkey said, a small mischievous giggle escaping his lips.

Yama’s frown deepened, seeing this annoying monkey come to mess with him. However, as much as he would love to kill the annoying monkey, he knew it was just a projection of an avatar of the Monkey King.
Basically, killing him was impossible...
"Don’t worry. After the awakening is over, you will have your chance to kill the main perpetrator of your humiliation today.
It is, of course, just too bad you won’t remember who the Paragon is until he chooses to reveal himself or finally becomes a god.
But either way, you will get a chance to get your revenge..."
The monkey turned toward the direction Vexthra went and smiled. "Though I wouldn’t count on that. After all, you just got your ass handed to you by an unknown woman."
With one more giggle, the monkey left, leaving Yama to seethe quietly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080: The Grand Arcana Planet Formation
paragraphs: Alina formed a hand seal, and a large formation that covered the entire planet opened. Every last crevice is covered by the formation.
"Finally," Elaine said, a relieved expression appearing on her face.
Ingrid smiled, seeing that the guard duty was finally over. It had already been an hour and a half since they arrived on the battlefield, and so far, they had yet to kill a single enemy.
This is, of course, because Alina was working on creating a grand formation she believed would one day become the greatest formation in the entire universe.
Nobody asked her to create something like that...
However, as someone who had great love for arrays and formations, when she saw the formation the Paragon created on the battlefield, she was inspired.
This made her spend an hour and a half creating something extraordinary. But now that she was done, the two sisters could finally get some action.
Alina turned and looked at Elaine and Ingrid. She smiled, watching their annoyed expressions...
"You two should be grateful. Although you were practically useless in the creation process, standing guard while I created the Grand Arcana Planet Formation should be your good fortune.
What I have just created will one day go down in history as the greatest formation in the vast universe.

Not only have I created a defensive shield that can withstand even an attack from a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior right now, but if given just one month, even an Empyrean will struggle to leave a dent in it.
Now imagine this formation being active for a year or two. Tell me, would even a Root Immortal be able to leave a crack in it?
But that is not all. The offensive arrays I have placed in can now kill a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior with a single attack... Just give it one year, and an Immortal will cry tears of blood.
Of course, since I am amazing and super intelligent, I created an Expansion Matrix—the kind that will one day expand to the nearby planets surrounding this one.
If it manages to spread to just 25 planets, it will be next to impossible to break the formation unless dozens of gods attack it several times.
Of course, I will leave your imagination to what then happens when it spreads to 50-plus planets."
Alina grinned at her sisters, causing Ingrid to smirk...
Elaine, however, was more than annoyed. "So we waited an hour and a half just for you to create something we can’t use now but in the future?"
"That—" The busty Alina tried to speak, but her words couldn’t come out.

"While we are under attack now, instead of creating something that can save us now, you instead wasted our time on something of no immediate use. Shouldn’t you have done that when all of this is over?"
Alina gave Elaine a guilty smile. "In my defense, I never asked you two to stand guard, so—"
Elaine lunged at Alina, and Ingrid grabbed her, making sure the angry Elaine didn’t accidentally bury the busty Alina, who couldn’t stop herself from laughing.
"If I don’t spank that big ass of yours today, then I am not Elaine." Ingrid smiled, feeling like Elaine was just looking for an excuse to land a few slaps on Alina’s majestic ass.
"What is happening here?" Suddenly, Vexthra asked, stepping out of a portal, Gaia, Akira, and Dori following behind.
"Big sister, could you believe Alina made us stand guard for an hour and a half just so she could create a formation of no immediate use, claiming it is for the future when nobody asked for it.
I mean, even if she wanted to create something that majestic, why shouldn’t she wait until after the battle before doing that?
Long story short, she wasted my time, and I want to punish her by landing a few slaps on her beautiful ass."
Vexthra smiled.
She read the expressions on all three sisters’ faces, and she could tell Alina indeed intentionally wasted their time.
But as to why she did that, Vexthra didn’t know... but would soon.
"I will be sure to allow you to do that when we are back inside the tower. For now, why don’t you go help your sisters?"
Elaine nodded, gave Alina’s fine ass a look before teleporting away. Ingrid just smiled and also teleported away.
Once they were gone, Vexthra turned to Alina. "Spill it. Why did you spend so much time working on something useless in this immediate battle?"
"It is not useless, big sister. Just watch."
Alina formed a hand seal, and in an instant, on the battlefield where Val was fighting alongside a Phoenix and a dragon, swords appeared in the air and suddenly started overwhelming the enemy.
"This is Val’s ’Sword Rain’ technique," Vexthra said, a little startled.
Soon, those injured by the swords started coughing up blood.
"That is Velyra’s Blood Poison technique." Vexthra noticed yet another skill that only Velyra used.
Soon, however, she started recognizing more. All skills manifesting in the formation belong to her sisters.

"The reason why I took too much time in creating the formation was because I was copying the techniques being used by my sisters. Elaine and Ingrid were excluded because copying their techniques is, for some reason, impossible.

I tried it a couple of times when working on my battlefield matrix, but I copied their skills. So, making them wait was a way for me to easily isolate them. Now, I am done, and the formation itself will start learning new techniques."
Vexthra looked at Alina for a few minutes before a smile appeared on her face. "Your big brain does match your ass."
Even a god was impressed by how magnificently Alina’s brain worked. ’One day, she is going to bring gods crashing down with a mere wave of her Rune Knife.’
Clearly, Vexthra couldn’t wait for that day.
"Go help your sisters... Although this formation is excellent, it still pales in comparison to some of the formations I saw you making a few days ago."
Alina nodded and retrieved five Formation Jade Stones, then activated the formations hidden within them.
In no time, four killing formations and one defense formation opened, announcing Alina’s presence on the battlefield.
"What a monster," Vexthra smiled, watching her sister go.
After a few seconds watching her sisters, she looked toward where Kent was fighting... ’How are you holding up?’ she asked, using the harem connection.
[Aside from bleeding from a stab wound and a few other life-threatening injuries, I am as docile as a dolphin.]
’Nothing to worry about then. Seems like you are having so much fun.’
[You have no idea.]
Kent smiled, meeting the sword of a monarch, and then he was forced to activate split bodies and swap with one of the clones, completely evading a spear that came from a different monarch.
[How was your trip?]
’Boring. Gods in this universe are very weak. I took just three steps, and he was eating dirt.’
BANG
Perhaps Kent shouldn’t have asked. Because of the unexpected answer he received from Vexthra, he stopped in his tracks when he should have moved.
That one distraction was enough for the enemy to make good use of it. However, the poor guy failed to land a killing blow.
Now, he is going to be the next target Kent would take out.
But first, he had to handle the pain he was in...

chapters.title: Chapter 1081: The Legion Dominates (1)
paragraphs: "Ouch. That hurts." Kent wince, feeling a wave of pain seep into his body.
[Vexthra, my love, never say such outrageous things ever again. You might just cause my death in the most unexpected way.]
’Sorry, dear... I was just speaking the truth.’
[I know you were. But in case you are not aware, the current you is just a step away from becoming a Supreme. This makes you several times stronger than other gods.
In fact, calling you a god is an insult; you should be called a Pseudo-Supreme.]
Vexthra smiled, feeling slightly happy to hear such loving words from her man.
Though what Kent said was no exaggeration. Vexthra indeed was a Pseudo-Supreme, meaning she was way out of the league of gods.
’Just focus on your battle. I am going to watch over the Paragon.’ Vexthra said, ending the conversation before she accidentally caused her man’s death.
[Suit yourself. Though when you look at his face, don’t get charmed. He may be easy on the eyes and extremely strong, but soon, I will surpass him... just saying.]
Vexthra smirked and flew away.
Kent was just too annoying sometimes.
Kent laughed and continued to fight, adding to his battle experience and gradually reducing the number of monarch criminals.
Also, using the soul map, he was now able to observe a few things, now that he wasn’t fighting Nirvana Stage warriors.
"Mountain Fist!" Kaizo’s voice boomed as he jumped high into the air and landed a powerful punch on a monarch while descending.
The monarch was sent flying back 3 meters before another punch landed on his back, sending him hurtling back toward Kaizo.
The person who landed the punch was another giant like Kaizo, his fist covered in dark scales.
"Die already." Golden lightning surrounded Kaizo’s fist as he smashed the poor guy’s face. His asymmetrical face caved in, and blood gushed out.
It took just a few seconds for him to succumb to death.
Kaizo looked at the giant man and nodded. The giant nodded back...
"They call me Kaizo." He extended his hand for a shake in the middle of battle...
"Lord Trench."
It was a brief introduction, but a sense of camaraderie was born between them.

The next second, they were back to smashing their fists into heads and chests. Kaizo was a brute through and through. But despite Zareth and Vaelros also being brutes, the true bruteness was not felt from them.

A true brute is one who uses their own body as a weapon. Kaizo used his fists, and so did Lord Trench. The brutes he had met so far all wielded colossal weapons, such as axes, hammers, and giant swords.
However, in the Fist department, it was only Lord Trench who had so far proven to be a user of fists in combat.
On another side of the battlefield, Aetheris, the flame brute, was creating so much chaos in one section of the battlefield.
Naturally, he was surrounded on all sides by raging flames, creating the perfect domain for someone like him to fight.
Beside him, Vaelros, the Chain User in the Undead Legion, was also creating chaos unlike any other. The two were surrounded by over 30 monarchs.
However, with Aetheris’ overwhelming attack power, the monarchs were even scared to get close, much less attack him.
Vaelros was also doing his job in the defense department. His chains were just too deadly for someone at his level. Even the monarchs couldn’t break through them.
Slowly, they kept pushing back, killing whenever they got a chance.
"This is just too beautiful," Nykali, the Shade King, said, his expression amusing.

He stood atop a Spirit Dragon, overlooking a large battlefield of spirit wraiths wreaking havoc on the poor Neburians, who were stranded on Earth after their king died and the portal to their world closed.
"I was told there is no surrender," Nykali spoke, watching as his spirit wraith entered a Domain-stage body through his nose.
A few seconds later, his body withered away, leaving only a hollow husk, slumping to the ground.
"Personally, I hate surrender. It makes the battle boring. I mean, wouldn’t you guys hate it when you are at the cusp of winning, only for your opponents to call for retreat?
I know I will hate that. That is why, knowing you guys are done for, I cannot bring myself to spare your pitiful lives.

You are all going to die. However, you can decide how you die. It can be merciful, where I will just take you out with a wave of my hand, or painful, where my shades enter your body, feed on your soul and body.
Your pick."
Nykali grinned.
"I like your style... very evil." Suddenly, a dark-haired, handsome man appeared beside him and spoke.
"You are?"
"You can call me Asmodeus... many call me the Undead King," Asmodeus grinned.
"I am Nykali, the Shade King."
The two evil men grinned, watching thousands of warriors screaming, some begging to be spared, while those who wanted an easy death knelt, their hands raised.
"There is no mercy in the ways of the evil," Asmodeus said, looking at those surrendering, asking for an easy death.

"The human brain is easy to fool. They think that after killing the innocent, they will have it easy." Nykali waved his hand, and then the warriors who surrendered were immediately engulfed by thousands of wraiths.
Asmodeus also joined in by summoning skeletons holding hammers and nails. "How about we send them all away in the most evil and painful way possible..."
"I like the sound of that. Traumatizing scums before they die is the most pleasing thing you can ever feel. I would love to see how much longer they can hold out before they stop screaming."
"Then let’s make it a memorable one."

Soon, screams that even made some Earth warriors tremble and grow pale filled the battlefield. Asmodeus and Nykali were making sure that, when these poor souls reincarnate, this trauma would follow them.
Meanwhile, Veydris and Irina were having a blast inside the void.
The two were known for frequenting the void, so the moment they arrived on Earth, they entered the void to start launching sneak attacks.
Obviously, it was something they do better.
However, this time, things were different.
When they entered the void, they were shocked to find over forty people trapped there. Initially, the people trapped there thought Irina and Veydris were also trapped there.
However, soon, they learned that the two were on the side of the one who trapped them.
Naturally, they tried to kill them. However, Irina and Veydris had fought many battles in the void, so they weren’t about to be overwhelmed by bugs.
Hours passed, but in the void, it felt like not even a second had passed.
Veydris, with his giant sword, and Irina, with her twin short swords, killed twenty-two warriors, but they still had thirty-eight more to kill.
Veydris swung his massive sword, cleaving through the misty air of the void, almost making it appear real.
The concept of air in the void is not too realistic, but in a way, possible.
The void is timeless and shapeless, so while it can’t be quantified, it can be given some properties and aspects.
Having air made it more of a place a person could stay...
Of course, they say the void was once home to many, but when the Big Bang happened, it was forced to move away, making way for the shaped and timed universe to form.

chapters.title: Chapter 1082: The Legion Dominates (2)
paragraphs: So the void did have air, and in some aspects, also time. But as to how it works or could be navigated, it all depended on how one chose to see the void.

The space rippled with each strike, sending shockwaves that shredded anything too close. A man in black armor tried to block with his shield, but the force crushed him into fragments of light and dust.
Veydris was using Void Energy inside the void. This made every attack several times stronger. And while he was facing beings far stronger than him, inside the void, they were forty percent weaker.
So while Veydris and Irina were perhaps fighting at two hundred percent of their usual strength, their opponents were severely weakened.
Irina spun beside him, her twin short swords glinting with a silver hue. She dashed between enemies, her movements fluid and unpredictable.
One moment, she was in front of a warrior, and the next, behind him, slashing his throat open before his mind could even process it.
Blood drifted upward like floating red mist.
"Don’t let them escape!" one of the trapped warriors shouted, gathering a burst of blue flame in his palm. He hurled it forward, lighting up the void.

Irina smiled. "I don’t know how you see or what way your eyes work, but we aren’t trying to escape. We actually want to kill you guys, so don’t worry, you will have plenty of chances to make us not have a way to escape."
She stepped sideways, and the flame passed harmlessly by. She flicked her wrist, and a short blade of pure void energy pierced through the man’s chest.
Irina laughed, a chilling sound that made even the void tremble. "I guess you won’t be around to make us not have what it takes to escape."
Veydris swung again, his sword releasing a shockwave that sent five warriors flying into a broken fragment of void space. The fragment shattered, devouring them instantly.
They probably would die in the most horrible way possible.

Entering a broken fragment of void space was like entering a pressing room full of needles. The closer the walls moved, the more piercing one would feel, only that this time, the pain would be ten times more painful.
It would feel like the void was closing in on you over and over again until everything went dark.

Irina landed beside Veydris, her boots barely touching the glossy, grassy ground. "Veydris, have I ever told you how hot you look whenever you do badass things?" she flirted, slashing through another warrior’s abdomen.
Veydris said nothing because he didn’t speak. But if he could speak, he would have told her to focus on the battle and stop wasting her time on pointless flirts.
Irina had this obsession with Veydris that even Kent couldn’t wrap his mind around. Of course, he was happy for his pal.
However, Veydris was a robot with virtually no emotions, while Irina was a beautiful woman whom many men would kill to have.
So this obsession toward Veydris made Kent wonder just what she was after...
Aside from teaming up, which one had to say—they were pretty damn good. Veydris couldn’t sexually satisfy her because, well, the guy was a robot with no dick.
However, Irina always found time to flirt with him.
But, as always, Veydris just ignored her and focused on what he was after—killing these bastards.
Another group of ten surrounded them. Each one unleashed their power at once—light, fire, darkness, and metal mixed into a storm of chaos.
Veydris raised his sword and slammed it into the ground. A pulse of dark red energy erupted from him, disintegrating everything within a ten-meter radius.
Irina used the opening to launch her own silent attack.
She jumped high, spinning through the air, her blades forming a whirl of silver light. "Whispering Cut!" she yelled.
The attack sliced through five warriors at once, leaving their bodies floating lifelessly in the void.
"Twenty-nine," Irina counted with a grin. "Only thirty-one more."

"Correction." The next second, Irina said, flicking her blade to remove the blood. "I believe that makes it twenty-eight." She pointed behind him, where one warrior’s body was slowly dissolving into shadow dust.
Veydris was a multitasker.
They continued moving together, their rhythm perfect. Every time Veydris swung, Irina followed. Every time Irina moved, Veydris guarded.
Their teamwork was seamless, and as they continued to fight, they built on that experience, strengthening their team further.
Meanwhile, Sylara had slowly raised her strength to a terrifying new level just from drinking the blood of her opponents.
She kept draining them, making sure every kill gave her something. The more she drank, the stronger she got until finally, she became a red blur on the battlefield.
She was just like Kent; they had no limit.
The more blood she drank, the stronger she got. There was no limit to how far she could raise her strength.
Even without her Blood Hunger Seal, she could continue to raise her strength. The only downside to this boost, now that she didn’t have her blood hunger seal, was that it was temporary.
She would lose everything after forty-eight hours.
However, with the Blood Hunger Seal, she could keep her strength permanent, making her a menace in combat.
But since they were fighting against beings far stronger than they were, she could only work on building the strength that even monarchs would be afraid of.
’If only I had my Blood Hunger. This battle would have raised my strength to the point that even I could go a few rounds with immortals.’
Sylara sighed and made a promise to herself. ’Next time, I will form more than one Blood Hunger deal. This way, sacrificing one wouldn’t affect me much.’
After saying that to herself, she ran toward Queenie’s direction. She could tell Queenie was also a blood user, so it was best if they exchanged a few pointers and saw where it led.
Kent used the soul map and saw that the battle would soon end.
Though his side had lost so many warriors, winning in the end was all that mattered.

The angels were down to the last few, and the monarchs were also down to less than 1,500. As for the Neburians, he could tell they were as good as dead, especially with Nykali and Asmodeus taking charge.
’In the end, it is all about winning. Those who died will be celebrated, and those still living will continue to grow so that one day, they can get revenge for the dead.’
Kent sighed.
He could only wish he had the power to prevent all this—the senseless deaths and the cheating the heavens did to make sure the Paragon suffered. If he had the means, he would have prevented all that.
But in the end, it was all about who got the last laugh.
The Paragon and his people would, and that alone was more than enough to make the heavens cry blood.
Suddenly, Kent saw Paragon kill the demi-dragon. But right when he did, a powerful aura came from the demi-lion, pushing Paragon back.
Kent’s eyes narrowed as a powerful, life-threatening feeling emanated from the demi-lion. ’I can’t take on this person even if I use my True Dragon form,’ Kent said.
However, when he turned to look at Paragon, he saw a smile appear on Paragon’s face...
’Oh, this should be fun.’
