chapters.title: Chapter 1083: Creating Bonds (1)
paragraphs: The moment Kent saw Paragon smile, he knew something was about to happen.
He hadn’t seen the battle from the start, so he couldn’t tell how much Paragon had to endure in order to get to where he is now.
However, knowing the battle lasted over 3 hours and that Paragon was bleeding severely, he could tell it was very chaotic.
This only made everything worse.
There is no telling what kind of danger he had faced; however, watching him smile told him something that even Kent never knew was possible for a person to go through.
’It seems he endured the past three hours out of necessity when he could have tried to kill these people.’ This doesn’t make any sense to Kent.
’If he had what it took to kill them, then why hasn’t he done that?’
The concept of toying with your opponent before killing them is not something Kent is friends with, so he can tell Paragon didn’t toy with his opponents.
This means that, even though he had the means to kill his opponents, he refused, suggesting that there is a much deeper meaning to it.
Kent soon figured out why Paragon had to do what he did. The rest of the course will come to him in due time.

’It seems he doesn’t think these four are the final boss. He is still expecting someone much stronger, and so overexerting himself to kill these losers will prove fatal when the real challenge comes.’

Kent sighed and was forced back into combat, but he kept an eye on Paragon. Soon, when he saw a darkly clothed lady appear and merge with him. It was then that he understood where the smile came from.
’What a sneaky little brat. He is much more cunning than I am.’

Kent blocked a spear stabbing at his heart. ’Looks like I should become more cunning and cruel when I go back. Just because the heavens like me in my universe doesn’t mean the gods will favor me too.’
If only Kent knew that there were dozens of gods waiting for him just because he killed a single tiger.
But for now, his focus was on killing more monarchs. To be able to form the second Blood Core gate, he must kill more and harvest more Blood Essence.
So keeping a part of his focus on Paragon, he continued to kill his way across the battlefield.
Meanwhile, Vexthra, who had decided to observe the battle between Paragon and the four remaining warriors, was instantly drawn to the darkly clad lady playing the zither...

’The Law of Death is rooted in this music. If I can copy even a single one of them, helping Kent when he reaches the Death Stage will be easy,’ Vexthra said as her focus, instead of being on Paragon, had now found its root on Maud, the Deathheart.
Soon, she began to see patterns as more notes were played.
"While this universe is messed up, when it comes to how visible the laws are, they are much better than my universe. It is like the laws are loose and can be manipulated however they want.
If Kent could come back here when he reaches the Empyrean Stage to learn the laws, he would make progress much faster."
This discovery led her to turn away from Maud and begin watching Paragon...
"As expected, the laws aren’t having much hold on him. With this, if he grows much stronger, even before becoming an immortal, the laws will become completely useless when going against him."
"What a monster."
Of course, that was Vexthra, the goddess of hatred and resentment, talking. The real her saw the death of humans trying to save their world, and that broke her heart...
However, as a god, she knew everything had a cause and effect, so she knew those responsible would be held accountable.
After watching Paragon for a while, she turned back to Maud.
Although she can’t fight, she can find ways to help her man become much stronger. Her sisters are doing the fighting.
"What is your name?" Lady Enzi asked a blue-haired beauty whose expression was calm, sweat trickling down her forehead as she held her spear firmly.
"I am Enzi, in case you are wondering.
The blue-haired lady looked at her and nodded. After all, just when she was on her last leg, this lady came to her aid.
"I am Asha, and these are my insect army."
"Cool. I have never seen an insect queen before."
Asha looked at Lady Enzi for a few seconds before giving her a polite smile, "Well, now you have, so I guess that should be cool, right?"
"You have no idea." The conversation was simple, but a lot was said.
Asha saw through Lady Enzi’s scheme, but knowing it was for a good cause, she feigned ignorance.
The truth is, Lady Enzi is scared of insects - terrified even.
She had a not-so-pleasant encounter with insects when she was young, so her fear of them is very deep. However, now it seems she has solved half her problem by fighting alongside insect soldiers.
The other half will be solved when she actually battles a swarm of insects.
"Well, happy chatting with you." Lady Enzi teleported through her glass domain and appeared on a different battlefield.
Asha sighed, "She is a weird one."
She turned back to her insect army and started giving them instructions. Soon, they dispersed to separate battlefields to help the warriors in dealing with the last remaining pest.
Velyra decided to fight beside her father and her tribesmen.

The Bloodvein Tribe is a warrior tribe. Just like the Asura in this universe, they are also created for battle. However, unlike the Asura who value battles more than anything, the Bloodvein Tribe is more about finding peace...
They serve the Mother of Killers, so they try to live up to her expectations. After all, the Mother of Killers was a daughter of war. She was born on the battlefield and died on the battlefield.
Of course, the idea that they wanted peace was also from the Mother of Killers. After her many battles, she sought peace, and she had it for a while before she picked up her spear again.
So they wanted nothing more than to bring peace to this world. Due to their resolve, a strange form of strength filled them as they fought the warriors.
They fought on the same battlefield as the vampires, so it was like neighbors fighting for a cause. They are, after all, blood users.
There is one other person on the battlefield beside them who caught Velyra’s attention, so when the battle relaxed a little, she approached her...
"Nice weapon," Velyra said, causing the dark-haired lady to look at her with a raised eyebrow.
"I know, red skin does make one stand out," Velyra said with a sigh.

"No, no... I wasn’t looking at you from that angle. I was just taken aback by how beautiful you look. If not for already being married, I would have already swept you off your feet. Who knew the red color would look this darn good on a lady?" the dark-haired beauty said with a smile.
"By the way, I am Eshira, but they mostly call me Princess Eshira."
"I am Velyra. Nice meeting you," Velyra said, also with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 1084: Creating Bonds (2)
paragraphs: Eshira raised her weapon and looked at it. "It was a gift from my husband. He gave it to me after making me work nonstop for nine good years." Eshira smiled, looking in Paragon’s direction.
Velyra also smiled. She could tell there was more to what Eshira said, but she didn’t pry into her business. Instead, she focused more on knowing more about this world.
After Eshira spent some time explaining the dynamics of this world to her, after a couple of minutes, she seemed to have a handle on how things work around here.
"So aside from humans, there are also water-borns, ice-borns, vampires, moon-borns, and finally the Bast race."
"Yes. It is a small world, but it contains many amazing cultures. Just the human race alone has more than 100 different cultures."
"What an interesting world." Velyra, who had been locked up in the Dead Region for centuries, wanted to learn more about other worlds now that she is out.

In fact, the idea of traveling to explore and learn about other cultures was something she wanted to do once they ascended. She wanted to see the universe beyond and learn more about the amazing people who fill it.
Her sisters promised to take her around and explore many worlds once they ascended. But getting the chance to learn more about this world was also good enough.
Now, she just wanted to find a way to come back when there is no war to experience all the amazing things Eshira told her about Earth.
After more discussion, they decided to put a pin in it until they meet again. For now, they must protect this world.
Selene also made a friend, however, not in the way one would expect.
From the moment she arrived on the battlefield, she sensed a strong attachment toward a certain green-scaled Devouring Snake.
Without even wasting time, she ran off to the side of such a magnificent serpent.
Initially, she wanted to have a talk with her to teach her how to harness the power of Devouring. However, she realized she was under pressure, so she first used her own sword to help reduce it.
When the pressure finally calmed and the snake turned into her pretty, green-haired, gorgeous human form, she decided to have the talk.
"I have to say, this is my first time seeing such a gorgeous lady devouring her enemies. Tell me, how does it work?" Selene was genuinely interested.
After all, one of the many abilities she received after awakening her Primordial Space was the Devourer skill.
She had tried many times to use it, but she seemed to be missing something. So, finally seeing someone in action using the power of the Devourer, she knew she had to make good use of this encounter.
"By the way, I am Selene."
"You can call me Lumia, and can we have this talk after we are done with everything... once we are done with this battlefield at least."
"I see." Selene was disappointed, but she knew Lumia’s words were indeed the truth. Also, since Lumia was fighting to save her world, she knew making sure her people were safe took priority.

Selene didn’t press further. Instead, she stood beside Lumia, silently watching as the serpent woman unleashed another wave of her devouring aura. The battlefield trembled, and the faint whispers of consumed souls echoed in the air.
Lumia’s power is strange. The beings she devours, she can use their resentful spirits in combat.
It is like the more she devours, the more resentful souls she absorbs, allowing her to later unleash a wave of power fueled by her Devourer powers.
Her power is in a way similar to Sylara’s blood devouring ability. However, in Lumia’s case, the more she devoured, the stronger she became.
There is no expiry date, unlike Sylara, who loses her power after 48 hours.

The two women fought back-to-back, their movements forming a pattern that soon synergized into a rhythm, the kind that suggests they are experienced warriors and can easily resonate with one another in battle.
Selene’s spatial blades carved through enemies with quiet precision, while Lumia’s devouring aura consumed everything that touched her shadow.
The weaker opponents were dying en masse, while the stronger ones slowly got pushed back or consumed.
Between each clash and scream, a strange calm lingered.
"You’ve seen this kind of battle before, haven’t you?" Lumia’s tone was low, almost lost beneath the chaos of battle.
Selene tilted her head slightly, slicing through a Neburian that lunged from behind. "Too many times. But this one feels... different."
Lumia gave no answer, only smiled faintly.
Then she asked, "How is this any different from the ones you have seen and participated in?"
Selene sighed for a moment and then replied, "The ones I witnessed and participated in mostly showed us having the upper hand... my sisters and I.
However, in this one, I saw how cruel those with higher power can be. They abused their power, and that alone makes this a completely different battle.
In a way, it feels like fighting a losing battle, yet we are winning somehow. It just doesn’t make any sense."
After a while, Selene spoke again, her voice soft but firm. "Do you ever wonder what happens after all this?"
Lumia paused, her devouring field flickering for a moment before returning. "Wondering leads nowhere. Survival first. Understanding later."
Selene’s lips curved in a faint smile. "You sound like someone very angry."
"Oh, I am very angry. I am so furious that if I don’t hold myself back, I might just go berserk." Lumia shot a green beam from her eyes, piercing a hole in a Neburian warrior’s head.
"Now, we wouldn’t want me going berserk. I just got married, so I have no plans on going back into the jungle simply because I can’t hold back my anger."
Selene chuckled, knowing the lady meant business, yet she found a way to keep herself grounded.
In a way, she wasn’t only making herself appear calm, but she kept reminding herself to remain grounded and that she should remind herself of what she is fighting for.
"We should indeed have this conversation when everything is said and done," Selene said before cutting another warrior in half.
The more the battle raged on, the closer everything seemed to get.
Kaizo and the rest of the legion were doing their best. That is all they could do, after all; their opponents weren’t greenhouse flowers either.
So the closer they got to the finish line, the stronger they felt, knowing that soon the battle would come to an end.
"I have to say, until there is another world-ending event where the odds are stacked against us, I will miss this universe and this battle," Kaizo said, his expression showing a sigh of regret.
If it were up to Kaizo, then this battle shouldn’t end anytime soon. He enjoyed the thrill of battle, so he would very much love to keep going for as long as it could last...
Not that he would ever be satisfied.
When Kent was creating him, the personalities he gave him were just too much. Now, he can’t live without battle.

After more discussion, they decided to put a pin in it until they meet again.
For now, they must protect this world.
Selene also made a friend, however, not in the way one would expect.
From the moment she arrived on the battlefield, she sensed a strong attachment toward a certain green-scaled Devouring Snake.
Without even wasting time, she ran off to the side of such a magnificent serpent.
Initially, she wanted to have a talk with her to teach her how to harness the power of Devouring.
However, she realized she was under pressure, so she first used her own sword to help reduce it.
When the pressure finally calmed and the snake turned into her pretty, green-haired, gorgeous human form, she decided to have the talk.
"I have to say, this is my first time seeing such a gorgeous lady devouring her enemies.
Tell me, how does it work?" Selene was genuinely interested.
After all, one of the many abilities she received after awakening her Primordial Space was the Devourer skill.
She had tried many times to use it, but she seemed to be missing something.
So, finally seeing someone in action using the power of the Devourer, she knew she had to make good use of this encounter.
"By the way, I am Selene."
"You can call me Lumia, and can we have this talk after we are done with everything... once we are done with this battlefield at least."
"I see." Selene was disappointed, but she knew Lumia’s words were indeed the truth.
Also, since Lumia was fighting to save her world, she knew making sure her people were safe took priority.
Selene didn’t press further.
Instead, she stood beside Lumia, silently watching as the serpent woman unleashed another wave of her devouring aura.
The battlefield trembled, and the faint whispers of consumed souls echoed in the air.
Lumia’s power is strange.
The beings she devours, she can use their resentful spirits in combat.
It is like the more she devours, the more resentful souls she absorbs, allowing her to later unleash a wave of power fueled by her Devourer powers.
Her power is in a way similar to Sylara’s blood devouring ability.
However, in Lumia’s case, the more she devoured, the stronger she became.
There is no expiry date, unlike Sylara, who loses her power after 48 hours.

The two women fought back-to-back, their movements forming a pattern that soon synergized into a rhythm, the kind that suggests they are experienced warriors and can easily resonate with one another in battle.
Selene’s spatial blades carved through enemies with quiet precision, while Lumia’s devouring aura consumed everything that touched her shadow.
The weaker opponents were dying en masse, while the stronger ones slowly got pushed back or consumed.
Between each clash and scream, a strange calm lingered.
"You’ve seen this kind of battle before, haven’t you?" Lumia’s tone was low, almost lost beneath the chaos of battle.
Selene tilted her head slightly, slicing through a Neburian that lunged from behind.
"Too many times.
But this one feels... different."
Lumia gave no answer, only smiled faintly.
Then she asked, "How is this any different from the ones you have seen and participated in?"
Selene sighed for a moment and then replied, "The ones I witnessed and participated in mostly showed us having the upper hand... my sisters and I.
However, in this one, I saw how cruel those with higher power can be.
They abused their power, and that alone makes this a completely different battle.
In a way, it feels like fighting a losing battle, yet we are winning somehow.
It just doesn’t make any sense."
After a while, Selene spoke again, her voice soft but firm.
"Do you ever wonder what happens after all this?"
Lumia paused, her devouring field flickering for a moment before returning.
"Wondering leads nowhere.
Survival first.
Understanding later."
Selene’s lips curved in a faint smile.
"You sound like someone very angry."
"Oh, I am very angry.
I am so furious that if I don’t hold myself back, I might just go berserk." Lumia shot a green beam from her eyes, piercing a hole in a Neburian warrior’s head.
"Now, we wouldn’t want me going berserk.
I just got married, so I have no plans on going back into the jungle simply because I can’t hold back my anger."
Selene chuckled, knowing the lady meant business, yet she found a way to keep herself grounded.
In a way, she wasn’t only making herself appear calm, but she kept reminding herself to remain grounded and that she should remind herself of what she is fighting for.
"We should indeed have this conversation when everything is said and done," Selene said before cutting another warrior in half.
The more the battle raged on, the closer everything seemed to get.
Kaizo and the rest of the legion were doing their best.
That is all they could do, after all; their opponents weren’t greenhouse flowers either.
So the closer they got to the finish line, the stronger they felt, knowing that soon the battle would come to an end.
"I have to say, until there is another world-ending event where the odds are stacked against us, I will miss this universe and this battle," Kaizo said, his expression showing a sigh of regret.
If it were up to Kaizo, then this battle shouldn’t end anytime soon.
He enjoyed the thrill of battle, so he would very much love to keep going for as long as it could last...
Not that he would ever be satisfied.
When Kent was creating him, the personalities he gave him were just too much.
Now, he can’t live without battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1085: Creating Bonds (3)
paragraphs: Unity, who was much closer to Kaizo, smirked, hearing the frustration in Kaizo’s voice.
"You know, these people are actually fighting to save their world. So while their suffering was a thrill to you, maybe try being human for once and see this battle coming to an end as a good thing.
If you want non-stop battles, then wait. Once we go back, the dungeon is waiting for us to clear."
Kaizo grinned, smashing the head of a Monarch with his fist.
"I understand, Unity. I will not say such things out loud. Next time, I will say it inwardly." Unity just shook her head.
"Don’t mind him. He was dropped on his head when his mama gave birth to him," Unity said to her new bestie, Hanna, who was also an archer.
"I understand. We have one of him in this universe, too. His name is Danny." Hanna smiled and looked in the direction Danny was fighting. "I believe he is that mountain of a man over there."
Unity turned and looked at Danny. "I get it. In any case, know that on the next visit, I hope you and I have a duel to see who is the best."
"I would love that."
Unity fired an arrow, and Hanna also cemented today’s promise with her own arrow. But for now, ending the battle would be the next best thing.
Nara and Mara also made friends.
"So you three are Elementals," Nara said, looking toward three identical twins who, after a very chaotic battle, took a few hours of rest before coming back again.
They were identical, but each had different hair and eye colors. These distinctions were determined by the nature and color of their elements.
"Yes. I am Aria, an Ice Elemental," the blue-haired beauty said.
"I am Stella, a Fire Elemental," the silver-white-haired beauty also introduced herself.
"And I am Nova, a Lightning Elemental," the redhead also said.
Nara smiled and said, "I am Nara, half human, half wraith, and this is my baby sister, an angel as you can see."
Mara grinned. "We had the same mother and father... in case you are wondering."
Naturally, the three elemental sisters were wondering the same thing. How could two sisters, born of the same parents, be virtually different in race and appearance?
They were both beauties, but one was basically a demon and the other an angel. These two didn’t swim in the same pond, so being sisters was rather unexpected.
"We clearly didn’t wonder why you two are different yet the same. Trust us, we have some of them in our family too," Nova said with a small smile.
"Believe it or not, but we have a mother who is made of fire just like me, a twin daughter who is basically made of poison, and her twin sister made from blood. So we get you."
The five ladies laughed.
"Being in a large harem opens your eyes to see many weird yet beautiful things." Mara and the ladies nodded.
"So, do you ladies also have a schedule for when you get to be with your man?" Nara asked, and Mara added, "We created one just a few days ago before coming here."
Aria looked at her sisters. "We don’t have such an arrangement yet, but we will implement it soon. Though I have to ask... how did you ladies arrange it?"
"Two or maybe three per night. Of course, we also put measures in place so that one of us can have a night to remember if we do something good that impresses our man.
Of course, we both know Alina will get all the goodies, not because she has a magnificent ass, but her brain is always creating something good... Such a bitch," Nara smirked, and Mara chuckled.
Aria, Stella, and Nova grinned. "Oh, we understand. We have two of them, just that ours are also sisters with big beautiful jugs and butts."
Yet again, the ladies laughed, feeling the bond between them grow stronger.
"I wish we could talk to you three when we go back to our universe," Mara said with a sigh. Her sister tapped her shoulder and sighed too.
"Our man is a Paragon, so don’t worry, he will definitely find a way to open a doorway to your universe one of these days," Stella said, and her sisters nodded.
"He sure would. Just don’t be too surprised when you suddenly see us in your universe," Aria said with a small smile. They spent a few minutes planning what they would do once they met again.
After they had had enough fun, they moved to a different battlefield to help clear the rest of the enemies.
More friendships formed between the wives of the Paragon and Kent, promising to one day bring the two families together.
Hopefully, their next meeting wouldn’t be on a battlefield.

Time passed, and soon, the only battles that were happening were the ones where Nykali and Asmodeus kept torturing the pitiful warriors, and some random ones, mostly between Kent and the Monarchs he was farming blood essence from.
Soon, however, even Kent ended his battles and decided to watch Paragon battle the last three Nirvana Stage warriors.
"He is very strong. I wonder if he can survive a punch from me," Kaizo said, standing beside Kent.
The Chaos Dragon looked at Kaizo with the corner of his eye, a sudden urge to knock him overwhelming his senses.
"I need to check your brain and see if everything is alright in there," Kent said, causing those who heard him to laugh.

They could tell Kaizo was a brute through and through. However, they also saw him fight, which told them he was not a muscle brain. If anything, he was brilliant, but sometimes, the comments he made were just too brain-dead.
Clearly, everyone could tell that a single punch from the Paragon was enough to end their existence. However, despite knowing this, Kaizo still made such a comment.
"You know what, one of these days, I will send you down to hell to go have fun there," Kent said, and Kaizo’s eyes lit up...
"I would love that."
Kent just sighed. The brute was indeed all about battles.
A couple of minutes later, the scene of the battle changed. Paragon conjured some dark chains and bound the three together.
’Damn,’ Kent said inwardly, feeling his blood boil.

Suddenly, he saw a large red eye appear in the air, which, for some reason, froze the three instantly. Then, thousands of weapons appeared in the air, and with a wave, they shot forward, and like poking holes into tofu, the weapons pierced their bodies, ending them for good.
Thousands cheered as the three Nirvana Stage warriors were impaled by hundreds of weapons.
Kent smiled, watching as the tribulation slowly dissipated. When the last cloud left the sky, Kent sighed.
He turned and looked at Vexthra, who gave him a calm nod.
For a moment, there was peace and quiet, then the unexpected happened.
Paragon suddenly pushed his Vampire wife away just as a palm strike came striking at him from the void.
Instinctively, Kent tried to move. However, before he could, he saw the void open over Queenie, and yet another palm strike came.
"I got it." Vexthra moved and appeared between the attack and Queenie.
But then, Paragon had already taken the attack head-on, sending him flying back.
However, just when Vexthra was about to block the blow, Kent saw the space around her twist, and then she vanished.
"Vex-" Before Kent could finish his word, another void opened over Nari, freezing her in place.
"Just what in the hell?" He took his dragon form and appeared between the palm strike and Nari.
BOOM
Kent felt his world spin, but he willed himself to stay conscious. It was only when he stood up that he saw more void openings, and more attacks kept coming.
’Come on, Kent, you got this.’ Kent moved, and soon, his colossal body became a shield for more palm strikes.
Two minutes later, Kent was down to his last leg, thousands were injured, and Paragon was on the verge of death.
’Damn it.’
Kent willed himself to move and take Paragon’s place. He saw another attack coming for his wife, and so he decided to use his body as a shield.
However, Kent, knowing he might survive the attack but not his pal, whom he had never had a real conversation with, just yet, made up his mind to take his place...
However, before he could move, a calm yet furious voice spoke, and everything went still...
"ENOUGH."

chapters.title: Chapter 1086: Saving The Day
paragraphs: Among the many things Kent expected, he never saw the sudden attacks from the void coming. He truly was taken aback.
He saw Miriam get crashed to the ground when her sister took the palm strike for her. He also saw how Queenie lost her arm, and half her body was paralyzed.
He also saw how some of Paragon’s friends and wives used their bodies to shield the wives who had been attacked.
Then Paragon himself went down.
Kent himself saw death stare at him multiple times, but he endured, and thanks to how tough his body was, he managed to survive.
’If not for refining one Blood Life Seal, I would have died after taking the second strike,’ Kent said, feeling his healing abilities kick in.
"Kent, are you alright?" Elaine and some of his ladies appeared beside him while the rest went to check on Paragon’s wives.

Selene was even injured after she helped Lumia (the Devouring Serpent she talked with) take on the attack for her sisters. However, she wasn’t the main defender, so her injuries weren’t life-threatening.
Of course, she was hurt in more than one place. However, with her own healing abilities, she would recover. Her main focus was on her pal Lumia.
"I am fine, ladies." Although one arm was broken, a leg was dislocated, and a few ribs were shattered from the violent attacks, Kent didn’t seem to mind.
Suddenly, the void cracked again, and the ladies went on the offensive. However, when they saw ten men chained and thrown out, they knew they had nothing to worry about.
Vexthra was responsible.
[2 Minutes Ago]
When the void cracked and the attack aimed at Miriam came, Vexthra tried to save her. But before she could, her surroundings warped, and she found herself staring at ten gods.
"I am afraid we cannot allow you to interfere in this battle," one of them said, his expression teasing.
Vexthra turned and saw more cracks opening, attacks raining down.
With her advanced sight, she saw the attacks weren’t coming from the void, but instead, the void was being used as a channel to transport the attacks. The attacker was someone else entirely.
This made her extremely angry.

So she attacked, and the ten gods, although unwilling to fight her, knowing what she was capable of, also attacked. However, it became clear in the next few seconds that they came on a suicide mission.
"Although my husband hates slaves, he will be very happy to make you ten his first slaves," Vexthra bashed the head of a god against a metal she summoned.
Then her sword moved, and the Law of Hatred trailed a clean line, cutting a wound into the god’s body.

"Your blood essence will become his source of strength, and your bodies will be meat shields he will hide behind. If you can’t become gods with integrity, then becoming a thing to wipe one’s foot on is your only path."
In no time, all ten gods were suppressed completely, not even a single one of them having the means to resist.
Vexthra then channeled their own soul energy, forming chains from it to bind them. Afterward, she applied her Hatred and Resentment Law on the chains, fortifying them.
By then, two minutes had passed, and so she sent them back to Earth.
However, when her eyes landed on Kent, broken and battered, her heart skipped a beat.
Thankfully, Kent wasn’t severely injured.
"Are you alright?" she asked, and Kent gave her a calm nod.
"I am fine. Though I can’t say the same thing for my pal," Kent pointed at Paragon, who was resting in the arms of a woman.
"Go check if you can save him. I will be there once I can walk," Kent said before closing his eyes. He started making plans in his head while Elaine cast multiple healing spells on him.
He prepared for anything, but he never accounted for the heavens sending out such sudden attacks.
’Tower, any suggestions?’
⟦The master can use the Second Chance Talisman. However, the master must know that using the talisman requires someone to willingly exchange their life for the one being saved.
In other words, the Second Chance Talisman basically transfers one’s misfortune to another and vice versa.⟧
’I see. I never knew there was such a condition when I bought it. I didn’t even know why I purchased it. No matter how I use it, the ending will be dark and heartbreaking,’ Kent sighed.

⟦The master shouldn’t beat himself up. Although the master bought something that will bring pain, it will also save a life. The one who would be sacrificing themselves will have to willingly give their life. This means they will be doing so of their own accord.⟧
’I know, Tower, but that will depress the one being saved. Though they will be saved, they will also hate themselves forever. Trust me, I know what I am talking about.’
The Tower remained mute, unsure how to counter Kent’s words.
What he said was the truth, and so even the Tower understood.
[How about we use the god that Big sister Vexthra brought in chain?] Suddenly, Akira’s voice entered Kent’s head, making the Chaos Dragon sigh again.
’It has to be willingly, Akira. We cannot force them.’
[But we don’t have to.]
’What do you mean?’ Kent’s expression changed upon hearing Akira’s words.

[The three of us can alter the Second Chance spell, and whether willing or not, we can use them to save the Paragon. This universe is a mess, and now I can feel the heavens slowly losing control over this world.
This means we can break the rules and alter the spell, making it so that, whether they like it or not, they will become willing participants.]
’Well, I like it when things work out in the end,’ Kent smiled.
[Also, big sister Alina can use her healing formation to help save the ladies. This world is now a hub to defy the Heaven Dao and get away with it.]
With this, Kent chose to go all out.
[Why help my bro wake up when I can help him become stronger too?] Kent grinned, and with that, he put several plans in motion.

He was going to save Paragon, and when done, he would implant the cores of the gods inside his soul sea, which, aside from healing him, would help him reach the next stage. Remaining comatose wouldn’t be a problem.
The only downside was that Kent’s time was running out, so he had to hurry.
Seven hours later, the process was completed successfully. Although Paragon hadn’t woken up, his life was saved from harm.
In the end, he only used seven gods, but it was enough to save his pal. His wives were also saved, and they would soon be waking up. However, Paragon’s injuries were too severe.
It would take some time for his soul to heal and his body to return to its shape. In other words, he was saved from death’s door, but he wouldn’t be waking up anytime soon.
But it was already good enough.
However, Kent wasn’t happy that he never got to have a chat with Paragon. He wanted to have a heart-to-heart with the Paragon and even ask for some pointers on how to defy major odds like he did.
In the end, he settled for recording a video message while his wives said their final goodbyes.

Though I can’t say the same thing for my pal," Kent pointed at Paragon, who was resting in the arms of a woman.
"Go check if you can save him.
I will be there once I can walk," Kent said before closing his eyes.
He started making plans in his head while Elaine cast multiple healing spells on him.
He prepared for anything, but he never accounted for the heavens sending out such sudden attacks.
’Tower, any suggestions?’
⟦The master can use the Second Chance Talisman.
However, the master must know that using the talisman requires someone to willingly exchange their life for the one being saved.
In other words, the Second Chance Talisman basically transfers one’s misfortune to another and vice versa.⟧
’I see.
I never knew there was such a condition when I bought it.
I didn’t even know why I purchased it.
No matter how I use it, the ending will be dark and heartbreaking,’ Kent sighed.
⟦The master shouldn’t beat himself up.
Although the master bought something that will bring pain, it will also save a life.
The one who would be sacrificing themselves will have to willingly give their life.
This means they will be doing so of their own accord.⟧
’I know, Tower, but that will depress the one being saved.
Though they will be saved, they will also hate themselves forever.
Trust me, I know what I am talking about.’
The Tower remained mute, unsure how to counter Kent’s words.
What he said was the truth, and so even the Tower understood.
[How about we use the god that Big sister Vexthra brought in chain?] Suddenly, Akira’s voice entered Kent’s head, making the Chaos Dragon sigh again.
’It has to be willingly, Akira.
We cannot force them.’
[But we don’t have to.]
’What do you mean?’ Kent’s expression changed upon hearing Akira’s words.
[The three of us can alter the Second Chance spell, and whether willing or not, we can use them to save the Paragon.
This universe is a mess, and now I can feel the heavens slowly losing control over this world.
This means we can break the rules and alter the spell, making it so that, whether they like it or not, they will become willing participants.]
’Well, I like it when things work out in the end,’ Kent smiled.
[Also, big sister Alina can use her healing formation to help save the ladies.
This world is now a hub to defy the Heaven Dao and get away with it.]
With this, Kent chose to go all out.
[Why help my bro wake up when I can help him become stronger too?] Kent grinned, and with that, he put several plans in motion.
He was going to save Paragon, and when done, he would implant the cores of the gods inside his soul sea, which, aside from healing him, would help him reach the next stage.
Remaining comatose wouldn’t be a problem.
The only downside was that Kent’s time was running out, so he had to hurry.
Seven hours later, the process was completed successfully.
Although Paragon hadn’t woken up, his life was saved from harm.
In the end, he only used seven gods, but it was enough to save his pal.
His wives were also saved, and they would soon be waking up.
However, Paragon’s injuries were too severe.
It would take some time for his soul to heal and his body to return to its shape.
In other words, he was saved from death’s door, but he wouldn’t be waking up anytime soon.
But it was already good enough.
However, Kent wasn’t happy that he never got to have a chat with Paragon.
He wanted to have a heart-to-heart with the Paragon and even ask for some pointers on how to defy major odds like he did.
In the end, he settled for recording a video message while his wives said their final goodbyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1087: Back To His Universe
paragraphs: A bittersweet goodbye, one would say.
Kent watches his wives hug and say goodbye to the friends they’ve made on this unexpected trip to a completely different universe.
It was an unexpected trip indeed.
However, it was one that brought families together.

Of course, the situation they met in wasn’t pleasant. However, they made it work somehow. However, every good thing must come to an end, so they had to say their goodbyes and, hopefully, one day they will meet again.
"You ladies should pay more attention to your training. The next time we meet, we will have more time to talk about ourselves and our big families," Nara said, looking at the three Elemental sisters.
They are injured again, but they aren’t in any danger.
Of course, with Alina’s Healing formation, they will be up on their feet in no time.
"You two should also take care of yourselves. When we meet again, we will have a blast," Aria said, and the two sisters nodded.
Nara and her sister Mara weren’t the only ones saying their goodbyes.

Princess Lovina was with Poison Queen Ohema. They bonded over their shared love for poison. It is in their nature to love poison, so the two ladies bonded, and now that they are leaving, she could only say her goodbyes.
Unity also met with Hanna, who was also injured trying to save her sisters. Unity gave Hanna all the arrows her Primordial Spirits made for her before they went into slumber.
In return, Hanna also gave Unity a technique called Seven Arrows of Condemnation. The technique is something far more valuable than the arrows Unity gave her.
This left Unity in a bind... She wanted to make sure her gift matched what Hanna gave her. In the end, she transferred her experience in awakening a Primordial Spirit to Hanna.
"It is what I went through while awakening my Primordial Spirit. If you can share it with your sisters, I am sure you will soon find a way to upgrade your soul spirits to primordial spirits."
Hanna thanked her.
She could tell how valuable this knowledge she had now was. This made her eternally grateful.
More goodbyes between the wives were said.
However, the legion also made friends, and Kaizo now looked at his pal, Lord Trench; a smile that reached down to his soul appeared on his face.
"Too bad I have to leave. I would have stayed long enough to help you guys get your revenge," Kaizo said, clenching his fist.
Lord Trench smiled and shook his head slightly. "Quite unfortunate you have to leave. However, when we meet again, I am sure there will be many battles to be fought."
"That would be awesome." Kaizo smiled, already looking forward to the day they would meet again.
Alina also met up with Princess Eshira to hand her the ownership of the Grand Archer Planet Formation.
"This should go to him," Princess Eshira said, wiping tears from her eyes.
Alina nodded, but because Paragon was unconscious, she knew that giving it to the next person who understood runes would be the best move.
Princess Eshira was selected by her sisters, so she handed it to her.

"He will wake up one day. When he does, you can give it to him, but for now, you must become the owner. Once it starts spreading to other planets, you will be able to sense when someone is coming to your world.
You will then have the means to attack them or let them through. Of course, I know you are smart, so you will figure out a way to make it even better than it is now."
"Thank you for this and everything." Princess Eshira bowed slightly toward Alina before walking away.
Thanks to Alina’s healing formation, her sisters are now safe from harm. In a way, Kent saved their husband, and Alina saved the wives.

Alina only sighed, moved, and started drawing some runes in the air. She was still not satisfied with how things had turned out, so she was making sure that, when she was gone, this family, nearly shattered, would thrive, and that one day, when they met again, it would be all fun.
Alina was fortunate to find a big, happy family, so she wanted to leave this one, too, on happy terms.
Kent saw through Alina’s mental state, so he approached her and hugged her from behind, despite his body still aching.
Alina smiled. "I am fine, Kent. I am merely setting up a Firework Array that will light up the sky every year as a reminder of today’s victory.

Whenever it lights up, every soul will know that although they went through many sufferings, they persevered. It will be a reminder of the victory they won in their unfair battle against the heavens."
Kent nodded and kissed her neck, making sure she knew he was with her on that...

The cloud was still roaring, and every second that passed, Kent could tell they truly wanted to slaughter the woman who couldn’t let go of her son, despite the five uncles of the Paragon reminding her that the longer she stayed, the more danger she put her son in.
Kent could only sigh, watching this.
Soon, however, the portal back to his world opened, signaling that it was time for him to leave.
Kent walked toward Paragon’s sleeping body and crouched down, making sure his words entered his ears even if he couldn’t hear a thing...

"Obviously, we will have to postpone the ritual to become sworn brothers until next time. However, since we will probably meet again in the most unusual way possible, it is fine if I leave this behind."
Kent retrieved a memory crystal from his space ring and handed it to Paragon.
"I have already left detailed instructions on how to use it in the video I recorded." A smile appeared on his face.
"I am also from Earth, in case you are wondering. However, unlike yours, mine is very messed up in all the wrong ways. However, it taught me how to adapt and keep pushing forward.

This is why I believe you will also adapt to this second chance at life. It won’t be long until you get back on your feet. When that time comes, just keep pushing forward, and one day, you will reach your goal."

Kent stood up and looked at the crying mother. "He is safe now, so you can leave knowing he will be in good hands. Although I don’t know him much, I saw the way he fought, and based on that, I can promise you that it won’t be long before you reunite."

Kent walked back and turned to leave. However, before taking a few steps, Paragon’s mom grabbed his hand. "Thank you for saving my son. If there is time next time, I will be sure to pay you back a hundredfold."
Kent smiled and nodded.
After everything was said and done, he made sure his people started entering the portal.
The Bloodvein Tribe entered first, followed by his Legion, then his wives. Although it took some time, they entered, some even holding back their tears.
After the last of them entered, Kent waved a final goodbye and entered. The portal closed the next second, and all parties involved appeared in the familiar confines of the Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 1088: Kent’s Next Moves
paragraphs: "Thank you, Tribe Chief Malthar. If it hadn’t been for you and your people, things would have ended very badly."
"No need to thank me, Kent. You saved us and gave us a home, so the least we can do is help you fend off your enemies."
Kent smiles.
Now that he is back in his universe, where he is loved and cared for, he finally sees how hard Paragon has it in his universe.
The Bloodvein Tribe fought bravely and lost only five warriors. However, it was war, and death happens. But hearing the sincere words from his father-in-law, he can tell they hold no regrets.
After a few more talks, Kent finally informed him of his next moves.
"I will soon be using the tribulation to ascend to a High World. Once I do, the energy in the tower will grow much denser, allowing you all to break through.
The tower will also undergo many changes as a result, so prepare your tribesmen and make everyone aware of the changes about to occur."
Tribe Chief Malthar nodded.

After he left with his people, Kent turned to the Legion. "It appears I can’t allow you all to push through your limits inside the dungeon. Once I ascend, it will take only a couple of years for some of you to reach the Heavenly Ascension stage...
So sorry about that."
"No need to worry, Master, we have seen how far we can go in Paragon’s Universe. Although we are still lacking, we saw where to improve.
I am sure a few weeks in seclusion will shape us into battle-ready warriors next time we have to cross over and go help the Paragon again," Kaizo said, beating his chest.
"Sure."
Kent didn’t want to tell the overly enthusiastic Kaizo that they wouldn’t be crossing over anytime soon, that he would have to focus on his training.
What none of them realized was that the key that brought them over to Paragon’s Universe also gave them a boon.
While they felt no changes thanks to the masking effect of the boon, every last one of them went into the battle as Spirit Lords.
Even Kent only discovered this after the battle.

However, going in as Spirit Lords and fighting those three realms above them was already enough to show the kind of strength they possessed. It was already enough for them to break through and rapidly advance to the Heavenly Ascension stage without weakening their foundation.
"Are you done exploring the 4th floor of the dungeon?" Kent instead chose to move away from that topic and instead focus on the events he had left to handle before ascending.
"We are yet to explore the underground chambers," Sylara answered, and Kent nodded.
"Then rest for a few days and go handle that. Once that is done, come back here and wait until I ascend before challenging the 5th level."
The Legion nodded and vanished back into the Legion Tower.
Kent was left with his wives.
Some are bruised, others broken, and some are completely fine.
"We won’t be going to the Interplanetary Sect Competition," Kent declared.
"Why?" his wives asked.
"Because I have no plans on showing your pale and worn-out faces to the public. I mean, how would that reflect on my handsome image?"
Every last woman, even Lady Enzi and Liora, gave him the "If you don’t dress up so we can leave, we will drag your body all the way to the Celestial Gate Planet" look.
Kent shuddered.
He had faced angels and demons a couple of hours ago, but under the glare of his wives, he shuddered.
"Fine. When you ladies get there, let me know, and I will come."
After saying that, Kent teleported away and appeared in the Tower Store, immediately purchasing some healing potions. He then gulped them all down and went ahead to buy some more.
The battle he had been in had taken a heavy toll on his body. He needed to rest, but knowing he had another promise to fulfill, he wanted to be ready for the sect competition.
He was not a seed candidate, meaning he must fight in the preliminaries. He had promised Lady Enzi he would help her sect win the competition before she ascended.
After drinking enough healing potions, he retired into a chair to let his body rest and heal.

"How chaotic," Kent sighed, his mind traveling back to Paragon’s universe. When he arrived there, he expected a battle like the one he had experienced down in hell; however, to his amazement, things turned out much more savage.
First, he had to face an entire battlefield on his own. Then he fought beings with strengths several realms above him, and he was even forced to take on a palm strike from an immortal.
Then, to make matters even more chaotic, he killed seven gods with a wave of his hand.
Talk about being overpowered — with his goddess wife holding his hand, he actually slayed seven gods and walked away unscathed.
"I am badass for sure," Kent grinned. Although his wife did all the heavy lifting, he was the one who struck the nail in, killing the gods.
However, while that was amazing and he would definitely brag about it one of these days, what took his breath away was Paragon.
He saw a lone figure standing tall, facing the unfathomable heavens. He shouldered the load, and in the end, he willingly gave his life to save those he cared about.
Though Kent didn’t wish for a Paragon life, he was triggered by something wholly disturbing, which prompted him to sigh in his heart and make a solemn vow.
"For as long as I live and breathe, I will never allow the heavens to be influenced in any way by any outside party.
I, Kent Madson, the Primordial Chaos Dragon, will ensure this universe remains free from all forms of outside manipulation.

Mercy on the souls of those who will dare turn their evil gaze on my universe," because his bloodline was still at 25% since the 24 hours weren’t up yet, a wave of chaos aura washed out of his body, showing how serious he was.
Kent closed his eyes and decided to rest. His wives knew he was tired, so when they got to the Planet Celestial Gate, they would enter the tower and carry him out.
Once everything was done here, he would ascend and continue his journey.
[Core of the Universe]

Lady Universe and the Enchantress held calm smiles on their faces, hearing what Kent had just said. As cosmic beings, they knew that when an external force attacked the universe, they could only rely on the beings that lived in it.
During the Primordial Era, the Chaos Dragon had sacrificed his life to save the universe, making him invaluable throughout the universe.
Now, hearing his solemn voice, they felt safe knowing the same old dragon who once stood up for the universe had yet again planned to save it if anyone dared lay their eyes on it.
"He has changed somehow," Lady Universe said, and the Enchantress nodded.
"That is to be expected considering where he went."
The two ladies sighed.
They continued to watch Kent’s handsome face as he slept comfortably in his chair.

chapters.title: Chapter 1089: Going To The Competition
paragraphs: Kent plans to sleep for a while. However, his wives came for him faster than he had hoped...
He forgot that his wives can use the tower portals to enter the sect, and then from there, they can just use a teleportation gate to reach Planet Celestial Gate.
The only time they wasted was when they stayed a few days inside the tower to heal before going.
Of course, staying 5 days inside the tower is just 5 hours out there, so they reached Planet Celestial Gate long before the competition even started.
There are still a couple of hours before it starts, but as someone who would be participating in the preliminaries, Kent was supposed to be ready a few hours earlier.
Thankfully, he had time to prepare.
Celestial Gate is a majestic planet. It is far more beautiful than Planet Sonox and a few other planets Kent had been to.
Of course, he had been to many high worlds and had seen better, but for a medium world, this new planet is very beautiful.
It has towering buildings and plants that aren’t white or green either. It is a blend between the two, and well, they look more artificial than natural.
Kent even saw that some of the buildings are carved from beautiful stones that aren’t quite jade nor real stones either.
Naturally, Kent was fascinated, but he wasn’t quite interested in exploring this world, considering he had more important things to do when he was done with this competition.

As for the people who live in this world, they have pale white skin, and a few folks have golden skin. Kent was yet again taken aback by these strange looks, but he soon saw something that caught his interest.
The world around him is beautiful, the people living in it are beautiful, but there are no beasts. Not even a bird could be seen in sight. This made Kent wonder just where all of them had gone.
He used his soul map to scan the planet, but found it was much larger than his 80,000 km of coverage could handle. He chose to let this mystery slide for now.
However, he saw the thousands of disciples coming for the competition.
There are 54 participating sects, so thousands of disciples are expected to attend.

"This is just bullying. The level of opponents that I fight, these poor souls will be crushed by just staring at them," Kent said, walking beside Lady Enzi and Liora as they headed to the location where they would register him as a participant in the competition.
The two ladies smiled, knowing it was indeed bullying. However, this is a competition, and Kent is a disciple...
"Just see it as relaxation after a very chaotic battle," Lady Liora said with a small smile.
"What should be relaxing is me sleeping, surrounded by naked jade beauties, feeding me berries and apples."
The two ladies couldn’t help but smile at hearing Kent’s words. Knowing the kind of life he lives, they knew his relaxation plan was indeed on point.
However, he made a promise, so he must fulfill it.
"It will be over in a few days, then you can go back to the relaxation of your dreams," Lady Enzi said, and Kent couldn’t help nodding to that.
There is no telling what would happen during the competition, but they knew Kent was no simple person, so he would be fine.
As they entered a mansion and moved through the corridor, and were about to branch to a different hall, a demi-tiger with two aquatic beasts blocked their path.

Kent saw them long before they met, so he knew they were no good news. However, he decided to see how things played out, even though he could have used his soul universe to deal with them without even Lady Enzi and Liora noticing.
"Well, well, if it isn’t the glass lady and the silent one," the tiger man said, a mocking smile on his face. The two aquatic beasts, a seahorse and an anglerfish, smirked, looking at Kent.
They knew better than to disrespect the elders of a sect, so they directed their mockery today at the non-chant Kent.

"Ravenos, we have no time to entertain your childishness, so move out of the way and let us pass. Your Primal Beast Sect can face us in a fair battle if you have a problem," Lady Enzi said, looking to move.
However, Ravenos, one of the elders of the second-rank sect in the Celestial Ascendence Planetary Alliance, blocked their path.
"Why the rush, Enzi? At least introduce me to this kid. For two great beauties to be escorting a nobody, I am intrigued by what his identity is."
The two ladies gritted their teeth, knowing these bastards always had issues with the Supreme Immortal Sect.

Also, they could tell he was intentionally provoking them. Naturally, the two ladies didn’t want to have an issue with him—not that they were afraid—but as a way to ensure whatever scheme he had in mind wouldn’t succeed.
Kent can see they didn’t want to play with this bastard, so he decided to get this farce over with.
"My name is Kent Madson. I am responsible for the death of his father, her mother, and all of the Ancient Sea Race. And yet, the remaining ones are now servants of the who of Planet Sonox.
So if you have a problem, face me in the arena and stop this nonsense. Of course, I don’t mind turning the entire Primal Beast sect into servants of my sect."
Without even showing any respect, Kent used his hand to push Elder Ravenos aside, and then, without even minding them, he moved, and the two ladies followed.
After they were gone, the elder and the two disciples gritted their teeth, feeling a surge of anger bubble in their hearts.

They were aware of what happened to the Ancient Sea Race. After they colluded with the vampires to attack Sonox, Kent made Alina bind their fate to Planet Sonox. Whenever it was under attack, they would be forced to defend it.
In a way, after killing many innocents, they were now going to be the ones to die when there was an attack again. It was a fate worse than death.
So, finally meeting the one responsible for turning their once vibrant race into mere meat shields, they all became extremely angry.

The Primal Beast Sect’s best disciples came from that race, so the entire sect was angry and wanted blood. But now they would direct their attention to the one responsible, which, in this case, is Kent.
"Relax, he is already marked for death," Elder Ravenos said, his expression dark as he led his two disciples away.
Kent smirked, hearing what he said. ’Breaking a few bones and making them regret their life choices will be enough to instill some fear into their hearts.’
Kent smiled, realizing that perhaps this competition wouldn’t be too boring after all.
Soon, they reached the registration area. After Kent registered, they met the other disciples who would be participating in the competition.
The seeded candidates were the Pill Princess, Ice Maiden, the One-Eyed Demon Spawn, the Venom King, and the Crystal Dragon.
After seeing what Kent was capable of during the Apocalypse battle, all five of them became obedient, especially Vanna, the Pill Princess, who was now more docile than a dolphin.
Aside from them, Kent’s little sis, whom he met in the sect, Nyss, would also be participating. Even Princess Elowen, Lady Enzi’s disciple, would also participate.
The next day, the competition officially began...

chapters.title: Chapter 1090: Let’s Start By Dominating
paragraphs: "Welcome, everyone."
An elder from the Celestial Gate sect said, looking around at the thousands of disciples and elders gathered for the Interplanetary Sect Competition.
"As you all know, this is the interplanetary sect competition, which happens every decade. It is when we compete to see which sect ranks first and which ranks last.
As always, there will be only ten disciples from each sect, of which five are seeded. The other five will be selected through an elimination round.

There are over 200 arenas to handle all battles, so every sect should pay attention to the schedules given. The moment it is your disciple’s turn, you must send them to the arena they will be fighting in.

Once the last five disciples are selected, the battle to see who is crowned the best will begin. Remember, you cannot kill your fellow disciples... of course, accidents happen, but that is not an open invitation to slaughter each other.
Those who violate this rule will be disqualified, and the sect they represent will be disqualified from the competition.
If you have any questions, feel free to ask."
Everyone was already aware of these rules, so they said nothing. However, one person raised his hand to ask a question.
Naturally, this person is Kent. "Go ahead. State your name and the sect you represent, and then ask your question."

"I am Kent Madson from the Supreme Immortal sect, and my question is very simple. Since killing is not allowed, can we sever the legs and arms of our opponents? This is a battle, and to win, one must do what is necessary. Since we can’t kill, I want to know if mutilation is allowed."
The expression on everyone’s face turned solemn, hearing such a chilling question asked so casually. Many started to wonder just what kind of person would ask such a question.
The elder looked at Kent for a few seconds before responding...
"As long as it doesn’t result in death, then sure, cutting an arm or leg off is allowed."

"Wonderful," Kent grinned, causing the disciples who saw his expression to shudder. They could tell he meant every single word he asked, and so every last disciple started praying they didn’t meet him.

"Getting under the skin of your opponents before the battle even starts, huh... what a clever child," an elder standing with the Celestial Gate sect said. She seemed to have seen through what Kent did...
However, she was mistaken if she thought Kent was merely trying to scare the disciples. He truly wanted to know if mutilating his opponents was allowed.
After all, he planned to have fun with the Primal Beast Sect, and what better way to get that done than by removing a few arms and legs?
"If there are no other questions, then we will proceed with the opening match." A large slab of stone appeared from the ground and flew into the air.
Then, on the surface, the matchups started to appear.
"Looks like you two will be fighting first," Kent said to Nyss and Princess Elowen when their names showed.
Nyss was matched against a disciple from the Wyxn Light Sect, and Elowen was matched with a disciple from the Mystic Ice Sect. The two were from the 10th and 11th-ranked sects.
"Looks like it." Nyss’s smile showed she was already looking forward to testing how much stronger she had become after absorbing all the treasures Kent gave her.
Princess Elowen was the same. Her master had spent a great deal of time teaching her the infamous ’Glass Art,’ so she wanted to see if she had what it took to handle someone of the same rank.
"Just kick their asses and show everyone the Supreme Immortal Sect is not to be trifled with." Kent knew they were strong, so he wasn’t worried.

Soon, they left. The large stone that displayed the names became a viewing screen showing the various battles. All one had to do was focus on the battle they wanted to see, and their minds would be transported there.

Kent didn’t have to use that to see what was happening since he had the Soul Map. He opened it and linked his wives, Lady Enzi and Lady Liora, to it. In an instant, all the battles happening became bare before their eyes.
This allowed them all to watch the two battles and other battles involving the Supreme Immortal Sect simultaneously.
Nyss and her opponent sized each other up before going into a battle stance. Nyss retrieved a dagger and a short sword while her opponent held her staff in a firm grip.

The moment the battle started, Nyss’s opponent cast a blinding light spell, aiming to blind Nyss and then take advantage to use an even more powerful spell. However, Nyss saw through her plan long before she even made her move.
She had already created a counter for it and was only waiting for the battle to begin.

So the moment her opponent unleashed her attack, Nyss slid into a shadow cast by the match officiator. Then, without anyone even realizing how, she slipped into a second shadow—this time, one cast by the staff her opponent was holding.
It was game over for her the moment Nyss entered the shadow of her staff. All she did was emerge and place her dagger against her neck.
Nyss merely used the sword as a distraction. Her opponent would have expected her to go for close combat, only to be deceived.
On the other side, Princess Elowen met an arrogant opponent who thought he was superior to her, only to be knocked out with a single glass arrow.
She didn’t use her flame, yet she knocked out her opponent.
In the end, the battles ended much faster than one would expect.
The second round didn’t include Kent, but even so, he watched, and aside from one disciple of the Supreme Immortal Sect losing, the rest won.
In the third round, however, Kent was called.
His opponent was a member of the Celestial Gate Sect. He was a Sword Sage, just like Kent.
"I will give you a chance to surrender because if we were to fight, you wouldn’t last a minute against me," the Sword Sage said, his expression filled with arrogance.
Kent smiled, and then he chuckled. Afterward, he asked, "Have you ever killed a Sword King?"
"No."
"How about defeating one in a fair duel?"
"No."
"Then what gave you the right to think you can defeat me? I defeated a Sword King when I was a mere Sword Grandmaster, so please try not to make this look boring."
Kent extended his hand, and Gaap, his sword, appeared. His Blood Sword Aura and chilling Sword Intent enveloped the arena, forcing the poor arrogant bastard to his knees.
"How boring," Kent smiled, and then, with a wave of his hand, the poor guy was sent flying.
"Too boring." Kent walked away, watching the Sword Sage stare at him with a scared look in his eyes.
All those who saw the battle were left stunned, unsure of what to even think. The dominance was plain as day. Kent had dominated his opponent, and it was made clear by how easily he defeated him.
The rest of the battles happened soon afterward. By the end of the day, the last battle took place, and the five added to the seeded candidates were selected.
The next day, the main competition to see which sect ranks first and which ranks last began.

chapters.title: Chapter 1091: Supreme Immortal Sect vs Coven Of Peace (1)
paragraphs: The next day, 54 sects in the Celestial Ascendence Planetary Alliance gathered again for the main competition.
The reason why the first day was reserved for selecting the other five candidates who would join the five seeded candidates for the main battle was to see how the sects were doing.
Every sect has five disciples they pay extra attention to. They give them resources and freedom to grow limitlessly. These five are the seeded candidates.

However, after the five, there are other disciples who go through the same process as the others. In a way, they are the true measure of what a disciple should be and a reflection of how the sect is doing.
Their performance will show whether the sects pay attention only to the seeded candidates or show fairness to all other disciples.

The Supreme Immortal Sect lost only two battles. This was a clear indication that the sect isn’t weak. Of course, part of the reason for the sudden shift in the disciples’ behavior and combat abilities was the chaotic battle they fought two weeks ago.
They had grown both mentally and in experience.

As a result, Kent planned to become the guardian of the sect, meaning that if any of these disciples later became the ruler of the millions of worlds out there, he would automatically become their guardian, giving him his share of the soul essence he deserved.
The sheer odds they went against were just too much for them, yet they faced them like true warriors.
Kent, Nyss, Elowen, and two others joined the five seeded candidates for the main event.
Inside a room in a mansion, Kent sat with the nine other disciples and five elders, which included Lady Liora, Lady Enzi, and Elder Lance.
Elder Lance manages the disciples’ schedules, and Lady Enzi manages the team.

"Our first battle is against the Coven of Peace Sect," Elder Lance said, holding a jade tablet. "They were the 35th-ranked sect a decade ago. Of course, just as we have grown, they have grown as well, so they are not to be underestimated.
The Coven of Peace Sect only takes in Summoners, so be sure to know that you won’t only be fighting them, but you will also be fighting their summons.
Also, from the little information I have gathered, their captain can summon five Core Formation stage beasts, and even one is a Drake."
The disciples’ expressions darkened at hearing such news. They were powerful, but facing someone who could summon five beasts in the same rank as them wasn’t something to take lightly.
"Do we know how many beasts the others, aside from the captain, can summon?" Kent asked, but Elder Lance shook his head.
"I see. It is going to be fun then."
The other disciples turned and looked at him wryly.
"What?" Kent asked, not understanding why the strange looks.
"Big Brother, do you have a plan to handle them?" Nyss decided to ask, knowing her big brother was rather resourceful for a 21-year-old.
"I have no plan, Nyss. Just that if someone can summon five beasts at the same time, then what is preventing them from summoning a sixth or a seventh?"
"You think they deliberately made us aware of their captain’s capabilities as a way of misleading us?" Lady Enzi asked, and Kent smiled.

"They are smart, that is for sure. But I am not worried about any of us. At the end of the day, it will be seven against seven. If we defeat them 4–0, it will be our win. However, if they ask for a group battle, then we just have to take out the summoners, and their beasts will go down too."
"That is easier said than done," Vanna, the Pill Princess, said, keeping her expression calm.

"No need to worry, Pill Princess, we have the right person for that here," Kent pointed at Nyss. "She can slide through the cracks and catch them off guard, so if there is a royal rumble, know that she will be our killing weapon."
Nyss puffed her cheeks and raised her shoulders, telling everyone she had them covered.
Her big brother, Xhan Wu, the Venom King, smirked, knowing his sister was indeed suited for the role.
"Let’s just wait and see what they will choose. They are, after all, the ones going to select the mode of battle."
A couple of minutes later, they left the mansion and headed to the arena they would be fighting in. When they got there, the Coven of Peace Sect was already there waiting for them.
Naturally, they were intimidated by the Supreme Immortal Sect. After all, they were the 3rd-ranked sect among the 54 participating in this competition.
However, Kent, who was much more perceptive, could see the mockery hidden behind their eyes.
’Oh, this is going to be an eye-opener.’ Using his Heavenly Jade Eyes, he saw the true danger posed by the disciples of the Coven of Peace Sect.
’They are clearly hiding their true strength. However, as they say, in front of absolute power, all schemes are useless. They will soon learn the bitter truth.’
Kent smiled in his head, stood on the side of his sect, and waited for the match officiator to start the match.
A couple of minutes later, the person appeared.
"The Coven of Peace Sect has selected individual battles. Each sect will call forth a disciple, and whoever wins will have the right to continue or let another member of their team take over.
If a team wins four times in a row, it will be their win. However, you can choose to go for a team battle after the first three battles.
If that happens, then it will be seven against seven, so keep that in mind." Every disciple nodded.
"In that case, each side should send their challenger."
The Coven of Peace sent a slim-looking young man named Kroth, who stepped forward holding a staff. He was a seeded candidate, meaning he was not one to be underestimated. Kent studied him and smiled.
"Zeyrion, you take this one," Lady Enzi sent the Crystal Dragon Prince to take the first challenge.
He was no weakling, but extremely arrogant, so they called him the Arrogant Crystal Dragon Prince.
’I see what she is trying to do. I just hope this bastard doesn’t become overly arrogant and actually wins with minimal effort.’
When Zeyrion entered the arena, Kroth sized him up and smirked. "So you are the Crystal Lizard, huh?"
Zeyrion looked calmly at Kroth and said nothing, which was shocking. The Zeyrion everyone knew would be bubbling with anger by now.
However, despite being called a lizard, he said nothing and instead looked at his opponent with a calm expression.
’That is true character development right there,’ Kent smiled.
"Are you two ready?" Kroth and Zeyrion nodded.
"Begin."

The reason why the first day was reserved for selecting the other five candidates who would join the five seeded candidates for the main battle was to see how the sects were doing.
Every sect has five disciples they pay extra attention to.
They give them resources and freedom to grow limitlessly.
These five are the seeded candidates.
However, after the five, there are other disciples who go through the same process as the others.
In a way, they are the true measure of what a disciple should be and a reflection of how the sect is doing.
Their performance will show whether the sects pay attention only to the seeded candidates or show fairness to all other disciples.
The Supreme Immortal Sect lost only two battles.
This was a clear indication that the sect isn’t weak.
Of course, part of the reason for the sudden shift in the disciples’ behavior and combat abilities was the chaotic battle they fought two weeks ago.
They had grown both mentally and in experience.

As a result, Kent planned to become the guardian of the sect, meaning that if any of these disciples later became the ruler of the millions of worlds out there, he would automatically become their guardian, giving him his share of the soul essence he deserved.
The sheer odds they went against were just too much for them, yet they faced them like true warriors.
Kent, Nyss, Elowen, and two others joined the five seeded candidates for the main event.
Inside a room in a mansion, Kent sat with the nine other disciples and five elders, which included Lady Liora, Lady Enzi, and Elder Lance.
Elder Lance manages the disciples’ schedules, and Lady Enzi manages the team.
"Our first battle is against the Coven of Peace Sect," Elder Lance said, holding a jade tablet.
"They were the 35th-ranked sect a decade ago.
Of course, just as we have grown, they have grown as well, so they are not to be underestimated.
The Coven of Peace Sect only takes in Summoners, so be sure to know that you won’t only be fighting them, but you will also be fighting their summons.

It is going to be fun then."

However, as they say, in front of absolute power, all schemes are useless.
They will soon learn the bitter truth.’

If that happens, then it will be seven against seven, so keep that in mind." Every disciple nodded.

Kent studied him and smiled.

’I see what she is trying to do.
I just hope this bastard doesn’t become overly arrogant and actually wins with minimal effort.’
When Zeyrion entered the arena, Kroth sized him up and smirked.
"So you are the Crystal Lizard, huh?"
Zeyrion looked calmly at Kroth and said nothing, which was shocking.
The Zeyrion everyone knew would be bubbling with anger by now.
