chapters.title: Chapter 1092: Supreme Immortal Sect vs Coven Of Peace (2)
paragraphs: One weakness of summoners is the weakness they go through whenever they summon a beast. Summoning the beasts itself is not tiring, but maintaining the gate open is the problem.
It takes too much energy, and so once a person summons a beast, they stand back and wait for the beast to be completely merged with reality before deactivating the summoning gate.
This process mostly takes a couple of seconds, depending on how strong the beast is.

So the moment Kroth summoned the three beasts, Zeyrion saw the exhaustion. However, he knew if he attacked, the three beasts would interfere and defend him, so he used the most unlikely way to get what he wanted.
He provoked Kroth into summoning a second gate, which he knew a seeded candidate could do. This means the moment the second gate appeared, poor Kroth would be very weakened.
"Crystal Blizzard."
Zeyrion activated a skill, and in an instant, a blizzard covered the entire arena, causing Kroth to turn pale.
He was already weakened, so this attack further weakened him. This allowed Zeyrion to take him out instantly.
"Crystal Beam." His eyes glowed, and before Kroth could make any attempt to block him, the beam came and landed on his body, sending him flying out of the arena.
He passed out the next second, and his three summoned beasts and the gates closed. The second summoning gate hadn’t even fully materialized before he was sent flying.
’Looks like he is using his brain now,’ Kent smiled. The intelligence Zeyrion had displayed now was much more amazing for someone known for his arrogance and brutality.
"The Supreme Immortal Sect won this round, and they want to maintain their player... Coven of Peace can send their second participant."
Another seeded candidate stepped in. However, this one didn’t try to provoke Zeyrion, learning from his teammate’s mistake.
The moment the match began, he waved his staff, and from thin air, a lion about 5 meters tall appeared and attacked Zeyrion. He then stabbed his staff into the air and summoned three more beasts.
Zeyrion had already anticipated a change in combat mode, so he prepared. But even he never expected this opponent to have a named summoned beast.
Summoners can sometimes summon a beast and then gain the ability to name their summon. The moment they name it, it becomes one with them.
This means summoning them into combat is as simple as waving his staff. He doesn’t have to use a summoning gate.
Having named summoned beasts is very rare, so Zeyrion never saw that coming.
However, he reacted on time and managed to evade the first attack from the lion. Soon, he was forced to move back when three more beasts appeared.
"Dragon Fear."
Zeyrion unleashed his dragon fear, causing the four beasts to become intimidated.
"Cleansen." His opponent used a buff skill to take away the dragon’s fear, causing his four beasts to get back to attack more fiercely.
However, Zeyrion didn’t frown at that. He merely moved back, buying himself two seconds to unleash a powerful attack.
As a crystal dragon, he could unleash powerful crystallized attacks, ones that ordinary beasts could not handle.
Zeyrion’s eyes glowed bright blue. He is still in his demi-dragon form, which is almost a perfect human form, except for the horns.
He is not like Kent, who can be in both his demi-dragon and human forms.
Shards of crystal formed in the air around Zeyrion, looking sharp and deadly. They spun fast, humming with energy.
The four beasts charged again.
The lion roared, shaking the arena. The ground cracked beneath its paws as it moved forward...
A wolf made of fire leaped at Zeyrion from the side, aiming to distract him so that the other three beasts could close in on him. However, Zeyrion is no ordinary dragon.
He crossed his arms and shouted, "Crystal Burst!"
Dozens of crystal shards shot out in all directions. Their whistle creates the impression that every last shard is a razor-sharp weapon meant to kill.
The air sparkled as they hit the beasts. The lion took the hit on its chest, roaring in pain.
Since it is a Named Beast, Zeyrion chooses not to kill it. Doing so is akin to killing a part of the summoner.
The fire wolf, on the other hand, cracked and faded into smoke.
But the other two beasts—a stone bear and a serpent of mist—kept coming. The serpent circled Zeyrion, trying to choke him.
Zeyrion spun fast, covering himself in crystal armor. He still refuses to take on his full dragon form. The serpent’s mist hissed against the crystal surface of his army but couldn’t break through.
Zeyrion didn’t waste much time since he had none. He raised his right arm, and a large crystal spear appeared in his hand.
He threw it straight at the stone bear. The impact sent a shockwave across the arena, shattering the ground.
The bear fell and broke apart into dust.

The serpent screeched, turning to retreat under the command of the summoner, but Zeyrion was faster. He dashed forward, summoning wings made of crystal. They spread wide, and with a single flap, he closed in with the serpent
"Crystal Rend!" he yelled, attacking with a fierce attack. His claws glowed, slicing through the mist. The serpent’s body tore apart and vanished.
Silence filled the arena.
The lion was injured, and so it vanished back to the Summoner’s soul sea. So the moment the Serpent was dispatched, the summoner gasped and fell to one knee.
His beasts were gone. The effort had drained his energy, so summoning another set of beasts isn’t going to happen.
Zeyrion walked toward him slowly and pressed a sword formed from Crystal against his neck.

"The Supreme Immortal Sect wins again!" the announcer shouted. The disciples cheered as their sect won back-to-back. It was to be expected, considering this is the third-ranked sect facing the 35th-ranked sect.
Zeyrion turned away and looked toward Kent. Their eyes met for a moment. Kent nodded with a faint smile. Zeyrion simply folded his arms and waited for the next challenger
In the end, Zeyrion single-handedly won all four battles for the Supreme Immortal Sect to advance to the next stage in the competition.
His 4th battle against the captain of the Coven of Peace lasted 20 minutes. He used his dragon form before he managed to win.
However, the endgame was achieved. However, he wouldn’t be able to participate in the next battle.
Kent didn’t know who they would be fighting next, so he just left to rest and further heal before the next battle.
His wives, however, decided to go on a tour. They want to see more of Planet Celestial Gate, so he allowed them. It wasn’t like they would be in danger.

However, because Selene is still not fully recovered, she decided to stay with Kent despite telling her to go heal in the tower. She just hugged him and soundly slept, making sure when she woke up, Kent wouldn’t sneakily slip away.
In the end, Lady Enzi compromised and allowed Kent to stay with Selene while the rest of his teammates handled their next match.
However, she said if they met the Primal Beast Sect, Kent would be the one to handle that battle.
Kent, who was already looking forward to that, was quick to accept this arrangement...
"You can send her to the tower. I will come to get you when you are needed. It will also help you heal much faster."
Kent nodded to Lady Enzi’s words and entered the tower. Since she now has access to the Tower, she can come and go as she pleases.

chapters.title: Chapter 1100: One Against Seven
paragraphs: Hearing Lady Enzi’s request caused every living soul who came for the Primal Beast Sect to grind their teeth, anger bubbling in their eyes...
There is one thing for easily defeating an opponent in a 1v1 battle, and another to request a 7v1 team battle. That is not something to be taken lightly.
The Primal Beast Sect is no weak sect.

They are the second-ranked sect in the alliance, so giving them the respect they deserve is the least they could ask. However, the words that came out of Lady Enzi’s mouth had no respect whatsoever for them.
This made them extremely angry.
"This bitch, who does she think she is?" Elder Ravenos, the elder who tried to pick a fight with Lady Enzi two days back, gritted his teeth, his expression turning darker.
The idea that only Kent will be facing their sect in the team battle clearly didn’t sit right with him.
"This is just too arrogant," someone in the audience said.
"I never knew a sect could be this arrogant. I mean, what do they take the Primal Beast Sect for?"
"A decade ago, the Primal Beast Sect disciplined them, so it seems they are still angry and want to disrespect them back. However, going one against seven is just too much."
"Maybe they want to lose but don’t have the balls to send all seven disciples to fight. They are clearly afraid."
More comments continue to fly through the air.

Hatred has a way of blinding even the most intelligent. They had just seen Kent defeat the first disciple of the Primal Beast Sect. They saw how effortlessly he did it, yet they were still blinded by hatred to the point that they believed the Primal Beast Sect still had a chance.
If they still had their minds straight, they would have seen that Kent was much more dangerous and that perhaps he had what it takes to win in a 7v1.
But they still believed in the Primal Beast Sect, and so, they continued to curse at Kent and the Supreme Immortal Sect.
Naturally, Kent was more than ready to further infuriate them.
Elder Ravenos selected the seven disciples to fight Kent... Five of them were from the Ancient Sea Race, and the other two were dragons.
The moment they entered the arena, the dragons assumed their true dragon forms and took to the air. Kent watched this with a small smile.
"What a pointless struggle," he lowered his eyes, scanned the faces of the five remaining on the ground, and grinned...
"I don’t like to underestimate my opponents; however, I can’t help but look down on you seven. It is as if you all still don’t understand your place," Kent smirked and looked at Elder Ravenos.

"It doesn’t matter whether they are the seven of your best. Even if all elders in your sect, including the sect leader, were to climb into the arena now, it wouldn’t take me five minutes to handle all of you."
Gasps spread everywhere, but Kent didn’t mind them...

"You losers are in this medium world and think you have seen everything already... What a bunch of losers," Kent scoffed and then looked at the elder overseeing the match. "At this point, declaring me as the winner is the best way forward."
Everyone, aside from the Supreme Immortal Sect disciples, continued to bubble with anger so intense; tearing Kent to pieces and feeding his body to the fishes was all they wanted.
The disrespect was too much...
"Please start the match so we can kill this bastard." The captain of the Primal Beast Sect, a seahorse beast, said, his eyes bloodshot.
The elder, who also wanted to end this farce quickly, given everyone’s anger, nodded and turned to Kent...

"I am ready if they are." The grin on Kent’s face further enraged everyone. They couldn’t wait to see Kent’s dead body, even if it would disqualify the sect. After all, a decade later, they could come back to reclaim their title...
"Begin."
The moment the elder started the battle, the two dragons took a nosedive and unleashed powerful breath attacks at Kent.
Scorching hot flames blasted from their mouths, and Kent, who had every opportunity to evade, simply stood there, allowing the flames to bathe him completely.
Cheers exploded everywhere.
Everyone was happy to see Kent engulfed in flames. They believe that with this one breath attack, Kent is done for.
"Looks like he couldn’t even move under the gaze and attack of two dragons. Good riddance," one elder from the Primal Beast Sect said, his expression filled with happiness.
Others were also happy to see Kent’s body consumed by the two dragon flames.
However, when the attack ended and the flames receded, every last face turned grim...
There, untouched by the flames, Kent stood looking at the two dragons with a mocking smile.
"You call that a flame attack... How pathetic." Kent, who had been to hell and back, knew what true flame felt like. What the two dragons had just unleashed wasn’t even enough to tickle his skin.

His flame resistance was already at the Flame Immunity stage. Although not at the point where no flame would affect him, his resistance was high enough to even survive attacks from early-stage immortals.
He was that strong now. So the two dragons, thinking they had what it took to burn him, were just laughable and, well, very pathetic.
The two dragons froze midair, unsure how to even handle what had just happened...
"Before you two get any ideas, know that your flame attacks won’t work on me. So why don’t you play with each other?" Kent grinned, then unleashed his mind manipulation skill.
He received that skill after adding Zaila to his harem...
With his superior mental strength and the fact that he had already broken three limits on his mind, he instantly gained access to their minds...
"Since you two like to breathe flames, why don’t you spray flames at each other?" Kent walked to the side, evading an attack he saw coming long before it arrived.
"Just make sure you don’t kill each other."
To everyone’s shock, the dragons turned on each other and began attacking one another...
Jaws fell, and shock rippled everywhere. Common sense has finally eluded everyone, causing them to wonder if Kent is even human.
Kent walked to his left again and evaded yet another attack. He then moved a step forward, and he appeared in front of a Crabfolk.
"One only needs two legs; why do you have six?" Kent grabbed one of the legs and yanked it off. It came clean off his body along with a soul-corroding scream, one that caused everyone to turn pale.
"Oh, before I forget, you losers can’t say the word ’surrender,’ so suffer in silence. I promise I won’t kill any of you."
Kent moved to his left again, evading yet another attack. He was not using any Flame Vein to move since his speed was already enough to see the enemy’s attack come at him in slow-mo.
Soon, more and more attacks started raining down on Kent, but with his hands behind him, he continued to evade every last attack.
Nobody could wrap their mind around how he was doing it, but the strongest watching all knew Kent wasn’t even putting in any effort. This scared them very much.
They could tell that no matter how hard they tried, touching even a hair on his head would be a luxury.
They are weak, and Kent, who wanted to send the message, could only grin as he sneakily used his mind manipulation skill on the Alliance Head.

Hatred has a way of blinding even the most intelligent.
They had just seen Kent defeat the first disciple of the Primal Beast Sect.
They saw how effortlessly he did it, yet they were still blinded by hatred to the point that they believed the Primal Beast Sect still had a chance.
If they still had their minds straight, they would have seen that Kent was much more dangerous and that perhaps he had what it takes to win in a 7v1.
But they still believed in the Primal Beast Sect, and so, they continued to curse at Kent and the Supreme Immortal Sect.
Naturally, Kent was more than ready to further infuriate them.
Elder Ravenos selected the seven disciples to fight Kent...
Five of them were from the Ancient Sea Race, and the other two were dragons.
The moment they entered the arena, the dragons assumed their true dragon forms and took to the air.
Kent watched this with a small smile.
"What a pointless struggle," he lowered his eyes, scanned the faces of the five remaining on the ground, and grinned...
"I don’t like to underestimate my opponents; however, I can’t help but look down on you seven.
It is as if you all still don’t understand your place," Kent smirked and looked at Elder Ravenos.
"It doesn’t matter whether they are the seven of your best.
Even if all elders in your sect, including the sect leader, were to climb into the arena now, it wouldn’t take me five minutes to handle all of you."
Gasps spread everywhere, but Kent didn’t mind them...
"You losers are in this medium world and think you have seen everything already...
What a bunch of losers," Kent scoffed and then looked at the elder overseeing the match.
"At this point, declaring me as the winner is the best way forward."
Everyone, aside from the Supreme Immortal Sect disciples, continued to bubble with anger so intense; tearing Kent to pieces and feeding his body to the fishes was all they wanted.
The disrespect was too much...
"Please start the match so we can kill this bastard." The captain of the Primal Beast Sect, a seahorse beast, said, his eyes bloodshot.
The elder, who also wanted to end this farce quickly, given everyone’s anger, nodded and turned to Kent...
"I am ready if they are." The grin on Kent’s face further enraged everyone.
They couldn’t wait to see Kent’s dead body, even if it would disqualify the sect.
After all, a decade later, they could come back to reclaim their title...
"Begin."
The moment the elder started the battle, the two dragons took a nosedive and unleashed powerful breath attacks at Kent.
Scorching hot flames blasted from their mouths, and Kent, who had every opportunity to evade, simply stood there, allowing the flames to bathe him completely.
Cheers exploded everywhere.
Everyone was happy to see Kent engulfed in flames.
They believe that with this one breath attack, Kent is done for.
"Looks like he couldn’t even move under the gaze and attack of two dragons.
Good riddance," one elder from the Primal Beast Sect said, his expression filled with happiness.
Others were also happy to see Kent’s body consumed by the two dragon flames.
However, when the attack ended and the flames receded, every last face turned grim...
There, untouched by the flames, Kent stood looking at the two dragons with a mocking smile.
"You call that a flame attack...
How pathetic." Kent, who had been to hell and back, knew what true flame felt like.
What the two dragons had just unleashed wasn’t even enough to tickle his skin.
His flame resistance was already at the Flame Immunity stage.
Although not at the point where no flame would affect him, his resistance was high enough to even survive attacks from early-stage immortals.
He was that strong now.
So the two dragons, thinking they had what it took to burn him, were just laughable and, well, very pathetic.
The two dragons froze midair, unsure how to even handle what had just happened...
"Before you two get any ideas, know that your flame attacks won’t work on me.
So why don’t you play with each other?" Kent grinned, then unleashed his mind manipulation skill.
He received that skill after adding Zaila to his harem...
With his superior mental strength and the fact that he had already broken three limits on his mind, he instantly gained access to their minds...
"Since you two like to breathe flames, why don’t you spray flames at each other?" Kent walked to the side, evading an attack he saw coming long before it arrived.
"Just make sure you don’t kill each other."
To everyone’s shock, the dragons turned on each other and began attacking one another...
Jaws fell, and shock rippled everywhere.
Common sense has finally eluded everyone, causing them to wonder if Kent is even human.
Kent walked to his left again and evaded yet another attack.
He then moved a step forward, and he appeared in front of a Crabfolk.
"One only needs two legs; why do you have six?" Kent grabbed one of the legs and yanked it off.
It came clean off his body along with a soul-corroding scream, one that caused everyone to turn pale.
"Oh, before I forget, you losers can’t say the word ’surrender,’ so suffer in silence.
I promise I won’t kill any of you."
Kent moved to his left again, evading yet another attack.
He was not using any Flame Vein to move since his speed was already enough to see the enemy’s attack come at him in slow-mo.
Soon, more and more attacks started raining down on Kent, but with his hands behind him, he continued to evade every last attack.
Nobody could wrap their mind around how he was doing it, but the strongest watching all knew Kent wasn’t even putting in any effort.
This scared them very much.
They could tell that no matter how hard they tried, touching even a hair on his head would be a luxury.
They are weak, and Kent, who wanted to send the message, could only grin as he sneakily used his mind manipulation skill on the Alliance Head.
